Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube .

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â

Job Summary 

This position is on the team building StrongDM, now part of Delineaâthe universal access management platform that secures and audits access to databases, servers, Kubernetes clusters, and web applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will apply deep expertise across distributed systems, security, and cloud architecture to help shape the technical direction of StrongDMâs proxy and control-plane platform. You will take on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous engineering challenges, exercise independent judgment on architecture and design decisions that span multiple teams, and serve as a recognized subject matter expert on secure, high-scale distributed systems written in Go. You will report to the teamâs engineering manager.

What Youâll Do:

- Lead the architecture and technical direction of highly concurrent, distributed backend systems in Go (Golang), setting engineering standards that extend across multiple teams within StrongDM and Delinea.

- Drive design decisions for the proxy data plane (gateways and relays) and control-plane services, evaluating tradeoffs on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous technical problems.

- Partner with architects, product managers, and DevOps/SRE leadership to shape multi-quarter system roadmaps, translating broader business priorities into concrete technical strategy.

- Serve as a subject matter expert on secure network protocols and cryptographic systems (TLS/mTLS, credential brokering, key management), guiding their application across the platform.

- Lead code and design reviews across teams, holding a high bar for performance, security, and maintainability, and coach engineers on applying that bar independently.

- Investigate and resolve the most challenging technical issues in distributed, multi-cloud production environments, often requiring evaluation of ambiguous or intangible tradeoffs.

- Author and maintain architectural and technical strategy documentation that informs decisions beyond your immediate team.

- Mentor engineers across the team and may direct the work of others, building the cross-team relationships that help align engineering execution with company objectives.

What Youâll Need: 

- Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in computer science, software engineering, or related technical discipline.

- 8+ years of professional experience working as a software engineer, with deep expertise in Go (Golang) , distributed systems, and backend/network service development at scale.

- Demonstrated experience architecting highly concurrent, distributed systems and exercising independent judgment on methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, including Goâs standard networking and cryptography libraries.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, network protocols, and API design (gRPC/Protobuf and/or RESTful APIs), with the ability to reason about tradeoffs across an entire system.

- Experience with AWS (or another major cloud provider) and cloud-native deployment models at production scale.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to convey advanced technical concepts and persuade diverse stakeholders and audiences.

- Proven ability to build formal working relationships and coordinate across multiple teams and functions.

- Conceptual thinking skills sufficient to understand advanced technical issues and their broader implications for the business.

- Demonstrated track record mentoring engineers and being recognized as a subject matter expert others turn to for guidance.

Weâd Love to See: 

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) beyond a single provider.

- Experience establishing or influencing engineering-wide standards for Terraform automation and CI/CD pipelines.

- Deep expertise with secure protocols, mTLS and PKI, secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), and credential brokering.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do 

- Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

- Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

- Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

- Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

- Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

- Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

- Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

- Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

- Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

- Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have 

- Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

- Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

- Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

- Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here 

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you .

Benefits Include: 

- Competitive compensation, including equity

- Full health, dental, and vision coverage

- Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

- Flexible time off

- Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together .

Employment Information 

Work Authorization 

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Reasonable Accommodations 

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Background Checks 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

At-Will Employment 

Employment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

- Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes. 
- Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements. 
- Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed. 
- Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise. 
- Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility. 
- Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port. 
- Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures. 

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

- Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
- Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
- Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work. 
- Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required. 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
- Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations. 
- Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format. 
- Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities. 
- Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work. 
- Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery. 
- Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise. 
- Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions. 
- Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others. 
- Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. 

Physical Requirements:

- Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory. 
- The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively. 
- The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential. 
- Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment. 
- Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling. 
- The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities. 
- Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs. 
- The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required. 
- Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team 

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t. We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.

Your Responsibilities 

- You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.

- Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.

- Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.

- Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.

- Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.

- Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.

- Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.

- Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.

- Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

Your Profile 

Must haves: 

- 3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.

- Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.

- Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.

- Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself.

- Curiosity about tax and a drive to make it feel easy for customers, even when the rules behind it are not.

- The ability to learn fast, take feedback well and change course when new facts come in.

- Energy, a strong work ethic and a hands-on attitude to detailed work.

- Clear, structured written English, and the confidence to explain trade-offs to senior leaders and say no with a reason.

Nice to haves: 

- Experience in a regulated field such as banking, payments, insurance or tax technology.

- Strong knowledge of the tax regime in one or more of Raisin’s markets, for example Germany (Abgeltungsteuer, tax exemption orders), or of statutory reporting such as CRS. Tax knowledge is not required. We will teach you.

- You have built tools for operations or customer service teams.

Important attributes for this role: 

- You bridge product and engineering. You are comfortable discussing data models and architecture trade-offs, and you push for practical solutions that scale.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! 

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from

- Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

- Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

- A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

- Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. 

- Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

- Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

- Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

- You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy 

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

This is a true builder role. You write the precise specifications and prompt architectures that bring solutions to life, making the critical design decisions that determine whether an enterprise AI deployment actually succeeds.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway 
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001. 

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us 

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

- Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
- User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
- API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
- Payments and billing. 
- ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
observability and alerting, consent and retention.
- The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on
Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access.
- Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were
never designed to meet.

Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want
someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and
used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone.

Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and
Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is
TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity
layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you.

How we work 

LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in. They are built around
agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions,
the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the
implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What
we are really hiring for is judgement over output you did not write by hand :
knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not
move when the tooling did.

Shape Up, and you own what you take. Roughly three weeks of building, then a
week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a betting table. We are small enough that
an area becomes yours quickly — you make the calls inside it and you answer for
how it turns out. We hand out problems, not the steps that solve them.

Remote first, with most of the team in Europe and everyone together in person at
least twice a year. Significant technical decisions get written down, and a
green build is never on its own enough to merge.

Requirements 

You'll thrive here if you have…

- Senior full-stack experience — you have owned features from the browser to
the machine they run on.
- A track record of taking something and running with it — a domain, a
migration, a subsystem you took on, decided and stayed accountable for.
- Taste. You can tell a good design from a merely plausible one, and you
will reject work that functions but is not right — your own, and an agent's.
- React beyond the client — server rendering, static generation, data
loading and hydration; you know what runs where and why it matters.
- TypeScript at strict — typed boundaries, and an instinct for when types
are carrying real weight.
- Infrastructure as code — Pulumi ideally; Terraform if you are ready to
pick up Pulumi.
- Containers and Linux in production — not writing a Dockerfile, but
debugging a service on a machine you have to SSH into.
- Postgres beyond queries — backup and restore, migrations, what a schema
change does under load.
- Wholehearted LLM-assisted development — you use coding agents daily, have
opinions about steering them, and review their output as critically as a
colleague's.
- Integration instincts — third-party APIs, webhooks, OAuth/OIDC, and
patience for other people's undocumented edge cases.
- A working day that overlaps ours : based within CET ±3.
- Fluent in English, our working language.

Nice to have 

- Identity and API gateways in depth — Keycloak, OIDC, SAML brokering, APISIX.
- Compliance from the inside — an ISO 27001 certification lived through, or GDPR
beyond a cookie banner.
- Payment systems, billing models, or PSP integrations.
- Observability and alerting — Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent.
- Experience in the maritime, logistics or freight industry.
- Familiarity with emissions accounting frameworks (GHG Protocol, GLEC, EU
ETS..).
Benefits 

As part of our team, you will:

- 🌱 Have a chance to re-shape the future of climate in the logistics.
- 👩‍💻 Be empowered to deliver your best work remotely, and get a stipend to set
you up.
- 🏄‍♂️ Have a flat hierarchy, where you will have direct access to the founders
and won't be tied up in politics.
- 🎓 Have a high degree of learning and ownership in a dynamic environment.
- 🏝 Take part in our team-building events.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Tekkr FDE Network
description:
Join the Tekkr FDE Network, where Europe's top Forward Deployed Engineers meet the top 1% of AI startups, like Parloa and Zauber. 

This isn't a job at a single company. You join a curated network that matches FDEs with Europe's best AI startups: startups that sell to enterprises and have real customer deployments in progress. Once you pass our assessments, you get a head start in the application process with our partner startups.

Find out more about the Tekkr FDE Network: https://www.tekkr.io/fde-network

What you get as a member 

- A head start in the hiring process at our partner startups, which receive your assessment score and reviewer notes

- Support on hiring process at top AI companies

- All of it is free for you. Startups pay a fee only when they hire.

What FDEs do at our partner startups 

- Own a deployment end to end, from scoping to go-live

- Run discovery: gather requirements and turn business needs into technical requirements

- Work directly with the customer's engineers

- Write production code, build integrations with enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, ticketing, transport management, data systems) and design the solution architecture

- Explain technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives

- Feed learnings from the field back into product, and build reusable patterns, tools and playbooks from individual deployments

What we look for 

- Engineering: you ship production-quality code fast, work with APIs, databases and cloud platforms, and debug production issues under time pressure. Typical languages: Python, TypeScript.

- Customer judgment: you turn a vague request into a scoped problem, and you know when to say no

- Communication: you explain technical trade-offs clearly, in writing and live

- Ownership: you have a track record of driving outcomes end to end, not just contributing, and you operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

- Track record: outlier achievements, such as shipped products or top performance anywhere

Nice to have 

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI agents (retrieval, evals, prompt engineering, tool use)

- A product background

What the process looks like 

1. Apply: fill in our application form

2. Screening: get invited to a screening with our senior FDE experts or our AI evaluator.

3. Fast-tracked interviews: if you're in, you get support and fast-tracked access to the interview processes at our partner startups. Each startup runs its own hiring process.

4. Not hired? You're still part of the network. You can get fast-tracked access again, or support to improve your odds.

What you should know 

- Every applicant goes through our assessments. Only the top 1% of applicants join the Tekkr FDE Network

- Contract details, such as: probation period, start date and annual leave may vary depending on the role we decide fits you best. These details will be given to you later on

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Projektmanagment
description:
Du willst im Studentenjob nicht Kaffee kochen und Listen abtippen, sondern an echten Projekten und an einem System arbeiten, das danach dauerhaft anders läuft? Dann lies weiter. 

Wir sind neaSOL , ein junges, wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Photovoltaik. Wir bauen Photovoltaikanlagen, Speicher, Wallboxen und Energiemanagement – sauber, schnell und auf höchstem technischen Niveau. Und das ist nicht nur so dahingesagt: Von GoodWe , einem der führenden Hersteller weltweit, wurden wir als digitalste und schnellste Firma des Herstellers ausgezeichnet. 

Genau da setzt deine Rolle an. Du arbeitest direkt an der Seite unseres Projektmanagers : Ihr geht Projekte gemeinsam durch, prüft sie auf Vollständigkeit, Termine und Wirtschaftlichkeit – und du sorgst dafür, dass nichts durchrutscht. Parallel treibst du unser zweites großes Thema voran: unser Warenwirtschaftssystem auf Automatisierungsniveau zu heben . Bestände, Beschaffung, Materialflüsse und Projektzuordnung sollen künftig KI-gestützt und weitgehend automatisch laufen statt manuell gepflegt zu werden. 

Kurz gesagt: Du behandelst nicht nur die einzelnen Projekte – du behandelst die Warenwirtschaft selbst als Projekt . Wer bei uns Einblick will, wie ein Betrieb Schritt für Schritt KI-basiert aufgestellt wird, bekommt ihn hier aus der ersten Reihe.

Aufgaben

- Projektbegleitung: Du unterstützt unseren Projektmanager im Tagesgeschäft – von der Auftragsübergabe über die Terminierung bis zur Fertigmeldung.

- Projektprüfung: Du gehst laufende Projekte gemeinsam mit ihm durch: Sind alle Unterlagen da? Stimmen Material, Termine und Kalkulation? Wo hakt es – und warum?

- Warenwirtschaft automatisieren: Du analysierst, wie unsere Warenwirtschaft heute läuft, findest die manuellen Bremsklötze und baust mit uns den Weg zur Automatisierung.

- KI & Tools einsetzen: Du testest und implementierst KI-gestützte Lösungen und Schnittstellen – von automatisierten Bestandsabgleichen bis zu Auswertungen, die vorher niemand hatte.

- Prozesse dokumentieren: Du hältst Abläufe sauber fest, damit aus Wissen im Kopf ein System wird, das auch ohne dich funktioniert.

- Auswertungen & Reporting: Du bereitest Zahlen so auf, dass Projektmanagement und Geschäftsführung schnell entscheiden können.

- Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und verbindlich – wenn du etwas zusagst, kommt es auch.

- Du hast ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit gerne mehr) und willst länger als ein Semester bleiben.

Kein Muss: Vorkenntnisse in Photovoltaik. Die Technik bringen wir dir bei – Kopf und Motivation bringst du mit.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten 

- Ein echtes Projekt statt Hilfsjob: Die Automatisierung unserer Warenwirtschaft ist deins – mit Verantwortung, Budgetgesprächen und sichtbarem Ergebnis.

- Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Projektmanagement und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen dauern bei uns keine Wochen.

- Einblick in einen KI-getriebenen Betrieb: Wir stellen unser Unternehmen von Lead bis Rechnung konsequent digital und automatisiert auf. Du bist mittendrin, nicht in der Theorievorlesung.

- Ausgezeichnetes Umfeld: von GoodWe als digitalste und schnellste Firma des Herstellers ausgezeichnet.

- Familiäres, dynamisches Team , das anpackt – inklusive gemeinsamer Team-Events.

- Perspektive: Wer bei uns liefert, dem machen wir nach dem Studium gerne ein Angebot.

Wenn du als Werkstudent Lust hast, diese Einblicke bei uns zu bekommen – melde dich einfach. 

Bewirb dich unkompliziert über Join. Ein Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Sätze dazu, warum dich das Thema reizt, reichen uns fürs Erste völlig. Zeugnisse und Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Den Rest besprechen wir persönlich.

Transforming factory scans into digital reality

At RIIICO, we're reimagining how factories adapt to change. Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts. 

We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D. 

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline.

- Basic digital literacy: you're confident navigating structured software tools, browser-based interfaces and Microsoft Office. 

- Bonus: Familiarity with 3D environments (e.g., through gaming, CAD, or similar), or a general spatial intuition. 

- English is a must; proficiency in German is a plus for clear communication with the team. 

- Please note: A valid work permit or residence permit for Germany is required for this position. 

This is a 12-month fixed-term position, with the opportunity to extend or move to a permanent contract based on performance and business development.

- Public transport subsidy 

Why You Should Join 

- Build something that makes a tangible difference in the world's most important sector: manufacturing.

- Backed by top international investors and preparing to scale.

title: Senior C++ Performance Engineer (all genders)
description:
About the role 

At Agile Robots, we build powerful software frameworks to orchestrate complex robotic systems and solve challenging tasks. The solutions are sold to various international customers to enable them to control their robotic work cells. Smooth integration and scalable deployment are key goals. 

AgileCore is meant to be a scalable platform that supports multiple projects in parallel. That only works if the platform underneath scales with it - if it stays fast, thread-safe, and diagnosable as projects, devices, and operating conditions multiply. 

We are looking for a Senior C++ Performance Engineer to join our AgileCore Runtime core team. This is a T-shaped role in a small senior team: you are a full member of the core team first - contributing to the Runtime, reviewing contributions from the teams that build on our platform, and sharing our support and release duties - and within the team, you own the performance and stability practice as your specialization. 

On the specialization side, you will drive the performance of the Runtime core - the Blackboard, the Behavior Engine and the execution paths beneath them - make the system provably thread-safe under load, and make failures in the field fast to diagnose. You own the practice: the methodology, the tooling, the benchmarks, the audits and the education. You work hand in hand with the platform architect, who owns the performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts at the architecture level - you turn those budgets into measured, enforced reality and shape them with your findings. You set the standard for performance, concurrency and troubleshooting, and raise the team's ability to meet it without slowing feature development down. This is a shipping role, not a research role: success is measured in merged improvements, closed field escalations and green regression gates - not in microbenchmark leaderboards. We optimize to the budget the product needs, not to zero. 

Why this role 

- Greenfield performance infrastructure: the benchmark suites, budgets and CI regression gates are yours to build, not inherit 

- A measurable, physical problem: your profiling and your benchmarks run against real robots on our hardware-in-the-loop rigs - where third-party plugins meet 1 kHz vendor control loops 

- A small senior core team with real ownership: your work becomes the standard the whole platform builds on 

Your Responsibilities:

title: Corporate Development Director
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

As the Corporate Development Director, you'll help influence how GitLab invests to win: what we build, what we buy, where we partner, and what we should not pursue. This role sits within the Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships.

This role straddles strategy and M&A engagements. You'll lead research that frames GitLab's options: mapping the markets in and around our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, testing where we have a right to win, and turning that into clear recommendations for the executive team. When the answer is to acquire, you'll drive the deal process end to end, from outreach through close and integration.

Success here is not measured by deal count. It looks like sharper strategic choices: a well-reasoned point of view on our priority markets, investment theses that product and executive leaders rely on, acquisitions that speed up the roadmap when buying is the right answer, and an educated no when it isn't. You'll own the wider market perspective rather than individual product categories, and work with the team's Analyst on the research behind it.

What you'll do

Strategy and research

- Own the wider market view. Research the broader market GitLab competes in, beyond specific product categories: competitive dynamics, AI-native entrants, technology shifts and where value is moving. Collaborate with the team's Analyst on the research and turn the findings into a clear point of view on where GitLab should play.

- Build an investment thesis for each focus area. Work with Product and Engineering leaders to define the problems worth solving, the capabilities GitLab needs, and what it would cost in time and money to get there on our own.

- Own the competitive and landscape view. Maintain market maps and a current read on GitLab's competitors: their strategy, product direction, positioning, pricing, and M&A and funding activity. Produce competitor analyses that show where we lead, where we're exposed and how rivals are likely to move. Flag shifts by competitors, hyperscalers and AI labs that change our options, and bring the implications to Product and the executive team.

- Define where GitLab should not play. Identify adjacencies that dilute focus and markets where the economics or competition work against us. Make the case for a no with the same rigor as a yes.

Build, buy or partner

- Run the build, buy, partner analysis. For each strategic gap, compare the options side by side on speed, cost, risk, control and strategic fit, and bring a clear recommendation.

- Deliver strategic clarity to executives and the Board. Produce short strategy memos/decks and business cases that set out the decision, the trade-offs and what we give up with each path.

- Feed company strategy and planning. Bring an outside-in view of the market and the inorganic options available into annual and long-range planning.

- Work hand in hand with Strategic Partnerships. When partnering is the right answer, frame the opportunity and hand it to the partnership owner with a clear thesis. When it isn't, explain why.

Deal execution and integration

- Own end-to-end deal process management. Validate target fit against GitLab's our target profile, product roadmap and other criteria, and build the acquisition rationale and business case. Drive our M&A process from intro call through the various steps through to closing and integration.

- Evaluate the deal. Develop valuation, commercial integrity assessment, impact on GitLab's business and provide negotiations assistance to the VP and the executive team.

- Lead cross-functional diligence. Run pre-LOI validation and diligence across Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, Legal and People, and communicate findings clearly.

- Drive deal documents with Legal. Prepare NDAs, LOIs and purchase agreements with GitLab Legal and outside counsel.

- Own integration outcomes. Lead post-acquisition integration as the DRI, measured against the roadmap and business goals in the business case. Bring lessons learned back into the strategy work.

- Build the external network. Maintain relationships with founders, executives, investors, bankers and advisors that bring us early insight and pipeline.

What you'll bring

- Strategy and deal experience. 8+ years across corporate development, corporate strategy, strategy consulting or technology investing, including 5+ years leading acquisitions end to end in enterprise software.

- Structured strategic thinking. You form a point of view from incomplete information, test it against data, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You're as comfortable recommending that we stay out of a market as that we enter it.

- Market research depth. Skilled in market sizing, competitive analysis and landscape mapping, and in turning research into a recommendation, not a report.

- Deal craft. Skilled in valuation, financial modeling, deal structuring, negotiation and integration planning, with experience across varied consideration structures.

- Technical fluency. A working understanding of software development, DevSecOps and the AI landscape, enough to hold substantive conversations with product and engineering leaders about roadmaps and architecture.

- Clear executive communication. You write short, decision-ready updates and present trade-offs plainly to executives and the Board, in an async-first environment.

- Influence without authority. You build trust across Product, Engineering, Finance and Legal and move decisions forward across functions.

- Ownership with collaboration. You own the strategic view and the recommendation, and partner closely with the team's Analyst on research and analysis.

- Preferred: familiarity with the DevSecOps, security, AI and open source ecosystems.

- You value the all remote lifestyle and share our values .

About the team

The Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team helps GitLab decide how to grow beyond what we build on our own. We own inorganic strategy: acquisitions, strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and AI labs, and the research that tells us which to pursue and which to pass on.

We work across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and the executive group. We set direction and do the detailed work ourselves, with a high degree of ownership and transparency in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

- Flexible Paid Time Off

- Growth and Development Fund 

- Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: 

You will join a high-performing sales team within the DACH sales organization, responsible for driving growth within large global enterprises from the Transportation & Logistics industry, including rail, ocean shipping and contract logistics. Transportation & Logistics is one of our strategic industries, where we help global leaders optimize their end-to-end processes, increase operational efficiency through our Process Intelligence platform, and provide the contextual layer to industrialize Enterprise AI.

The Role: 

Applying a value-driven consultative sales approach, you will create and cultivate strategic relationships to drive sales cycles from deep discovery to value realization. You will be responsible for a selected portfolio of strategic accounts from the Transportation & Logistics industry in the DACH region, generating new business opportunities with existing customers. Navigating complex organizations up to the C-suite, you will collaborate cross-functionally to understand your accounts' needs and systematically drive the end-to-end sales cycle to a successful close.

The Work you'll do: 

- Manage your accounts from an existing customer perspective. Land-and-expand is the typical model.

- Engage across lines of business, at C-level and below.

- Drive Celonis Process Intelligence sales motions across the logistics value chain and translate customer challenges into compelling, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact.

- Hold an individual revenue target for closing six- to seven-figure deals within your accounts.

- Navigate complex procurement and tender processes.

- Engage closely with partners, e.g. consulting firms and SaaS vendors.

- Drive complex sales cycles by orchestrating virtual teams: business development representatives, marketing managers, partner managers, value engineers, sales engineers / pre-sales, customer success managers, professional services and implementation partners.

The Qualifications you need: 

- 8+ years of relevant experience in either one, or ideally both, of the following domains:

- Management / AI Consulting: experience in a consultancy, ideally in a transportation, logistics or travel practice, with direct responsibility for client relationships and business development, including your own sales target and sourcing new projects.

- Enterprise Software Sales: a proven track record of applying a consultative sales approach to sell complex, strategic business solutions to large enterprise accounts with full account ownership, ideally at a hyperscaler or leading SaaS company.

- A proven track record of commitment, long tenure and successful career progression with your previous companies.

- Strong business acumen and a deep understanding of how transportation and logistics companies operate, with familiarity with their core processes and KPIs, particularly within Supply Chain and Finance.

- Familiarity with the different industry players (3PL, contract logistics, freight forwarding, rail) and experience in addressing their key challenges: supply chain volatility and resilience, cost pressure (e.g. from manual document handling such as customs and air waybills), and punctuality.

- Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior Business and IT stakeholders and engage effectively at the C-level (CEO, CFO, CIO, COO, Head of Operations).

- Experience with complex tender processes is a strong plus.

- Grit, a hands-on mindset, and strong discovery and sales process leadership.

- Fluency in German and English, with exceptional communication and presentation skills.

- Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset.

- Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins

The Team:

Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business.

Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions.

The police are one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. Police officers spend a large proportion of their time on data work and comparatively little on the actual investigation. We want to turn that around. With our new police solution, Metropolis, we help police authorities connect and make sense of their data, so that officers can focus on what matters most: solving cases and keeping people safe .

To address this, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Police .

The Role:

This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows police work from the inside: how investigations really run, where time is lost in data work, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships with police authorities at federal and state level and position Celonis as a long-term partner for their digital transformation.

Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and public IT service providers.

- 
Represent Celonis at public sector events, conferences and police-specific forums.

- 
Several years of professional experience within the German police (federal or state level), ideally in a leadership role and/or in an area close to investigations, criminal analysis, IT, digitalization or organizational development.

A solid network within the police landscape and a deep understanding of how police authorities and Interior Ministries are organized, how decisions are made and how budgets are planned.

-

Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and very good English.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.

Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo’s operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.

It’s an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you’ll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we’d expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It’s especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.

What you’ll be doing

- Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.

- Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture : improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast.

- Product and Planning: Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner.

- Supporting Engineering Excellence : Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.

- Long-Term Thinking: Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform.

- Agentic Development: Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship.

- AI Fluency: Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes.

📍This role can be based in our Berlin tech hub. Read more about our hybrid setup here .

Feel free to check out the Wolt Tech Blog for more insight into our culture and technology.

Our humble expectations 

- Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React.

- Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure.

- Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows.

- Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases.

- Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.

- Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams.

- Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs.

Nice to Haves

- Experience with micro-frontend architecture.

- Frontend platform engineering experience.

- Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams.

- Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads.

- Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE).

- Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code).

What’s in it for you 

- Impact: Build and shape the platform that thousands of people depend on.

- Scale: Work on real platform problems behind 250+ MFEs with hundreds of monthly contributors.

- Collaboration: Partner with talented engineers, designers, and operators across companies to make their daily work faster and better.

- Growth: Take on deep technical challenges across frontend architecture, agentic development, DX, and improving engineering efficiency.

- Culture: Be part of a diverse, open-minded team that values creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Product Designer - POS
description:
About the team

SumUp's Point of Sale (POS) solution helps cafes, shops, bars, hair salons, and thousands of other businesses manage their day-to-day operations. Alongside the POS experience, merchants rely on powerful reporting, sales management, and fiscalisation tools to understand their business, stay compliant, and operate with confidence.

This role would own these three domains from a design perspective - Reporting, Sales, and Fiscalisation. You'll design the experiences merchants use to analyse performance, manage sales activity, and navigate local fiscal requirements, while helping shape a more unified reporting experience across SumUp's payments, banking, and commerce products.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and data teams within POS, and collaborate with designers and stakeholders across SumUp to deliver experiences that are clear, trustworthy, and built to scale.

🎬 Take a look at our Berlin office 

What you'll do

title: Engineering Manager
description:
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a Product Engineering team in our Automation Domain in Berlin.

The Automation Domain is responsible for building and owning Nelly’s SaaS and AI products - everything from onboarding new medical practices, the Doctor, Patient, and Back Office portals, to automating bureaucracy and practice workflows, and the AI Scribe, Billing Agent, and Treatment Plan generation products.

The role 

You'll lead a fast moving AI enabled team that is building a new, but central, product. You’ll ensure the team is able to explore, experiment, and iterate quickly - testing new features and ideas internally and with our customers.

The product is new, giving you the opportunity to define the product with the team based on experimentation. The team needs to learn fast and be able to let go of ideas that don’t work. You’ll guide the team through this process, striving to improve how the team operates and enabling it to move faster.

The team is growing quickly, giving you an opportunity and responsibility to hiring a high performing team and define how it operates.

About Nelly 

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

What you'll do 

- Lead, inspire and grow a high-performing team of 3–6 software and AI engineers.

- Collaborate closely with a product manager to iteratively build, launch, and improve new products

- Own hiring for your team, building a team of high performing engineers.

- Keep your team at the cutting edge of LLM and AI based engineering, testing new ideas and tech as it’s released

- Own the quality, reliability, and security of your team’s products. Delivering high availability production systems

What we're looking for 

- 1+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and 8+ years of overall experience in software development

- Experience with cloud native development.

- Experience designing, building, and owning customer facing products and production back-end systems

- A deep understanding of software engineering processes and team management

title: AI-Enabled Governance Associate (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋 

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission 

As our AI-Enabled Governance Associate, you will help strengthen how lemon.markets runs and improves governance processes across third-party management, partner oversight, and operational controls in a regulated environment.

This role starts with a strong focus on third-party-related governance, including external providers, partners, and intra-group relationships. Over time, the scope can evolve further toward governance excellence, KPI/SLA monitoring, control effectiveness, and AI-supported process improvement.

A core part of this role is to help us use AI and automation in a practical way across recurring governance workflows. This includes identifying repetitive manual work, improving how information is collected and assessed, making documentation and reporting more efficient, and helping turn process-heavy governance tasks into more scalable operating routines.

In this role you will: 

- Support and improve governance processes related to third parties, partners, and operational oversight in a regulated environment.

- Identify repetitive manual work and fragmented workflows, and improve them through better process design, standardisation, AI-supported execution, and selective automation.

- Use AI tools in a practical way to support analysis, information structuring, questionnaire handling, documentation drafting, summarisation, reporting support, and follow-up preparation.

- Work with internal subject-matter experts to better understand, improve, and scale KPI, SLA, and monitoring approaches across both internal services and third-party services.

- Help optimise KPI monitoring, service reporting, and governance transparency so operational performance becomes more measurable, decision-useful, and actionable.

- Contribute to making recurring governance work more scalable, consistent, and less manual over time.

- Support governance routines such as reviews, reporting, meeting preparation, action tracking, and evidence collection.

- Support assessments, reviews, and due diligence processes for new and existing providers or partners.

- Support governance documentation, registers, supporting evidence, and process transparency for internal stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and relevant partners.

You’ll be successful in this role if you: 

- Are excited to learn how governance, controls, third-party processes, and operational oversight work in practic and the can be optimized,

- Have strong analytical skills and are comfortable structuring information, spotting gaps, and turning observations into practical next steps.

- Work in a structured, reliable, and detail-oriented way, with strong follow-up discipline.

- Bring a pragmatic, hands-on mindset and enjoy improving recurring processes rather than only designing concepts.

- Are comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work and are curious about how they can help make operational and governance processes more efficient.

- Are motivated by the idea of reducing manual work through better workflows, smarter tooling, and selective automation.

- Have enough technical affinity to understand IT services, service levels, incidents, monitoring concepts, and operational dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

- Communicate clearly in English and enjoy working with different stakeholders across business, technology, and control functions. German is a plus.

How we take care of you: 

- 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

- 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

- 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

- 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

- 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

- 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

- 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

About 8returns

Every online shop has returns. Most treat them as a cost. We help brands turn them into a better customer experience, more exchanges instead of refunds, and less work for their teams.

What you bring

- Native-level German, written and spoken. You'll write most of our content in German. Fluent English on top.

description:
IHR START BEI PRAXISEINS. 

Sie haben Medizin studiert, um Patienten zu behandeln und nicht um Formulare auszufüllen, KV-Anfragen zu beantworten und IT-Ausfälle zu managen? Bei PraxisEins haben Sie ein Team hinter sich, das sich darum kümmert. Damit Sie wieder das tun können, wofür Sie angetreten sind – ganz ohne Nacht- und Wochenenddienste. 

Für unser modernes Hausarztzentrum suchen wir ab sofort einen Facharzt für Allgemeinmedizin und/oder Innere Medizin (m/w/d). 

Als inhabergeführter und staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger hat PraxisEins es sich zum Ziel gemacht, die hausärztliche Versorgung zu sichern und dabei Qualitätsmedizin zu ermöglichen! 

In unseren modernen Hausarztzentren können Sie sich ganz auf die Medizin konzentrieren. Wir legen Wert auf moderne Diagnostik, digitalisierte Abläufe, ärztliche Fortbildung, ein gutes Teamgefüge und ärztlichen Austausch im Team. 

WAS WIR IHNEN BIETEN: 

- Medizin im Mittelpunkt: Sie fokussieren sich auf die Behandlung Ihrer Patienten – den Rest übernehmen wir! 

- Qualitätsmedizin: Unsere Standorte verfügen über modernste Diagnostik und digitalisierte Praxisabläufe; ein kollegialer Austausch ist uns wichtig 

- Attraktive Vergütung und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Sie erhalten ein übertarifliches Gehalt - bei sehr guter Leistung bietet sich in unserer Gruppe die Möglichkeit des Aufstiegs zur ärztlichen Leitung mit einem attraktiven Partnerschaftsmodell

- Strukturierte Fortbildung: Mit den organisierten Qualitätszirkeln unserer PraxisEins-Akademie bieten wir Ihnen leitlinienkonforme interne Fortbildungen 

- Lebenslanges Lernen: Fortbildungstage und eine finanzielle Förderung für ärztliche Fortbildungen sind bei uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit 

- Vereinbarkeit mit der Familie: Keine Pflicht-Dienste und 35 Tage Urlaub (inkl. Fortbildungstagen) - zudem bestehen Möglichkeiten für Teilzeitmodelle und (bei Interesse) Videosprechstunden im Home-Office 

IHRE AUFGABEN: 

- Sie fokussieren sich auf die Patientenversorgung und bringen sich als Teil des Praxisteams ein 

IHR PROFIL: 

- Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Facharztausbildung der Allgemeinmedizin oder Inneren Medizin 

- Sie konnten (idealerweise) erste Erfahrungen im niedergelassenen Bereich sammeln 

- Sie haben (idealerweise) bereits hausärztlich relevante Fortbildungen oder Zusatzbezeichnungen absolviert (z.B. Psychosomatische Grundversorgung, Diabetologie, Hypertensiologie, Palliativmedizin) 

Über PraxisEins 

PraxisEins ist ein staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger mit einem Fokus auf den Bereichen der hausärztlichen Versorgung, Diabetologie und Schmerztherapie.

Unsere Mission 

Versorgung sichern - Qualitätsmedizin gewährleisten. Als PraxisEins wollen wir die Primärversorgung zukunftsfähig machen – mit digitaler Unterstützung, klaren Prozessen und einem Umfeld, in dem Ärztinnen und Ärzte Medizin wieder mit Freude ausüben können!

PraxisEins ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt schätzt. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen und bearbeiten diese völlig unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religionszugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behindertenstatus. Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet.
