GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

As the Corporate Development Director, you'll help influence how GitLab invests to win: what we build, what we buy, where we partner, and what we should not pursue. This role sits within the Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships.

This role straddles strategy and M&A engagements. You'll lead research that frames GitLab's options: mapping the markets in and around our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, testing where we have a right to win, and turning that into clear recommendations for the executive team. When the answer is to acquire, you'll drive the deal process end to end, from outreach through close and integration.

Success here is not measured by deal count. It looks like sharper strategic choices: a well-reasoned point of view on our priority markets, investment theses that product and executive leaders rely on, acquisitions that speed up the roadmap when buying is the right answer, and an educated no when it isn't. You'll own the wider market perspective rather than individual product categories, and work with the team's Analyst on the research behind it.

What you'll do

Strategy and research

- Own the wider market view. Research the broader market GitLab competes in, beyond specific product categories: competitive dynamics, AI-native entrants, technology shifts and where value is moving. Collaborate with the team's Analyst on the research and turn the findings into a clear point of view on where GitLab should play.

- Build an investment thesis for each focus area. Work with Product and Engineering leaders to define the problems worth solving, the capabilities GitLab needs, and what it would cost in time and money to get there on our own.

- Own the competitive and landscape view. Maintain market maps and a current read on GitLab's competitors: their strategy, product direction, positioning, pricing, and M&A and funding activity. Produce competitor analyses that show where we lead, where we're exposed and how rivals are likely to move. Flag shifts by competitors, hyperscalers and AI labs that change our options, and bring the implications to Product and the executive team.

- Define where GitLab should not play. Identify adjacencies that dilute focus and markets where the economics or competition work against us. Make the case for a no with the same rigor as a yes.

Build, buy or partner

- Run the build, buy, partner analysis. For each strategic gap, compare the options side by side on speed, cost, risk, control and strategic fit, and bring a clear recommendation.

- Deliver strategic clarity to executives and the Board. Produce short strategy memos/decks and business cases that set out the decision, the trade-offs and what we give up with each path.

- Feed company strategy and planning. Bring an outside-in view of the market and the inorganic options available into annual and long-range planning.

- Work hand in hand with Strategic Partnerships. When partnering is the right answer, frame the opportunity and hand it to the partnership owner with a clear thesis. When it isn't, explain why.

Deal execution and integration

- Own end-to-end deal process management. Validate target fit against GitLab's our target profile, product roadmap and other criteria, and build the acquisition rationale and business case. Drive our M&A process from intro call through the various steps through to closing and integration.

- Evaluate the deal. Develop valuation, commercial integrity assessment, impact on GitLab's business and provide negotiations assistance to the VP and the executive team.

- Lead cross-functional diligence. Run pre-LOI validation and diligence across Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, Legal and People, and communicate findings clearly.

- Drive deal documents with Legal. Prepare NDAs, LOIs and purchase agreements with GitLab Legal and outside counsel.

- Own integration outcomes. Lead post-acquisition integration as the DRI, measured against the roadmap and business goals in the business case. Bring lessons learned back into the strategy work.

- Build the external network. Maintain relationships with founders, executives, investors, bankers and advisors that bring us early insight and pipeline.

What you'll bring

- Strategy and deal experience. 8+ years across corporate development, corporate strategy, strategy consulting or technology investing, including 5+ years leading acquisitions end to end in enterprise software.

- Structured strategic thinking. You form a point of view from incomplete information, test it against data, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You're as comfortable recommending that we stay out of a market as that we enter it.

- Market research depth. Skilled in market sizing, competitive analysis and landscape mapping, and in turning research into a recommendation, not a report.

- Deal craft. Skilled in valuation, financial modeling, deal structuring, negotiation and integration planning, with experience across varied consideration structures.

- Technical fluency. A working understanding of software development, DevSecOps and the AI landscape, enough to hold substantive conversations with product and engineering leaders about roadmaps and architecture.

- Clear executive communication. You write short, decision-ready updates and present trade-offs plainly to executives and the Board, in an async-first environment.

- Influence without authority. You build trust across Product, Engineering, Finance and Legal and move decisions forward across functions.

- Ownership with collaboration. You own the strategic view and the recommendation, and partner closely with the team's Analyst on research and analysis.

- Preferred: familiarity with the DevSecOps, security, AI and open source ecosystems.

- You value the all remote lifestyle and share our values .

About the team

The Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team helps GitLab decide how to grow beyond what we build on our own. We own inorganic strategy: acquisitions, strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and AI labs, and the research that tells us which to pursue and which to pass on.

We work across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and the executive group. We set direction and do the detailed work ourselves, with a high degree of ownership and transparency in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

title: Customer Success Manager, Southern Europe
description:
About Anthropic 

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du poste 

Rejoignez l'équipe Customer Success d'Anthropic en tant que Customer Success Manager basé(e) dans la région EMEA, alors que nous façonnons l'avenir de l'adoption de l'IA en entreprise. En tant que Customer Success Manager chez Anthropic, vous serez partenaire stratégique et conseiller de confiance de nos clients les plus complexes dans la zone EMEA, les aidant à exploiter pleinement le potentiel de toutes nos fonctionnalités Claude : API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code.

Vous développerez de véritables partenariats avec les clients, acquérant une compréhension approfondie de leurs objectifs commerciaux, de leur orientation stratégique, de leur vision en IA et de leurs besoins techniques. Vous ferez appel à la fois à votre sens des affaires et à votre expertise technique pour agir comme conseiller stratégique tout au long de leur parcours chez nous.

En partenariat avec l'ensemble de l'équipe chargée des comptes, vous aiderez les clients à identifier les fonctionnalités Claude les mieux adaptées à leurs objectifs commerciaux spécifiques, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec eux pour leur fournir les meilleures pratiques et des conseils, tout en les aidant dans la croissance et l'évolution de leur utilisation (consommation et base) sur le siège.

Votre rôle consiste à aider les clients à adapter efficacement leur utilisation, à mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement, à optimiser les cas d'utilisation et à maximiser la valeur de leur investissement en élargissant les cas d'utilisation à l'ensemble de leur organisation. Les informations que vous recueillerez auprès de vos clients serviront directement à définir nos priorités en matière de recherche, de développement et

de stratégies de commercialisation, vous permettant de jouer un rôle clé dans la manière dont nous créons et fournissons de la valeur en continu en tant qu'entreprise.

En tant que l'un de nos premiers CSM dans la région EMEA, vous serez une pionnière en aidant à mettre en place des processus régionaux, à établir de nouvelles relations avec les clients et en représentant la marque Anthropic dans un

marché en forte croissance. Vous travaillerez avec une grande autonomie tout en maintenant un alignement fort avec les équipes mondiales, ce qui requiert une personne qui s'épanouit dans des environnements ambigus et peut travailler efficacement dans différents fuseaux horaires.

Responsabilités : 

- Établir des relations de confiance et stratégiques avec les décideurs clés des clients EMEA afin de comprendre leurs activités et leurs objectifs, en identifiant des opportunités d'optimisation et d'expansion

- Devenir expert des produits Anthropic via API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code, en comprenant les nuances techniques et les meilleures pratiques de chacun afin d'orienter les clients vers les bonnes solutions

- Tirer parti de votre connaissance approfondie du client et des spécificités régionales pour piloter de manière proactive la planification de l'utilisation, en cernant les tendances actuelles et futures en matière de consommation et d'adoption, ainsi que la manière dont celles-ci se traduisent en valeur ajoutée pour le client

- Surveiller les schémas d'utilisation et identifiez les opportunités d'optimisation, en traitant de manière proactive la sous-utilisation des produits basés sur la consommation (API) et par abonnement (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) pour tirer pleinement parti des engagements contractuels

- Jouer le rôle de partenaire stratégique auprès des clients, en enrichissant leur connaissance des produits Claude grâce à la diffusion de la feuille de route des produits d'Anthropic, en faisant connaître les nouveaux produits et en impliquant les chefs de produit pour qu'ils se fassent le porte-parole des clients de la région EMEA

- Documenter et quantifier la valeur client réalisée grâce aux résultats commerciaux, au ROI et aux indicateurs d'impact afin de constituer des arguments commerciaux internes convaincants en vue de poursuivre et d'accroître les investissements

- Identifier les cas d'utilisation potentiels et les secteurs d'activité qui ne sont pas encore exploités, en collaborant avec les clients pour découvrir de nouvelles applications pour Claude au sein des différents services, équipes et flux de travail

- Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement pour favoriser l'adoption par les utilisateurs finaux et maximiser la valeur au sein des organisations clientes, y compris des programmes de formation des formateurs, le développement de centres d'excellence et l'accompagnement organisationnel

- Gérer l'expérience client tout au long de son cycle de vie : gérer des comptes complets et des plans de réussite fondés sur les objectifs commerciaux du client, réaliser des bilans commerciaux trimestriels et servir de principal intermédiaire entre le client et Anthropic

- Contribuer au développement de la marque Anthropic et des relations avec la clientèle en tant que membre de la première équipe de service client de la région, en élaborant, si nécessaire, des processus, des guides opérationnels et des bonnes pratiques adaptés à la zone EMEA et tenant compte des cultures d'entreprise régionales

Profil recherché : 

- Vous avez plus de 6 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions en contact avec la clientèle (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/ Functional Consultant, Success Engineer ou similaire)

- Expérience avérée en matière de réussite dans les modèles commerciaux basés sur la consommation et sur la location de places, avec une bonne compréhension des différents leviers de croissance et des indicateurs de performance associés

- Maîtrise technique et capacité à comprendre et à articuler les concepts d'IA/ML, les intégrations d'API et les modèles de mise en œuvre logicielle

- Expérience dans la présentation et la démonstration de produits techniques auprès de publics variés

- Mentalité stratégique pour identifier les opportunités de croissance et les traduire en plans d'expansion concrets

- Collaborateur polyvalent qui représente le client avec positivité et proactivité, en mobilisant l'ensemble de l'équipe autour de solutions permettant de répondre aux besoins du client

- Solides compétences en gestion de projet et capacité à gérer plusieurs relations clients

- Passion pour l'IA et intérêt pour le développement responsable de systèmes avancés

- Acquérir de l'expérience en travaillant et en contribuant au développement d'une région en pleine croissance, tout en jonglant avec les fuseaux horaires depuis le siège social situé aux États-Unis

- Un talent pour mettre de l'ordre dans le chaos et une mentalité enthousiaste de « retrousser ses manches ». Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe

- (Bonus) Maîtrise du français, de l'allemand, de l'espagnol ou de l'italien

title: Quantum Applications Engineer
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 

Description of the Project 

As a Quantum Applications Engineer , you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects .

Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured.

Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods.

This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research.

Your Key Responsibilities 

- Identify and assess quantum use cases by working with customers, industrial partners and internal teams to understand their challenges and translate them into relevant computational problems.
- Perform feasibility studies to determine whether and how these problems can be addressed using current and near-term quantum computing technologies, with a particular focus on NISQ approaches.
- Define meaningful benchmarks , including relevant problem instances, expected outputs, accuracy targets and classical baselines to objectively evaluate quantum approaches.
- Explore promising application domains and contribute to application roadmaps, from near-term demonstrations to longer-term utility-scale applications.
- Evaluate scientific, industrial and economic value to help prioritize the applications where quantum computing can have the greatest impact.
- Design and maintain strategic demonstrations and Proofs of Concept , working with internal teams or external software partners depending on the project.
- Follow customer projects throughout their lifecycle , including projects where algorithm development is performed by external partners.

title: Platform Architect - Banking
description:
About us 

EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets.

The role 

You will own the design of a shared AI platform for our clients. The platform has two parts. An AI Control Plane governs what agents may do, through identity and delegated permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, budgets and durable audit records. A managed AI Runtime is where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services.

You will set the architecture, define how services and controls fit together, and make sure what the team builds is sound, assured and ready for production. The role reaches across engineering, security, audit, risk and the client's architecture function. You will take designs through their governance, record the decisions, and give the engineers a design they can build and the client a design they can approve.

You will be EggAI's accountable architecture lead on the engagement, leading design for a delivery team of platform engineers. You make the technical decisions within the team's remit, recommend on the rest, and secure the client's approval where their architecture or risk governance requires it. 

What you will do 

- Own the architecture of the AI Control Plane and AI Runtime and keep it aligned with the client's architecture standards, cloud substrate, API gateway, identity provider and audit services.
- Define service interfaces and contracts. Decide where each security and policy control is enforced: in the gateway, the control plane, the runtime or the client's own services.
- Keep the design record. Write architecture decision records (ADRs) and record every deviation from the client's standards or our reference designs for a client decision.
- Take designs through the client's architecture and risk forums. Secure approvals in time for dependent work, so that design precedes implementation.
- Lead design and quality review across all platform services. Review engineers' changes, cross-service tests and fault exercises with the CTO.
- Define how the architecture will be proven. Agree acceptance criteria with engineers and client control owners for each interface, control and infrastructure contract, including behaviour when a dependency fails, and review the test evidence showing they are met.
- Hold the build to the design's principles: policy enforced outside the agent, decisions recorded before actions take effect, fail closed with stop always available, and audit evidence that is administered independently of the people who build and run the platform, reconciled against what actually happened, and readable with the client's own tools.
- Maintain the inventory of platform controls. Record for each one whether it is enforced or only monitored, whether it is implemented, tested or still open, and what evidence it produces, so acceptance reviews work from a current record and coverage gaps are visible.
- Assess proposed technology, scope and dependency changes for their effect on the design, controls, effort and running costs, and give the programme lead a clear basis for plan and cost decisions.
- Evaluate new runtimes and managed services against the platform's control requirements. Compare shared controls with provider-native ones on integration effort, operating cost and assurance gaps, separate what is verified from what is assumed, and recommend whether to adopt, change the design or hold scope.
- Lead the technical assessment of production readiness. Review recovery, containment and fault-exercise evidence, and give the programme lead a clear view of what is ready and what is not.
- Stay with the platform through go-live and the support period after it. Resolve the architectural issues that production exposes, and decide when a fix is a design change rather than a defect.
- Prepare the client's receiving engineers to maintain the design. Lead the architecture parts of training and handover, and leave documentation, decision records and guidance they can extend without you.

Essential experience 

- You have been the accountable solution or platform architect for systems that went into production, and have led engineers through building them.
- You have delivered cloud platforms into production in a regulated environment and taken designs through formal architecture and risk governance.
- You know a major cloud platform in depth: networking, identity, secrets, Kubernetes and managed services. Azure is strongly preferred.
- You have hands-on experience with API gateways, identity and delegation using OAuth and OIDC, and policy as code.
- You work with infrastructure as code, GitOps and software supply-chain controls, and understand how they underpin reproducible environments, conformance tests and release assurance.
- You have designed systems that must produce audit evidence and fail safely: durable records, immutable storage, separation of duties and deny-by-default access. You have sound judgement about retries, partial failure, idempotency, identity propagation and recovery.
- You write clear architecture decision records and can explain and defend a design to senior architects, risk owners and engineers.

Nice to have 

- Delivery in financial services or banking.
- LLM or agent platforms in production, including model gateways, agent orchestration and protocols such as MCP and A2A.
- Audit, evidence retention or AI risk controls, including EU AI Act, PRA or FCA expectations.
- Products in this space such as Kong, Open Policy Agent or Microsoft Foundry.

Practical details 

- Hybrid working and client-site attendance will depend on the engagement.
- You will need to complete the background and security checks required by the client.

- Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.

- Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.

- Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement 

- Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.

- Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.

- Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.

- Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

- Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact

Success Metrics

- Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have

- Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals

- Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents

- Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems

- Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance

- Strong communication skills in English

AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

We are scaling fast: our target is €1M of signed ARR per month by the end of December 2026. The liberal segment (private practices and groups, ~€10–30k ARR per account) needs to contribute heavily.

This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory.

Your mission

Generate €400k ARR in year one in new business on the liberal segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals.

Expected outcomes

1 month: 

- Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…)

- Make your first prospecting calls , demos , and initial sales conversations

- Close your first simple deals independently.

3 months: 

- Build a stable pipeline , with at least 30 active opportunities at different stages

- Improve our call scripts and email sequences

- Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments 

- Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap

- Full autonomy by month 3 on pitch, product, ICP, and qualification

6-12 months: 

- Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders)

- Contribute to structuring our sales playbook 

- Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings)

What the role looks like day to day

Build your own pipeline 

- Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking

- Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers

- Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one

Own the full sales cycle 

- Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with practice and group decision-makers

- Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage

- Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments (~1 month post-signature)

Make the engine better 

- Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking

- Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences

What sales look like on the liberal segment 

- Deal size from 15K to 30K

- 1 month sale cycle

- ICP : group of independent practitioners

This role is for you if

The prerequisites: 

- You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets : people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers.

- You've run SMB/mid deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 6 months, on fast, slightly pushy cycles (€10–20k average basket). You listen actively, you're convincing and assertive, and you're comfortable being pushy.

- You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with doctors: they need to be won over, so we want sharp closers. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to individual practitioners with the same professional posture.

What we'll evaluate in interviews: 

- Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego : you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet.

- Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work.

- Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable.

Requirements: 

- 1–3 years of B2B SaaS sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience

- Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication

- Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company

- Entrepreneurial mindset

Nice to have: 

- Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints

- Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals)

- Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo

This role is NOT for you if

- You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only "sold" by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch.

- You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes.

Perks and Benefits

- Equity (BSPCE)

- Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

- Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

- MacBook provided.

- Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

- EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

- Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

- Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

- Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Hiring process

- Discovery interview (30 min, video) — Talent Acquisition Manager

- Manager fit interview (30 min, video) — Alexandre, Head of Sales

- Track record + case study (1h) — Alexandre and Nathan (Senior AE)

- Founders / culture fit (1h, on site) — Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

- Reference checks

- Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days . You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca? 

- An entrepreneurial adventure , with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

- A product already live , with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

- A true scaling phase , with everything still to build

- Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles. 

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]
description:
TL;DR

- We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce)

- Founding deployment strategist : you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work

- €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs)

- €45–60k + equity

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

- Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

- Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later.

- Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow.

- Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents.

- Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it.

- Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget.

- Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear.

- Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment.

What you bring

You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor.

Must have 

- Customer-facing project experience. Two years or more managing client projects in an industrial environment, typically in consulting (operations, supply chain, transformation). You've held deadlines, managed stakeholders, and delivered.

- AI-native, for real. You use LLMs every day, and you've built things with them: automations, agents, prompts that run in production (Claude, GPT, n8n, Make, scripts, whatever works). You know what an agent can do alone, where it breaks, and where a human must stay in the loop.

- Listening before configuring. You translate what people say into what the system and the agents must do, and you notice when the two don't match.

- At ease in front of clients: Plant directors, finance, shop-floor operators. You can hold a room, and say no in it.

- A full load, gladly. Around 150 project days a year, several deployments running at once.

- Fluent English and French, both required. Our first clients work in French, our team writes in English, and you may support our deployments in the United States.

Nice to have 

- You've automated a real operations process end to end, with measurable hours saved

- You've already taken a complex B2B software live

- Comfortable with AI

- You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns

- Seed / Series A experience, where nobody's job description holds for long

Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway. 

How we'll measure success

- ERP go-lives on the date we promised

- Days spent against the plan we sold

- Agents still running three months after launch, and the hours of work they take off the client's hands

What you'll get

- €45–60k + equity

- World-class peers

- The first hire of our deployment team: you write the playbook that future hires and our system integrator partners will follow, and you grow with the team it builds

- A front-row seat on how AI agents change the way real companies operate

- Regular company offsite (2–4 times per year) in great locations

- Ideal equipment and setup

- Remote-first (France), about 20% of your time on client sites

Process

We value efficiency and clarity. The entire process takes no more than 2 weeks:

- 30-minute intro call with Florian (CRO)

- 60-minute deployment deep dive with Eric (CEO)

- 30-min cultural-fit interview with Eugène (CTO)

- 2 days paid assessment, on a real client situation.

- Offer: If it's a match, we move fast.

Interested? Tell us about a client project you led, and something you automated with AI. A short, personal note goes a long way, AI-generated cover letters don't.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build and deploy AI, data and software solutions directly with our clients. 

You are an engineer first: you write production code and take technical ownership of complex projects from discovery through production and handover.

You will work with client teams, alongside Singulier engineers, Product Owners, delivery managers and advisory colleagues:

- Build and ship: write, review and debug production code. Build applications, integrations, data pipelines and AI workflows or agents that connect models to client data, tools and processes. 
- Design the solution: translate business priorities into architecture, technical scope and estimates, and make explicit trade-offs between quality, cost and speed. 
- Run it in production: put in place testing, AI evaluations, access controls, monitoring and deployment suited to the client's systems and constraints. 
- Drive adoption: understand workflows, test assumptions with users and explain technical choices to engineers and executives. Agree success measures upfront, track adoption and business impact, and hand over with documentation and training. 
- Lead technically: guide other engineers through design and debugging, coordinate technical dependencies, and turn project work into reusable components and patterns. This is a senior individual contributor role. 

Beyond client work, you will help build the firm: scoping and estimating new projects, interviewing engineering candidates, and contributing to internal AI initiatives and experimentation. 

Work environment : engineering culture and stack 

We are building a small, highly skilled delivery team that shares engineering patterns and goes deep on a focused stack. Our aim is to make AI and technology transformation practical for mid-sized companies, within their budgets, teams and operating realities. Reusing proven foundations across projects lets us deliver faster, with consistent quality and a clear path to business value. 

The stack below is our default, not a constraint: we adapt to client environments and adopt new tools when the benefit is clear. 

- Ways of working: Git, pull requests, code reviews, automated tests and CI/CD. Monitoring, evaluations and tracing ship with every AI application. 
- Languages and frameworks: Python, SQL and TypeScript; Polars, FastAPI, Pydantic and Pydantic AI. 
- Data: PostgreSQL, DuckDB, LanceDB and Parquet, with attention to data quality, modelling and the simplest design that meets performance and scale needs. 
- Infrastructure: infrastructure as code, Docker, and disciplined configuration, secrets and environment management. Databricks and Google Cloud, including BigQuery, when the workload calls for them. 

You do not need to have used every tool listed. We care about what you have shipped, how you collaborate and what production has taught you. 

Requirements 

You will likely bring: 

- 6+ years as a hands-on engineer in software, data or applied AI, including technical ownership of complex production deployments. 
- Strong Python, fluent SQL and enough TypeScript to contribute across the stack. 
- Experience shipping LLM-based solutions to production: evaluating their behaviour and designing around their limitations in real workflows. 
- Solid grounding in APIs, data modelling, storage and pipelines, and practical experience with cloud services and infrastructure as code. 
- Strong engineering habits around code review, automated testing and CI/CD, and the judgement to make architecture decisions and guide other engineers. 
- Comfort in unfamiliar client environments: clarifying ambiguous requirements and discussing scope, commitments and trade-offs with senior stakeholders. 
- Commercial sense: you care whether what you build moves operational and financial results. 
- Fluency in French and English. 

Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery, business process automation, or transformation in mid-sized or PE-backed companies would be valuable. A degree in engineering, Computer Science or a related field is welcome, as is equivalent practical experience. 

Why join us 

- Real impact, in production: what you build changes how our clients operate, and you see the results. 
- Shape the practice early: join the delivery team while it is still small, and help set its stack, standards and reusable foundations. 
- Ownership and variety: lead projects end to end across different industries and problems, working directly with business owners, investors and leadership teams. 
- European scale: be part of the platform Singulier and OMMAX are building, with engineers, data specialists and strategy advisors to learn from. 
Benefits 

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing, partner-led consulting platform at a pivotal moment in its development.

You will work on high-impact AI, Technology and Transformation engagements, advising private equity funds, portfolio companies and executive leadership teams on critical investment and transformation decisions.

As Singulier x OMMAX build a leading European AI management consulting platform, you will help shape how AI, technology, data and business strategy come together to create lasting value for clients.

You will also benefit from significant exposure to Technology Due Diligence, Value Creation and Transformation projects, a steep learning curve, early ownership, close mentorship and the opportunity to contribute to the growth of an entrepreneurial consulting firm operating at European scale.

description:

About ARCHIMED: 

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Your Role 

Portfolio engagement and value creation 

- Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes.
- Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required.
- Develop and oversee the execution of actionable S&I roadmaps for each portfolio company, with targets and milestones based on the company’s materiality analysis and aligned with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy, partnering with third-party technical experts when necessary.
- Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices.
Investment process 

- Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations.
- Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making.
Data, reporting, and compliance 

- Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary.
- Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives.
- Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency.
- Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements.
Center of excellence and capability building 

- Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices.
- Provide expert guidance and S&I training to management, investment, and investor relations teams to deepen integration across the business.
Requirements 

- At least 10 years’ experience building and executing sustainability strategies, preferably in private equity.
- Proven hands-on leadership, initiative, and project management skills, with strong problem-solving ability.
- Robust knowledge of S&I frameworks and disclosures, including SFDR, SASB, CSRD, EDCI, PMDR, and the UN SDGs.
- Strong command of impact measurement methodologies, including developing and reporting on impact metrics.
- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to build coherent sustainability narratives and proofread content.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the adaptability to engage C-suite executives internationally.
- Proven team player, able to build working partnerships and promote collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders.
- Ability to coach junior team members, sharing knowledge and giving regular feedback.
- Pragmatic, constructive, creative, and solution-oriented, with a positive mindset and the ability to work under varied pressures.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Freelance
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

- ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job 

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

Why Now, Why Mirakl 

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

What You’ll Do 

1. Design & Build AI Systems 

- Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.

- Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.

- Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.

- Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack 

- Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.

- Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.

- Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.

- Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact 

- Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.

- Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.

- Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.

- Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability 

- Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.

- Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.

- Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.

- Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement 

- Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.

- Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.

- Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.

- Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools 

- 
Languages: Python and SQL

- 
AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

- 
Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

- Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful 

- Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems

- Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products

- Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact

- Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics 

- Product adoption and business impact

- Performance and reliability of AI systems

- Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

- 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields

- Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals

- Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents

- Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems

- Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance

- Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments

- Strong communication skills in English

- Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

- A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

- An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.

- 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

title: Manager, Key Accounts - Hotels
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join 

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence and guest-centred ethos that define Airbnb. Our mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotel partners easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You Will Make 

Build a global team. Open doors no one at Airbnb has opened yet. 

Airbnb Hotels is one of the most exciting growth stories in travel, and we’re only getting started. As Manager, Key Accounts, you will build and lead a brand new, globally distributed team of Enterprise Account Managers. Together you will win and onboard high-value, above-property hotel groups with hundreds of hotels across multiple continents. 

We’re looking for someone who brings: 

- Proven leadership of a key, strategic or enterprise accounts team , ideally globally distributed

- A network and reputation in travel and hospitality , ideally hotels

- Real negotiation experience with high-value partners

- A builder’s mindset, with a track record of creating teams, playbooks and processes where none existed

- Strong cross-functional influence across a matrix organisation

What you’ll own: 

- End-to-end partner management at hotel headquarter and regional office level

- Mutual account plans that drive supply and strategic relationship value

- The global Key Accounts strategy, in line with the Enterprise Team playbook

- A clear mandate to consistently exceed quarterly business KPIs

- World-class account management practices, operational excellence and partner satisfaction

- The voice of Key Accounts within Hotels leadership

- A collaborative, growth-oriented team that you mentor and motivate

This position reports to the Global Head, Hotel Enterprise and Connectivity Partnerships, and offers a unique opportunity to shape Airbnb’s growth in the hotel market.

Why this role: 

- Lead a brand new team in a business that only launched this year

- Shape the Key Accounts playbook from day one

- Own the relationships, the targets and the strategy for a global segment

- Work with a leadership team that is moving fast and backing this business

A Typical Day 

- Lead a distributed team of Enterprise Account Managers, supporting them on partner management and new business development for supply acquisition

- Own the team’s quarterly revenue, supply acquisition and OKR targets, and ensure they are met and exceeded

- Take partners from first conversation through negotiation, signed deal and onboarding

- Develop and execute the Key Accounts playbook in line with global strategy, working closely with Hotel functional teams across regions

- Manage and grow relationships with multi-national hotel groups, acting as an escalation option for your team where needed

- Build the operational rhythm for the team: establish and track KPIs, analyse growth and key metrics to identify trends, surface new business opportunities, and resolve business challenges with urgency

- Support the Hotels field team in achieving their goals through well-designed field-level action plans

- Work closely with Product, Technical Support, Connectivity, RevOps and Hotels Cross-Functional Leadership to drive feature adoption and business performance

- Represent Airbnb at industry and partner events, and organise internal partner events

- Hold regular team meetings, 1:1s, and performance and development reviews

- Organise team business gatherings, quarterly kick-offs and team-building events

Your Expertise 

Must-haves

- 12+ years of professional experience and at least 8+ years in sales or account management roles in travel, hospitality or e-commerce

- 6+ years of experience managing and leading high-performing teams, with a proven track record of meeting and exceeding goals

- Experience leading a globally distributed team and driving solutions to improve supply acquisition and revenue goals, ideally across international markets

- Established relationships with, or deep knowledge of, major hotel groups across the global hospitality landscape

- Entrepreneurial mindset developed from experience having launched companies, teams or significant initiatives where resources, processes and capabilities had to be created, not handed to you or followed

- Proven track record of preparing and executing complex negotiations with high-value partner organisations

- Highly motivated team builder with the ability to coach and mentor account managers

- Ability to develop a strategy, communicate it clearly, and secure buy-in and support to execute against quarterly goals

title: Senior Outsourced Sales Manager: Vinted Go Acquisition
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted Go grows by signing new pick-up/drop-off locations, and a large share of that growth is delivered by external sales agencies. You will own that network: the agencies running our field sales, virtual calling and digital outreach across Europe and the US.

Today these relationships are managed in a fragmented way. Your job is to turn them into one well-governed, high-performing extension of the acquisition team, with clear targets, a consistent operating rhythm and a single point of accountability.

This is a high-ownership role. You will act as an agency manager, performance analyst and budget owner, and above all as the guardian of the Vinted Go sales approach in every conversation an agency has on our behalf. You will build on the structure that already exists.

In this position, you’ll 

Agency & Channel Management 

- Own the full relationship with every outsourced sales partner across countries: onboarding, day-to-day management, escalations and offboarding

- Be the single point of accountability for agency sales results, replacing today's fragmented oversight

- Negotiate and manage contracts, SLAs and commercial terms, including pay-for-performance structures

- Evaluate, select and onboard new sales agencies as we enter new markets

- Build one operating framework (reporting cadence, WBRs, MBRs, escalation paths) that works the same way across agencies, channels and countries

Performance Management 

- Define and track sales KPIs and SLAs per agency, channel and market: conversion, signed locations per rep, productivity, lead quality and adherence to the Vinted Go pitch

- Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into performance across the whole network

- Spot underperforming agencies or markets early and drive corrective action plans

- Translate acquisition targets set by leadership into agency-level performance expectations

- Run calibration and quality assurance (call reviews, field ride-alongs) so every agency sells consistently

Budget Management 

- Own the outsourced sales budget across all agencies and countries: forecasting, spend tracking and variance reporting

- Analyze cost per outcome (CAC, cost per signed location, cost per hour) across agencies, channels and markets to drive efficiency

- Find and execute cost optimizations without compromising quality

- Report on budget and performance regularly to finance and leadership

Scale & Process 

- Design the processes and governance needed to run a multi-agency, multi-country, multi-language sales network sustainably

- Build and maintain playbooks for opening new markets and onboarding new agencies

- Work with the acquisition team to align on targets, budgets and reporting standards

About you 

- Senior experience managing external sales agencies or outsourced sales teams (field sales, telesales, digital lead generation), ideally across several countries and vendors at once

- A background in sales, acquisition or growth in a high-velocity environment, so you know what good looks like on the ground

- A strong record of agency performance management: setting KPIs and SLAs, running WBRs and MBRs, and driving accountability

- Budget ownership: forecasting, tracking and optimizing spend across multiple vendors or cost centers

- Comfort building structure and process from a relatively unstructured starting point

- Strong analytical skills, working easily in dashboards, reporting tools and a CRM to track performance and cost

- Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills: you hold agencies accountable while keeping the partnership productive

- Comfort working across time zones and cultures

- Fluent English; French and/or Spanish is an advantage

Why This Role Matters

Outsourced sales is one of the main ways Vinted Go signs new locations at scale, and it is growing in every market we enter. This role brings order, accountability and cost discipline to that network, and lays the foundation for further international and product growth.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 working days of holiday

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Co-contribution meal vouchers for each workday through a convenient meal card

- Comprehensive Medical Coverage

- Frequent team-building events

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

What You Will Do

- 
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

- 
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

- 
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

- 
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- 
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

- 
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- 
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

- 
Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT , TPOT , tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

- 
Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

- 
Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM , or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

- 
Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

- 
Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

- 
Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

- 
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8 , INT8 , INT4 , NVFP4 , MXFP4 , AWQ , GPTQ , SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

- 
Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

- 
Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

- 
CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

- 
Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, KServe, or related projects.

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. 

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities 

- Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
- Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
- Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
- Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
- Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
- Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
- Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.
Requirements 

Background & Experience 

- At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
- Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
- A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
- Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
- Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
- Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
- Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
- Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.
Benefits 

What Makes You A Great Fit 

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us? 

- Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
- Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
- Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
- Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
- Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).
Ready to Move the Needle? 

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

Our talented team is at the heart of this mission, and we are looking for an Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications to join us in developing robust software solutions that operate reliably in real-world railway environments.

What you will do 

- Industrial Software Development: Design, implement and maintain robust application software for industrial and railway products using C++, C#, Python or comparable technologies.
