- Software Architecture, Quality & Controlled Releases: Own software architecture and release discipline, including configuration and version control, code reviews, test evidence and controlled software releases.

- Product Cybersecurity: Own threat assessment, secure access and software updates, vulnerability handling and lifecycle security maintenance; coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences.

- Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team.

- Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities.

- Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems.

What you bring 

- Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience.

- Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment.

- Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service.

- Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed.

- Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems.

- Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use.

- Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable.

- Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products.

- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces.

- Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows.

- A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution.

- Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly.

- Fluent English; German is a strong advantage.

Nice to have 

- Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems.

- MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience.

- Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable.

- Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS.

- Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment.

Benefits

- Flexible working hours and home office options.

- Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences.

- Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage.

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

What you’ll do

- Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

- Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

- Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

- Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

- Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

- Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

- NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

- JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

- Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer 

- Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

- Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

- Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer 

- Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

- Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

- Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Team: regular team events.

Practical information

- Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

- If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

An overview of this role

Your Typical Day 

No two days look exactly the same. You might design a new capability for the agent runtime, improve how models and tools are orchestrated, investigate a production reliability issue, or take an integration from an early prototype to a secure, observable service.

The role

#LI-MM1

We’re looking for a Software Engineer with strong C++ expertise to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.

Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

Built on top of the open-source YTsaurus ecosystem, we run and extend our own Nebius distribution and develop significant in-house functionality (core and platform-level). We can design, implement, and roll out features end-to-end on our clusters without waiting for upstream approvals and contribute upstream when it makes sense.

At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.

What’s inside the platform

You’ll work on a system that includes (and ties together):

- Distributed Storage (Cypress) : transactional semantics, tiered storage, erasure coding, replication, and strong reliability expectations.

- Compute & ETL : a cluster-wide job scheduler (tens of thousands of cores), MapReduce, YQL for SQL-like data processing, and SPYT (Spark over YTsaurus) for modern data engineering.

- Interactive analytics (CHYT) : ClickHouse® instances spun up directly on compute nodes for fast SQL over data in-place.

- Dynamic Tables : low-latency NoSQL KV with distributed ACID transactions for OLTP-style workloads and feature stores.

- Orchestracto : workflow orchestration deeply integrated with the platform (Airflow-like, but platform-native).

What you’ll do

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong systems skills with product sense : understanding who uses the platform, why certain capabilities matter, and making pragmatic trade-offs to maximize impact. On our team, engineering work is expected to be connected to real users and outcomes — you’ll regularly align with internal stakeholders, clarify requirements, and help drive prioritization.

In this role, you will:

- Design and implement new functionality in YTsaurus core (C++) with production reliability in mind.

- Build and evolve platform-level capabilities: platform architecture and operating model—multi-cluster growth, shared primitives, and a consistent experience that scales with new teams and use cases.

- Improve end-to-end platform experience for internal (and external-facing) users: APIs, guardrails, debugging workflows, and automation.

- Own production quality: incident response / on-call rotation , root cause analysis, and turning learnings into durable fixes.

Example projects

- Roll out sharded YTsaurus masters (incl. Kubernetes operator support) and build automatic balancing of metadata across master cells (consensus groups) to remove control-plane bottlenecks and unlock 10–100x cluster growth .

- Make CHYT interactive SQL faster and more predictable at high load via performance work like data-skipping / min-max-style indexes and improved execution introspection.

- Turn Orchestracto into a platform product by defining the building blocks, developer experience, and governance for how teams create and share workflows.

- Scale and harden Parquet-on-S3 for native YTsaurus workloads by tackling replication/movement, consistent lifecycle semantics, and master-server metadata optimizations for performance and reliability.

- Design and ship complete, trustworthy audit trails for data changes (who/what/when) across heterogeneous storage and compute paths.

Tech stack

- Core: modern C++ (C++20, async + multithreaded primitives)

- Services & tooling: Go and Python (microservices, utilities, integration tests)

- 5+ years of software engineering experience.

- Strong C++ skills (you’ll write core code).

- Working knowledge of Python and/or Go (you don’t have to be expert, but should be comfortable navigating them).

- Experience developing and/or operating high-load, distributed services .

- Production mindset: ability to use SSH, read logs/metrics/traces , and debug distributed systems behavior.

- Solid CS fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency basics.

Nice to have

- Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).

title: Scientific Product Manager
description:
About CuspAI 

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. 

The Role 

Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.

Your impact 

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.

What You Will Do 

Product Requirements & Roadmap 

- Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

- Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

- Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

Partner Lab Onboarding 

- Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

- Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

- Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

Closed-Loop Campaigns 

- Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

- Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications: 

- PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

- Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

- Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

- Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning.

- Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others.

- Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas.

- Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical): 

- Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments.

- Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR data or metadata schemas, and familiarity with lab data standards (e.g. SiLA 2, AnIML, Allotrope).

- Instrument integration experience, including vendor software, data formats, and scheduling or orchestration.

- Product or project management experience, such as roadmaps, user research, external research collaborations or vendor relationships. We are equally open to strong experimental scientists making their first move into product.

- Experience working in industry at a materials, chemicals, energy or deep-tech company, or closely with industry at a research institution or national lab.

- Experience coordinating work across multiple labs, sites or countries.

Additional Considerations 

This role could be based in any of our locations with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner labs and other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

- A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

- Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

- Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

- ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

- Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

- Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

- True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other

Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world. 

CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace . We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team. 

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

title: Senior Cosmetic Chemist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Cosmetic Chemist for our KEUNE Beauty Solutions team. You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market.

At KEUNE, we develop and manufacture not only our own professional haircare products but also products for KEUNE Beauty Solutions (KBS), our private label division. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products.

MISSION 

- Lead assigned new product development projects from brief to commercialization, taking ownership of technical execution, deliverables, timelines, and follow-up in line with the NPD process.

- Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

- Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan.

- Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps.

- Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes.

- Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked. 

- Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders.

- Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control.

- Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients.

- Apply appropriate instrumental and analytical methods to evaluate formulations, substantiate performance, and support technical decisions.

YOU 

- Master's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.

- At least 7 years of relevant cosmetic formulation and development experience, with strong expertise in hair products.

- A proven track record of developing and successfully launching cosmetic products.

- Strong hands-on formulation skills, paired with the ability to organize and tackle multiple development activities.

- A proactive, independent, and accountable working style: you take initiative, follow through on commitments, and know when to escalate issues.

- Confidence in leading technical client conversations, challenging or clarifying briefs constructively, and managing expectations together with cross-functional colleagues.

- Ability to guide junior and mid-level chemists.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

- Curiosity about innovation, new ingredients, and opportunities to improve products and ways of working.

- Eligible to work in the Netherlands

OUR OFFER 

- A sustainably-conscious employer;

- Travel allowance 

- 27 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment);

- Relocation support 

- A good pension plan;

- A competitive salary;

- 8% holiday pay;

- And never have a "bad hair day" again thanks to staff discounts on the entire Keune collection!

- Attention to your mental well-being through unlimited access to OpenUp

- Participation in group classes at Personal Fitness Soest

KEUNE 

We are a family business with a long-term vision, where science is at the heart of everything we do. Our story begins in 1922, in Amsterdam. Today, KEUNE belongs to one of the fastest growing brands in professional hair care products. From our headquarters in Soest, KEUNE products are developed, produced and distributed worldwide to more than 85 countries. And we have no intention of slowing down! Every year we open a new site of our own. We produce in a sustainable and animal-friendly way and are B Corp-certified. But KEUNE is not just about creating beautiful products - it's about our story and our vision.  KEUNE is led by Philip Berlijn, who is focused on building a strong brand and creating a corporate culture that is all about collaboration, sustainability and showing character

description:
ennovationHUB is a rapidly growing international e-commerce group operating in the home & living category, with a strong focus on furniture. From our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers across the UK, North America, EU, and APAC. 

As we work toward €160m+ annual revenue by 2027, we are looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us ASAP and take ownership of Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, and profitability. 

This is not a typical agency PPC role focused on managing a handful of campaigns. You will join a multi-brand international e-commerce group with significant advertising budgets, multiple markets, and a clear view of how your work influences revenue and profitability. 

Google Ads is central to our growth strategy. Working across multiple countries and brands brings both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for people who enjoy working with large datasets, identifying performance opportunities, and consistently improving results through testing, analysis, and execution. 

You will collaborate closely with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists to ensure campaigns perform well today and continue to scale efficiently as the business grows. 

- Take ownership of Google Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets 

- Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types 

- Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability 

- Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio 

- Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience segments 

- Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations 

- Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives 

- Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement 

- Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness 

- Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting 

- Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices 

- Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance 

You will be joining a business where Google Ads already delivers results. Your role is to build on that success by identifying opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where even small improvements can have a significant impact. 

You will work alongside experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support or reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and directly influence the growth of the business. 

- 

This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Applicants whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered. 

We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes within an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and feel comfortable taking responsibility for results, beyond simply providing recommendations. 

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have: 

- 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns 

- Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability 

- Strong experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns 

- Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer 

- Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights 

- Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement 

- Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center 

- Highly analytical with strong attention to detail 

- Fluent in English, both written and spoken 

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities 

- Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement 

- Able to take ownership and make decisions independently 

- We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change 

- Senior, but practical 

- Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical 

- Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions 

- Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements 

- Focused on outcomes rather than activity 

- Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution 

- Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns 

- Available to start immediately / ASAP 

We are investing in strengthening our presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. 

The role involves travel approximately every 4-8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work takes place remotely, we value spending time together in person, particularly as the company continues to scale. 

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to make a meaningful contribution to scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years. 

In Our Culture at ennovationHUB, We Value: 

- Accountability over excuses 

- Execution over talk 

- Clarity over politics 

- Learning through doing 

We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. What matters most is the quality of your work, taking ownership, and helping the business move forward.

title: Graduate FPGA Engineer (2027 Start)
description:

You’ll create solutions with nanosecond response times, highly parallelized algorithms, and customized low-level networking that solve business challenges effectively and efficiently. Collaborating closely with our business, you’ll have in-depth insight into a problem before developing the solution.

Optiver is building with cutting edge AI technology in the most competitive, data rich landscapes in the world: financial markets. Our FPGA engineers use AI to speed up verification, debugging, and technical research, while retaining full ownership of the designs and decisions it supports.

What you’ll do 

Your onboarding 

You will participate in Optiver’s comprehensive Global Academy and be equipped with the knowledge needed to make an impact the moment you join your team. The comprehensive training covers trading theory and Optiver’s tech stack to hone your skills for your role. In addition, you will be paired with a dedicated mentor who will empower you to take ownership of your work and make a difference.

Your responsibilities 

- 
Accelerate network infrastructure and trading system components with high-speed hardware designs.

- 
Research new low-latency techniques and platforms and identify opportunities for integration with our trading system.

- 
Collaborate in a multidisciplinary team of traders, software developers, and infrastructure engineers.

- 
Leverage the best hardware available or build in-house versions to ensure our FPGAs can interface with cutting-edge server hardware. 

What you’ll get 

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

- 
A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool

- 
The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 different countries

- 
25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards

- 
Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses

- 
Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, sport and leisure activities, bi-weekly massages and Friday afternoon drinks

- 
Training and continuous learning opportunities

- 
International transfer opportunities for global career growth

- 
Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats

Who you are 

- 
University degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or similar, with outstanding academic achievements

- 
Graduating between August 2024 and August 2027, with a maximum of 3 years of work experience

- 
Academic design experience with FPGAs or ASICs

- 
Academic experience in VHDL , Verilog, or SystemVerilog

- 
An open, collaborative, self-critical attitude and willingness to learn from your mistakes

- 
A desire to understand how the systems you build fit into our trading activities

- 
Able to work closely with other engineers, traders, and business operations

How to Apply: 
Apply directly via the form below for the position of Graduate FPGA Engineer. Please provide us with a CV in English. Unfortunately we cannot accept applications via email for data protection reasons.
If your application is selected to proceed to the next round, you will be required to complete online assessments. By submitting your application you are confirming that you will be able to take the assessment within 7 days.
Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via the contact form 

Diversity statement 

Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion .

We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via the contact form , selecting "Reasonable Adjustments" as the subject of your inquiry.

For answers to some of our most frequently asked questions, refer to our FAQs .

For applicants based in India, our entry route is via the placement office internship hiring season (July/August).

Optiver has a global application re-apply policy for our intern and graduate roles. We welcome you to re-apply after the 8-month cool off period.

title: Senior Financial Controller
description:
MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken.

Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie.

Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie.

MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Project Control

- Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts.

- Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren.

- Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow.

- Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting.

- Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen.

- Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie.

- Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering.

Financial Control

- Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen. 

- Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces. 

- Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting. 

- Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie.

- Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages.

Business Control & Business Partnering

- Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning.

- Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses.

- Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie.

- Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning.

- Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's.

- Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming.

Wie zoeken wij?

- Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar.

- Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie.

- Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen.

- Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants. 

- Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving.

- Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing.

- Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools.

- Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

- Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht.

- In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders.

- Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie.

Wij bieden je:

- Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief.

- Een internationale werkomgeving met collega's en projecten over de hele wereld.

- Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

- Een marktconform salaris conform de cao Architectenbureaus, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.

- 30 vakantiedagen, hybride werken en een inspirerende werkplek in Rotterdam.

- Onbeperkte toegang tot OpenUp, korting met Urban Sports, een gezonde lunch geserveerd, een NS Business Card en een laptop. 

Klaar om mee te bouwen aan een financieel sterke toekomst voor MVRDV? We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie.

title: Senior Campus Recruiter
description:
Ready to shape the future of talent acquisition in a global trading firm? As a Senior Campus Recruiter, you'll be the driving force behind spotting and bringing the top 1% of talent from Europe's premier universities on board. Your journey involves navigating the full campus recruitment lifecycle, from identification to selection, and making your mark at European recruitment events.

The team 
You'll join our Campus Recruitment team in Europe, based in Amsterdam, part of a wider recruitment organisation of experienced tech, trading and business support recruiters. Collaboration comes first here: we share knowledge, step in for each other in peak season, and succeed as one team.

What you'll do 

- Own the end-to-end recruitment process: screening, interviewing, assessment review, offer conversations and closing

- Build strong partnerships with business leaders and interviewers, and make sure we're aligned on hiring needs and on what great looks like

- Work in a data-driven way, using insights to make our process sharper, fairer and more efficient

- Contribute to strategic projects such as market analyses, process and assessment reviews, and improvements to how we select

- Represent IMC at recruitment events across Europe, with frequent travel (more than four times a year)

What we look for 

- 3+ years of industry experience, ideally within a global finance, trading, tech or consultancy organisation

- Knowledge of financial markets and the trading industry

- A critical eye: you question how things are done, spot trends early and turn them into practical improvements

- The ability to think strategically and act tactically, moving easily between the bigger picture and getting things done today

- A solution-oriented mindset: when something isn't working, you look for a better way

- You enjoy operational recruitment. Running a tight process and giving candidates a great experience energises you

- You build relationships with the business with ease and earn trust as a partner, not just a service provider

- You thrive in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same

- You work well in a larger team and put collaboration first

- You keep up with industry trends and best practices in campus recruitment and bring them into your own work

What we offer 

A unique work culture that values collaboration, initiative, and ownership. Our professional and friendly environment provides the perfect backdrop for your growth and responsibilities. We operate with transparency in a flat structure, allowing you direct engagement with stakeholders and professionals. Your input matters here, contributing to our collective success. At IMC, continuous learning is a priority. Various training and on-the-job growth opportunities allow you to shape your path within the organisation. This isn't just a job; it's a journey of ongoing growth.

We appreciate your efforts. Our highly competitive salary comes with great perks. If you're looking for a friendly yet professional space to contribute and grow, IMC is the place. If you're ready for a role beyond routine recruitment, where your experience can contribute to the future of our team and company, apply now.

About Us 

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: Senior Product Manager – JetBrains Air (Agentic Development in IDEs)
description:
Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?

About JetBrains 

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do 

Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process. 

JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction.

Day to day, you will:

- Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration.

- Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review.

- Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions.

- Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments.

- Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions.

- Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities.

- Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it.

- Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements.

What you’ll bring 

- A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies.

- A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry.

- Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.

- Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.

- Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.

- Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.

What you’ll need 

- Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.

- Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management.

- A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers.

- An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.

- The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.

- Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

What success looks like 

In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means:

- Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30).

- Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers.

- Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas.

- Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.

- Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.

Why join JetBrains? 

- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.

- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.

- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.

- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.

- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.

- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.

- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. 

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. 

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. 

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. 

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer 

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

- Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

- Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

- Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

- Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

- Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

- Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

- Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

- 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

- Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

- Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

- Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

- Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

- Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

- Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

- Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

- Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

- Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

- Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

- You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

- You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

- You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

- You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

- You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

- You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

What we offer: 

- Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. 

- International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. 

- Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. 

- Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company. 

- Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 

- Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 

- Hybrid working model. 

- Policies to support working parents. 

- Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office. 

- Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp 

- Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 

Equal opportunities 

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Marketing Events Planner
description:

- Proven knowledge of event management, agency coordination, and brand activation

- Hands-on experience in project management and handling event budgets

- Proactive mindset with sharp attention to detail and a passion for flawless execution

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

title: Senior Product Manager Transport (Equipment)
description:
About us 

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role 

Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.

Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.

Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.

What you'll do 

- Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking.

- Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing.

- Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet.

- Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it.

- Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them.

- Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community.

What we are looking for 

- 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS.

- You've owned a product area end to end. From discovery through launch and post-launch tracking, not a backlog-only PO role.

- You're comfortable with operationally complex problems: routing, scheduling, fleet or capacity planning, supply chain, field service. A logistics background is a plus, not a must.

- You work from data. You can show how you set a success metric, what you did when it was missed, and how you make the business case behind a product call.

- You've run customer discovery yourself, not through a research team, and you can make and defend scope calls on partial evidence.

title: Associate Director- Sustainability & Impact (Lyon, France)
description:
Location : Lyon, France 

About ARCHIMED: 

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools & Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services. 

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team 

• An international team (with more than 30 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors

• Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.

• Professional backgrounds: Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, capiton), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Pharmacy, Veterinary)

Your Role 

Portfolio engagement and value creation 

- Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes.
- Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required.
- Develop and oversee the execution of actionable S&I roadmaps for each portfolio company, with targets and milestones based on the company’s materiality analysis and aligned with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy, partnering with third-party technical experts when necessary.
- Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices.
Investment process 

- Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations.
- Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making.
Data, reporting, and compliance 

- Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary.
- Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives.
- Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency.
- Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements.
Center of excellence and capability building 

- Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices.
- Provide expert guidance and S&I training to management, investment, and investor relations teams to deepen integration across the business.
Requirements 

- At least 10 years’ experience building and executing sustainability strategies, preferably in private equity.
- Proven hands-on leadership, initiative, and project management skills, with strong problem-solving ability.
- Robust knowledge of S&I frameworks and disclosures, including SFDR, SASB, CSRD, EDCI, PMDR, and the UN SDGs.
- Strong command of impact measurement methodologies, including developing and reporting on impact metrics.
- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to build coherent sustainability narratives and proofread content.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the adaptability to engage C-suite executives internationally.
- Proven team player, able to build working partnerships and promote collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders.
- Ability to coach junior team members, sharing knowledge and giving regular feedback.
- Pragmatic, constructive, creative, and solution-oriented, with a positive mindset and the ability to work under varied pressures.

title: Senior Sales Operations Manager – Compensation & Planning (m/w/d)
description:
Als Senior Sales Operations Manager – Compensation & Planning (m/w/d) verantwortest du die variable Vertriebsvergütung und den Budgetprozess für Deutschland. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du die übergreifende Vertriebssteuerung und das Reporting. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Vertriebsleitung, Finance und Analytics verbindest du technisches Know-how mit unternehmerischem Urteilsvermögen, um zuverlässige Abläufe und fundierte Geschäftsentscheidungen zu ermöglichen.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du operativ, übernimmst viel Eigenverantwortung und stehst im direkten Austausch mit Führungskräften. Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit Daten und Systemen, entwickelst Handlungsempfehlungen und hinterfragst Annahmen konstruktiv.

Deine Aufgaben 

- 
Verantwortung für die variable Vertriebsvergütung übernehmen: Du steuerst den gesamten Prozess – von der Übersetzung vereinbarter Vergütungsmodelle in Berechnungslogiken über die Validierung der Ergebnisse und die Bereitstellung der Auszahlungsdaten bis zur Klärung von Rückfragen.

- 
Berechnungen und Reporting pflegen: Du schreibst SQL-Abfragen und passt Berechnungslogiken und Reports in QuickSuite an, wenn sich Ziele, Vertriebsstrukturen oder Vergütungsmodelle ändern. Du machst die Ergebnisse für die Vertriebsteams zugänglich und verständlich.

- 
Eine zuverlässige Abwicklung sicherstellen: Du koordinierst die Aktualisierung unterschiedlicher Vertriebsziele sowie die Verarbeitung von Ausnahmen und manuellen Eingaben. Dabei sorgst du über die monatlichen und quartalsweisen Abrechnungszyklen hinweg für eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation und wirksame Kontrollen.

- 
Den Budgetprozess für Deutschland verantworten: Du koordinierst die Planung mit Finance und den relevanten Fachbereichen, erstellst detaillierte Excel-Modelle, hinterfragst Annahmen und entwickelst Szenarien, die Risiken und Zielkonflikte transparent machen.

- 
Die Vertriebssteuerung unterstützen: Du analysierst die Vertriebsleistung und geschäftliche Einflussfaktoren, pflegst relevante Reports und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen für die Vertriebsleitung ab.

- 
Mit Führungskräften und zentralen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten: Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis unserer Vertriebsprozesse, bewertest Anfragen und bringst dich als konstruktiver Sparringspartner ein.

- 
Prozesse verbessern: Du erhöhst die Datenqualität, automatisierst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und steuerst konkurrierende Fristen vorausschauend – insbesondere während der Budgetplanung und rund um Quartalswechsel.

Das bringst du mit 

- 
Mindestens fünf Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in Sales Operations, Vertriebssteuerung, variabler Vertriebsvergütung, Commercial Finance, Unternehmensplanung oder einer vergleichbaren analytischen Funktion.

- 
Sehr gute praktische SQL-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit QuickSuite oder vergleichbaren BI-Tools sowie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in der Excel-Modellierung. Du kannst Berechnungen und Reports eigenständig aufbauen, pflegen und Fehler darin beheben.

- 
Ein fundiertes Verständnis von Vertriebsprozessen, wirtschaftlichen Erfolgsfaktoren und Anreizmechanismen sowie die Neugier, unser Geschäft im Detail kennenzulernen.

- 
Gutes unternehmerisches Urteilsvermögen und die Sicherheit, eine eigene Position zu entwickeln, Annahmen konstruktiv zu hinterfragen und mit Führungskräften souverän zusammenzuarbeiten.

- 
Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und auch in arbeitsintensiven Phasen zuverlässig Ergebnisse zu liefern.

- 
Fließende Englischkenntnisse und Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau. Du kannst Fragen zur variablen Vergütung direkt mit deutschsprachigen Vertriebskollegen besprechen.

description:

Your Impact

Location: Munich, Germany (Hybrid: 3 days/week in-office)

You will:

- Strategy & Leadership: Architect disaster-recovery processes for core IAM systems. Design compliance reporting structures. Mentor peers, share best practices, and lead cross-functional technical initiatives.

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork. Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.

You bring: 

- Language Skills: Fully fluent in both German and English (written and spoken). 

- Technical Expertise: Advanced knowledge of supporting and managing Apple environments (macOS/iOS) and cloud-native/SaaS services.

- Security & IAM: Direct experience with endpoint security platforms (Zscaler, CrowdStrike Falcon EDR) and Identity and Access Management solutions (e.g., Okta).

- Network Experience: Proven ability configuring and managing office Wi-Fi and LAN infrastructure.

- Project & Stakeholder Leadership: Track record of leading operational initiatives, change management, and representing IT in cross-departmental discussions. Ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Pacing & Adaptability: Comfortable juggling multiple initiatives and reprioritizing in a high-velocity environment without compromising service quality.

- Culture Add: A collaborative mindset that cultivates belonging, seeks feedback, and actively participates in company culture.

AI Aptitude: A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have: 

- Okta and/or Jamf Administration

- Atlassian Cloud, Confluence and Jira

- IT Asset Management (ITAM), Inventory Management

- IT and/or Security Certifications

- Bug Bounty Programs

- Security CTFs, threat hunting, SOC (Security Operations Center)

Our Benefits 

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs

🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition

title: Technical Business Development Intern (Emerging Verticals) (f/m/d)
description:
Description 

QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) images magnetic fields with micrometer resolution, and that capability could matter far beyond semiconductors. As our Technical Business Development Intern for Emerging Verticals in the Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development, you help us find out where.

Working directly with our project lead for Emerging Verticals, who mentors you, you explore new application fields for widefield magnetic imaging. You dig into the science and the markets behind them, talk to potential customers and users, and help turn promising ideas into first feasibility studies with our magnetic field imaging system. You see how a deep tech company decides where its technology goes next, and help shape that decision.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

Who we are 

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds? 

Picture this: 

- Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

- Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

- Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

- An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us? 

- You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

- From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

- Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

- You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible! 

What will you do 

- Map and evaluate application areas for magnetic field imaging beyond semiconductors: key players, customer segments and structured comparisons of use cases.

- Review scientific literature and patents to understand the state of the art, competing measurement methods, and where NV-based imaging offers a real advantage.

- Prepare and join discovery conversations with researchers and companies to understand their measurement challenges, and keep contacts and opportunities up to date in our CRM.

- Support feasibility studies with our experts, from defining suitable samples to interpreting first measurement results.

- Turn your findings into clear deliverables such as application one-pagers, decision memos, and presentations.

What is expected of you 

- Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in physics, engineering, materials science, chemistry, biophysics, or a related natural science or engineering field, ideally with some Python exposure.

- Available full time for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

- Curiosity about how a new measurement technology can solve problems in fields you may not know yet.

- Clear writing and structured analysis: you turn a pile of papers and conversations into a one-page recommendation.

- AI tools are part of how you research, analyze and write, and you check their output the way you check your own.

- Fluent in English. On-site in Munich.

Business studies or first experience in market research, consulting, or a startup is a plus, not required.

Our benefits 

- Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

- Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

- Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship.

- Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

- Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases.
