As part of Waymo's Legal team, you will work on the exciting legal issues surrounding our transformational autonomous driving technology and help drive our business lines forward from technology ideation through scaled commercial deployment. We partner with our public policy, safety, security and privacy experts to define transportation policy for the autonomous driving world to come, advising on regulatory changes that support and protect our users around the world. We collaborate with our engineering, product, strategy and operations teams to develop and protect our intellectual property portfolio and drive our corporate and commercial transactions. We ensure compliance with an increasingly complex and dynamic range of global regulations. And we anticipate, mitigate, and litigate high-profile and precedent-setting legal matters.

In this hybrid role, you will report into our Managing Counsel. 

You will: 

- Serve as the primary, on-the-ground Privacy Counsel for Waymo's operations, product launches, and engineering initiatives across Germany and the broader EU, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure compliance with GDPR, ePrivacy, and local laws like the BDSG.

- Advise on "Privacy by Design" and data minimization principles for European market entry, working directly with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to design innovative privacy solutions for complex sensor data and model training. 

- Proactively build and maintain constructive relationships with EU Data Protection Authorities (DPAs), acting as the primary legal contact for regulatory inquiries, data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), audits, and ongoing local engagement. 

- Lead rapid, localized legal response for any EU data incidents, coordinating internal investigations and compliance reviews, managing strict notification timelines, and mitigating regulatory risk. 

- Partner with Waymo’s Public Policy, Trust & Safety, and Regulatory Affairs teams to monitor, review, and help shape emerging European privacy legislation, developing advocacy strategies to influence policy changes that support responsible innovation. 

You have: 

- A Juris Doctor (or equivalent law degree) and active qualification to practice law in Germany (e.g., Volljurist) or another relevant EU jurisdiction. 

- 8+ years of legal experience with significant expertise in European privacy, data protection, and regulatory compliance, preferably in-house at a global technology company. 

- Deep, practical expertise in the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and German national data protection laws (BDSG), with a track record of operationalizing these frameworks for complex data flows. 

- Direct experience engaging with European Data Protection Authorities (DPAs) and working with government or regulatory bodies to navigate rulemaking processes and compliance readiness. 

- Experience advising on cross-border data transfers, international data governance, and translating strict legal requirements into practical engineering specifications. 

- Professional fluency in both German and English, with exceptional ability to communicate legal risks clearly to leadership and technical teams in the face of ambiguity. 

We prefer: 

- Recognized European privacy certifications, such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT. 

- Prior in-house experience at a US-based multinational technology company, autonomous vehicle developer, or AI-focused enterprise navigating EU expansion. 

- Hands-on experience advising on the intersection of GDPR with emerging European technology and data regulations (e.g., the AI Act, Data Act), including experience providing counsel on proposed legislation. 

- Experience structuring and defending main establishment strategies (One-Stop-Shop) and data transfer frameworks for EU resident data. 

- Background in responding to privacy litigation, localized incident response, or managing comprehensive privacy compliance audits. 

- A technical background or strong fluency in data infrastructure, cloud computing, computer vision, or software engineering.

title: Deployment Strategist - German Speaking
description:
About HappyRobot 

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. 

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll do 

- Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.

- Scoping : Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.

- Prototyping : Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.

- Program Management : Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.

- Prioritization : Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.

- Customer Partnership : Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.

- Onsite Embedding : Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.

- Product Feedback Loop : Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have 

- Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.

- Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.

- Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.

- Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.

- Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.

- Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.

- Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us? 

- Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

- Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

- Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

- Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

- Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles 

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About pplwise 

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics 

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production.

About the role 

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.
Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments based on your analysis.

What you’ll do 

- Identify critical dependencies, lock in availability through supplier contracts, and qualify alternatives so no single source can stop production

- Set up the ERP and the systems the supply chain runs on, including supplier quality tracking

- Define clear quality criteria for suppliers and components together with Engineering

- Give the assembly team the forward visibility they need to plan builds

- Turn supply analysis into input for Leadership’s volume commitments

- Once supply is robust, reduce component prices toward a leaner bill of materials

About you 

- Several years in supply chain , procurement or sourcing for hardware products (e.g. robotics, automotive, machinery, electronics)

- Proven experience moving products from prototype to series production

- A solid grasp of BOMs, component sourcing, supplier qualification and supplier quality

- Strong negotiation skills and experience closing supplier contracts

- A hands-on, structured approach: you prioritize well, work comfortably without defined processes, and deliver

- Clear, concise communication in English and German

What Filics offers 

- Full ownership of a function you build yourself, with direct impact on getting the robots into series production

- A small, ambitious team where initiative leads to responsibility

- Work on a first-of-its-kind product in intralogistics

- An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

Verantwortung bekommt, wer Initiative zeigt und zuverlässig liefert. Als Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) bei Filics baust du die Lieferkette auf, mit der die Roboter in Serie gehen.

Über die Rolle 

Die Position ist onsite bzw. hybrid in München angesiedelt, nah an Engineering und Montage.
Die Roboter von Filics bestehen aus hunderten Komponenten. Viele davon kommen von nur einem Lieferanten, und die meisten sind noch nicht vertraglich abgesichert. Auf dem Weg vom Prototyp in die Serienfertigung kann ein einziges fehlendes Teil die ganze Linie stoppen. Deine Aufgabe ist deshalb, eine robuste Supply Chain von Grund auf aufzubauen. Sie soll genau wissen, wovon Filics abhängt, Risiken frühzeitig absichern und mit steigenden Stückzahlen mitwachsen, und das alles, während die Produktion bereits läuft. Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung dafür, wie jede Komponente beschafft, abgesichert und gemanagt wird.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering zusammen. Engineering verantwortet die technischen Spezifikationen und qualifiziert Lieferanten und alternative Bauteile. Die Montage braucht eine verlässliche Versorgung, um Builds zu planen. Die Geschäftsführung legt auf Basis deiner Analysen die Volumenzusagen fest.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Kritische Abhängigkeiten identifizieren, Verfügbarkeit über Lieferantenverträge sichern und Alternativen qualifizieren, damit keine Single-Source-Abhängigkeit die Produktion stoppt

- ERP und die Systeme aufbauen, auf denen die Supply Chain läuft, inklusive Tracking der Lieferantenqualität

- Gemeinsam mit Engineering klare Qualitätskriterien für Lieferanten und Komponenten definieren

- Der Montage die Vorausschau geben, die sie für die Planung der Builds braucht

- Supply-Analysen in Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Volumenzusagen der Geschäftsführung übersetzen

- Sobald die Versorgung steht, Komponentenpreise senken und die Stückliste (BOM) schlanker machen

Über Dich 

- Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Supply Chain , Einkauf oder Sourcing für Hardware-Produkte (z. B. Robotik, Automotive, Maschinenbau, Elektronik)

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung auf dem Weg vom Prototyp in die Serienfertigung

- Fundiertes Verständnis von Stücklisten, Komponentenbeschaffung, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Lieferantenqualität

- Ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick und Erfahrung im Abschluss von Lieferantenverträgen

- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit Hands-on-Mentalität: Du setzt die richtigen Prioritäten, arbeitest gern ohne festgelegte Prozesse und lieferst

- Klare, präzise Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch

Das bietet Filics 

- Volle Verantwortung für eine Funktion, die du selbst aufbaust, mit direktem Einfluss darauf, dass die Roboter in Serie gehen

- Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team, in dem Initiative zu Verantwortung führt

- Arbeit an einem Produkt, das es in der Intralogistik so noch nicht gibt

- Eine Onsite- bzw. Hybrid-Rolle in München, nah an Engineering und Montage

description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. 

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. 

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

Your responsibilities 

- Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down.

- Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy.

- Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it.

- Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently.

- Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling

- Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale.

About you 

- Proven experience in a deal desk, pricing, commercial, revenue operations, or sales-strategy role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience standing up or scaling a deal desk or pricing process from scratch is a plus.

- Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling.

- The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last

- Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

- Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team.

- A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job.

- Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments.

- Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment.

- Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking.

About Moss 

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: 

- Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

- Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

- Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package). 

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy .

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

What You Will Do

- 
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

- 
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

- 
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

- 
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- 
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

- 
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- 
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

-

description:
About BoWatt 

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and system engineering software for manufacturing . We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years . This will unlock massive value across several complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors , including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

You’ll join a small, exceptional team of startup builders, driven by innovation and execution. Over half the team are former founders across DeepTech AI, psychedelics, and gaming. We’ve studied and worked at top institutions and companies like Stanford, TUM, Google, EA , and YC -backed AI startups.

The role 

- Partner with our CEO, Steven, to set priorities, make trade-offs, and ensure the company stays focused on the work that matters most

- Take on whatever's breaking, slowing us down, or the bottleneck to our growth

- Drive important projects from definition through execution, working across fundraising, product, engineering, sales, customer success, people, and operations

- Own and improve key people operations, including hiring plans, recruiting processes, onboarding, team development, and company culture

- Impactful culture and energy setter across the company. Build deep relationships with everyone, be an "always on" context connector across the company.

- Take ownership wherever the company most needs it. The scope of the role will evolve alongside BoWatt

You 

- Exceptional Generalist : you are an exceptional generalist who can quickly understand unfamiliar problems and turn ambiguity into a clear plan

- Clear communicator : you write clearly, speak confidently, and know how to get to the point

- High judgment : you have strong judgment and know how to prioritize when everything feels important

- Speed : you thrive in a fast-moving startup environment where responsibilities are broad, priorities can change, and there is significant freedom to shape how the company operates

- Team-oriented : you build trust across different teams and can align people without relying on formal authority

- Ambitious: You set a high bar for yourself and care deeply about outcomes

What we offer 

- Competitive salary based on experience 

- Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool: 5–10% virtual equity package

- 25 vacation days/per yr, plus public holidays

- Company retreats

- WellPass membership

The Founders Pool

BoWatt’s Founders Pool is a dedicated virtual-equity pool for a small group of early team members who take responsibility for building and leading a major part of the company.

We created it because we want the people building BoWatt alongside us to participate meaningfully in the value they help create. These are not narrow execution roles with finished playbooks. You will own your vertical with co-founder-like autonomy and accountability: setting the standard, building the function, and being responsible for its results.

As our founding Customer Success hire, you will participate in the Founders Pool (5-10%) and have the opportunity to build Customer Success from the ground up. The precise allocation, vesting structure, and plan terms will be discussed transparently during the interview process.

- Reference calls

title: AI & Engineering Lehrkraft/Coach (all genders)
description:
Jobbeschreibung

Wir launchen aktuell ein neues, spannendes Trainingsprogramm: AI for Project Engineering – Teil einer umfassenden AI Academy , mit der wir Engineering-Teams fit für die KI-Ära machen, und suchen aktuell Verstärkung für unser Team.

Als KI & Engineering Lehrkraft/Coach bist Du die tägliche Anlaufstelle für unsere Lernenden: Du beantwortest ihre Fragen zu AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung, gängigen AI-Architekturen, MCP und Systemintegration und hilfst ihnen in Sandbox-Übungen, Hackathons und Client-Implementierungsprojekten weiter, wenn sie nicht mehr weiterkommen. Komplexere fachliche Fragen und Grenzfälle gibst Du an unseren Senior Coach weiter, der die Kick-off- und Closing-Events leitet, die Abschlussprojekte bewertet und die Trainingsinhalte verantwortet.

Durch den engen, täglichen Kontakt zu den Lernenden bekommst Du ein sehr gutes Gefühl dafür, wo es typischerweise hakt – dieses Feedback gibst Du direkt an den Senior Coach und das Learning-Team weiter. Diese Rolle passt gut zu Dir, wenn Du gerne Menschen unterstützt und Dich perspektivisch in Richtung Senior Coach, Learning & Development oder AI-Enablement weiterentwickeln möchtest – ganz ohne jahrelange Senior-Engineering- oder Curriculum-Design-Erfahrung.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

- Fachliche Beantwortung der alltäglichen Fragen der Lernenden (schriftlich und mündlich) zu AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung, gängigen AI-Architekturen, MCP und Systemintegration – als erste Anlaufstelle; komplexere Fälle bzw. Grenzfälle eskalierst Du an den Senior Coach

- Unterstützung der Lernenden in Sandbox-Übungen, Hackathons und Client-Implementierungsprojekten, wenn sie nicht weiterkommen – Du hilfst beim Entblocken, nicht bei der inhaltlichen Konzeption

- Durchführung individueller Coaching-Sessions zu Debugging, Code-Review-Grundlagen und Testautomatisierung

- Teilnahme an Digital Workshops und Hackathons als Support-Präsenz vor Ort

- Rückmeldung an den Senior Coach und das Learning-Team, wo Lernende häufig hängen bleiben – als Input für die Qualitätssicherung, nicht in eigener Verantwortung

- Unterstützung beim Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder

Das bringst Du mit

- Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar – oder fundierte praktische Erfahrung ohne Studienabschluss

- 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung als Software-Entwickler:in/Engineer (Junior bis Mid-Level, nicht Senior)

- Praktische Erfahrung im Einsatz von AI-Coding-Copiloten (z. B. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) in echten Projekten – eigene Architektur von agentenbasierten/RAG-Systemen ist nicht erforderlich, sicherer Umgang und Erklärbarkeit schon

- Arbeitswissen zu zentralen Software-Engineering-Praktiken: Testing, Debugging, grundlegendes CI/CD, Docker-Grundlagen

- Hohe Service-Orientierung, Empathie, Geduld und klare Kommunikation – das zählt hier besonders, da Du die primäre Lernenden-Schnittstelle bist

- Hands-on-Mentalität, Teamgeist, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

Nice to have (kein Muss) 

- Erste Berührungspunkte mit LLM-APIs, RAG, Agentenarchitekturen oder MCP (auch auf Hobby-/Projektebene)

- Informelle Lehr-, Mentoring-, Pairing- oder TA-Erfahrung mit weniger erfahrenen Entwickler:innen

- Grundlegendes Bewusstsein für AI-Governance-Themen (EU AI Act, Responsible AI) – hilfreich, aber erlernbar

- Erfahrung mit Cloud-Deployment

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur 

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten Multiverse StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership 

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation 

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch 

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung

title: Avionics System Engineer (Flight Computer System)
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run. 

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer (Flight Computer System) to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role entails delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you will be focused on the Flight Computing system of the spacecraft, but you might also be assigned to different avionics systems.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

- Define and develop avionics system architectures , including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

- Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements .

- Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

- Define computing requirements for processing capability, memory, storage, timing, synchronization, boot and initialization, and operational modes.

- Develop architectural concepts for fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR), fault containment, redundancy management, and autonomous spacecraft operations.

- Develop network topology, interface control documents (ICDs), data flow diagrams, communication matrices, and interface specifications.

Communications & Data Handling

- Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts .

- Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

- Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints.

- Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration & Interface Management

- Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

- Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

- Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification & Validation

- Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

- Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

- Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

- Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

- Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements .

- Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

- Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

- Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams.

- Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

- Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

- Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering , or equivalent.

- 5+ years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering .

- Strong understanding of:

- Electronic and embedded system architectures

- Communication and data handling principles

- System integration and interface management

- Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development .

- Knowledge of verification and validation methods , including testing and simulation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems .

- Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS).

- Experience with HIL testing, simulation environments, or digital engineering tools .

- Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.

- Experience working in international or multi-stakeholder engineering teams.

Why you should join us! 

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: 

- We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

- We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them 

- We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

title: Creative Designer (m/w/d)
description:
Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Du willst von grafischer Seite unmittelbar daran mitwirken, dass ein Onlineshop wächst – und in den Zahlen sehen, was dein Hook, dein Static, dein Banner bewegt? Dann bist du bei NEOLYMP richtig. Wir skalieren unseren Shop, und ein großer Teil davon entscheidet sich im Creative. Genau da sitzt du: als Creative Designer:in, der oder die aus Design- und Grafiksicht maßgeblich an unserer Performance mitwirkt. 

Wer wir sind 

NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop. 

Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt. 

Warum diese Rolle 

- Du bist Teil der Performance: Deine Creatives laufen im Paid-Marketing und entscheiden mit, wie profitabel wir skalieren. Du siehst in den Zahlen, welcher Hook funktioniert, welches Static klickt – und drehst mit jeder Iteration an einem Hebel, der direkt auf Umsatz wirkt.

- Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop.

- Bestes Rohmaterial: Du arbeitest mit Content aus echten Shootings und von echten Creatorn – kein Stockmaterial, sondern Persönlichkeiten und Produkte, die du in Szene setzt.

- Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen.

- KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

Aufgaben

Performance Creatives 

- Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound.

- Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter.

- Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein.

Social Media & Organic Content 

- Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform.

- Du entwickelst Templates, die dem Content-Team schnelle, markenkonforme Veröffentlichungen ermöglichen.

Shop, Amazon & Brand 

- Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für alle Bannerbilder, Kampagnen-Visuals und Shopbilder – von Landingpage-Headern.

- Du hältst unser visuelles Erscheinungsbild über alle Kanäle konsistent und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

Produktion & Workflow 

- Du integrierst KI-Tools in deinen Workflow – für Ideation, Bildvarianten, Freisteller, Übersetzungen oder Schnitt-Unterstützung – und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall 

- Schnitterfahrung: Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher – Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbar – und lieferst aus Rohmaterial eigenständig fertige, plattformgerechte Video-Creatives inklusive Schnittrhythmus, Text-Overlays, Untertiteln und Sound.

- Bildbearbeitung & Grafik: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma oder vergleichbare Tools sind dein Handwerkszeug. Freisteller, Retusche, Composings, Layouts und saubere Exportformate für Web, Social und Amazon gehen dir leicht von der Hand.

- Ein Portfolio, das beides zeigt – Video und Static.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Grafik-, Motion- oder Creative Designer:in, idealerweise im E-Commerce, D2C oder in einer Performance-Agentur.

- Ein Verständnis dafür, was Performance Creatives von schönen Grafiken unterscheidet: Hook, Klarheit, Tempo, Lesbarkeit auf dem Handy.

- Gespür für Social-Plattformen: Du weißt, wie Content auf TikTok, Instagram und Pinterest aussehen muss, um nicht weggewischt zu werden.

- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du jonglierst mehrere Aufträge parallel, hältst Deadlines und behältst den Überblick über Formate, Versionen und Assets.

Das zählt für uns am meisten 

- Lust darauf, wirklich das ganze visuelle Spektrum zu bespielen, Neugier auf neue Tools und die Motivation, mit der Rolle und dem Team zu wachsen. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus – für alles darüber hinaus ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil.

Nice to have 

- Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in der Bild- oder Videoproduktion (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs).

- Fotografie- oder Kamera-Erfahrung für Shootings.

title: Founding Growth Associate
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring 

- We're past product-market fit and growing 2x year on year, almost entirely through word of mouth, Google and AI search. Around 70 new leads land each month without a growth engine behind them, and you'll play a pivotal role in building one alongside the founders.

- Our co-founder Paddy is taking direct ownership of growth, and he wants a commercially minded builder alongside him: someone who'd rather make the thing than talk about it.

- You'll sit in the founders' office, working directly with Paddy on whatever moves the number most, from partnerships and events to building something that brings in 50 qualified leads in a month.

- The goal is 7,000 deals a year. Getting there depends on more of the right people finding us.

What you'll build 

You'll work directly with Paddy , our co-founder, with the freedom to try things fast and the backing to scale what works

- Growth mechanisms: Lead magnets, micro products, tools and campaigns that bring syndicate leads and fund managers to Odin. You build the actual thing with AI, not a strategy deck about it. Think a calculator every new fund manager bookmarks, or a tool that turns a syndicate lead's first deal into a week's work instead of a month's. Ship it, see what works, double down.

- Partnerships: Co-investors, syndicate networks, accelerators and fund admins already talk to the people we want to reach. You find the ones who can send us the right people and get them live.

- Events: Pitch nights, GP-LP mixers and founder dinners for a community that backs everything from AI labs to small nuclear reactors. You'll turn that into new customers.

- Referrals and repeat: Our existing customers already come back again and again. You'll build the ways they bring others with them.

- Special projects: The founders' office gets the problems that matter and don't have an owner yet. You'll pick them up, work out what's true and get them done.

What we're looking for 

- Exceptionally sharp: At least a couple of years in a role that's trained you to think fast and rigorously. That might be consulting, banking, VC, a founder associate or chief of staff role, or early-stage growth.

- A commercially minded builder: You love making things, and you think about who they're for and whether they'll move the number before you start.

- You build with AI: You ship things yourself rather than waiting for someone else to execute your ideas, and you can show us what you've made.

- Analytical and financially literate: You're comfortable with numbers, you can tell what's working from the data, and you understand how capital moves.

- Taste and creative flair: You know what will land with a sophisticated audience of investors and founders, and what won't.

- Fast-moving and self-directed: You make decisions without constant validation and you'd rather ship something today than perfect it next month.

- Outcomes over activity: Pipeline and revenue are what you optimise for, not impressions or output volume.

- Credible with investors: Comfortable on a call with a seasoned GP or in a room full of them.

- Big plus: private markets exposure: VC, angel syndicates or fund admin. Useful, but not required.

How we work 

There are five things we care about deeply:

- Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

- Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

- Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

- Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

This role is probably not for you if

- You'd rather write the strategy than build and ship the thing yourself;

- You need a team underneath you to get things done;

title: Technical Programme Manager
description:
About us 

EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets.

The role 

You will lead our clients through the organisational and operational changes needed to establish a shared AI platform. The platform has two parts: an AI Control Plane that governs what agents may do and records the evidence, and a managed AI Runtime where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services, and both need owners, approval routes and support arrangements on the client side.

You will own delivery outcomes from mobilisation through production release and operating handover, acting as the client sponsor's day-to-day counterpart. The role reaches across engineering, business leadership, security, risk, compliance and operations. You will bring these groups together to agree how the platform is governed and supported, and what evidence they need for assurance in a regulated environment.

You will lead an EggAI delivery team with a mix of Platform Engineering roles and skills. Client application teams develop the business use cases; you lead AI platform delivery and the changes needed for teams to adopt and operate it.

Why this role 

Most organisations are still working out how to let AI agents act safely in production: who approves what an agent may do, how its actions are evidenced, and who answers when something goes wrong. There is no settled playbook yet, especially in regulated industries. In this role you will help write it. The operating models, approval routes and assurance practices you design with our clients will shape how they run agentic AI for years, and they will become the basis of how EggAI delivers across Europe.

You will work at the point where AI capability meets enterprise reality, with direct access to client sponsors and EggAI leadership, and with real influence over how a growing company builds its delivery practice.

Responsibilities 

- Own the delivery plan and milestones, keeping commitments achievable within the agreed scope, budget and team capacity.
- Secure the client commitments that delivery depends on. Agree who will provide access, complete service changes and make decisions, then resolve delays with the responsible teams.
- Design the target operating model with the client. Define who owns the platform service, maintains policies and software, supports the runtime and approves changes, with agreed escalation routes.
- Run milestone acceptance. Submit evidence for each milestone, secure recorded client decisions within agreed review periods and escalate overdue or disputed decisions.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

- Generous Annual Leave Policy:  We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

At Anduril Australia we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface and other domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require a Senior Electrical Engineer with deep electrical system design experience to architect and deliver critical systems and sub-systems. The Senior Electrical Engineer strives to leverage their experience with Electrical and Power Systems to rapidly architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation autonomous vehicles through the entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

- Drive the development and design of innovative electrical systems and products that meet the unique requirements of our company.

- Collaborate with other engineers and team members to integrate electrical systems into larger product designs

- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business objectives into clear electrical engineering deliverables.

- Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, test procedures, and technical reports.

- Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulations, and safety requirements throughout the product development lifecycle.

- Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and testing to evaluate system performance and optimise efficiency.

- Troubleshoot complex electrical engineering challenges and provide innovative and practical solutions in a rapid development environment.

- Hold and deliver to project timelines, milestones, managing your time and budgets to achieve successful project outcomes.

- Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in electrical engineering and proactively apply new knowledge to improve our products.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

- Proven experience in a senior role within defence, tech or any fast-paced environment, driving successful electrical engineering projects from concept to market launch.

- Expertise in electrical engineering principles, techniques, and technologies, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions.

- Proficiency in using industry-standard electrical design and simulation software.

- Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor junior engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.

- Strong time management and organisational abilities, with a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time and within budget.

- Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and adapt to diverse and evolving challenges.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Familiarity with fast paced environment best practices, including agility, adaptability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

- Passion for technology and a curiosity to stay updated with the latest advancements in the industry.

- Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance (NV2).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience designing electrical and power systems for unmanned vehicles.

- Experience in the subsea or maritime domain

- Experience working on defence programs and familiarity with current Defence standards.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits 

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

- 
No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work.

description:
About BJAK 

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location 

This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Supply Planner
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

As a Supply Planner, your role is crucial in optimising the flow of materials from suppliers into our operations. You function as the primary analytical link between strategic purchasing decisions and operational inventory needs. Your main mission is to ensure optimal stock availability (raw materials, components) while driving cost efficiency and minimising risks of shortages or obsolescence.

You actively collaborate with the Procurement team to integrate market insights into tangible planning actions.

Responsibilities 

Operational Planning and Procurement Strategy Support 

- Demand Translation: Analyze sales forecasts and production schedules to accurately determine raw material and component requirements (MRP/DRP).

- Supplier Ordering: Generate, send, and monitor purchase orders (POs) based on planning requirements, ensuring alignment with procurement contracts and volume agreements.

- Inventory Optimization: Define, monitor, and adjust planning parameters (safety stock, reorder points, EOQ) in the ERP to maintain target inventory levels and reduce working capital.

Supplier Performance and Risk Management 

- OTD Monitoring: Track and report on supplier performance metrics (On Time Delivery - OTD, lead time compliance) and proactively highlight potential delivery risks to the Procurement Manager.

- Risk Analysis: Identify and anticipate potential supply disruptions (e.g., transport delays, capacity issues) and develop mitigation plans in collaboration with the Purchasing team.

- Dispute Coordination: Serve as the planning focal point for resolving delivery and quantity discrepancies with suppliers, escalating critical issues to the Procurement Manager.

Process Improvement and Reporting 

- Reporting & Dashboards: Develop and maintain detailed analytical reports and dashboards to monitor supply performance, inventory health, and forecast accuracy.

- Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the procure-to-pay and planning processes, proposing solutions and leading small-scale improvement projects.

- Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy of planning-related master data within the ERP system (lead times, MOQs, safety stocks).

Candidate Requirements 

- Educational Background: Master's level degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Production Management, or Engineering (with a focus on logistics/industrial specialisation).

- 5+ years of professional experience in a similar planning, procurement, or logistics role, demonstrating mastery of planning tools (MRP/DRP).

- Fluency in both English and French (written and spoken) is essential for interacting with international suppliers and teams.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel and Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

- In-depth knowledge of a major ERP (SAP, Oracle) and/or a dedicated planning tool (APS).

- Ability to manage a high volume of SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) and data.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills for working cross-functionally (Procurement, Production, Logistics).

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Software Engineer (Golang), Managed K8s
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE TEAM 

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on.

THE ROLE 

You will build our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute.

Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

- Design and ship the control plane. You own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions — scheduling, operators, provisioning, node lifecycle.

- Own the reliability of the Kubernetes control plane. It is the team's headline KPI. You make the calls when it breaks at 3am.

- Shrink the distance from metal to on-demand. Provisioning a cluster should be minutes of automation, not weeks of tickets.

- Partner with Product Managers to set priorities, scope initiatives, and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

- Raise the engineering bar through code review and knowledge sharing across the Cloud Platform org.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

- You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

- You have run Kubernetes in anger — and ideally built parts of it: operators, schedulers, controllers. You understand what happens underneath it, and you have worked on Linux directly, not just on managed services that sit on top of it.

- You have run GPU workloads on Kubernetes, or you are confident you can own that domain fast.

- You think like a developer who happens to build infrastructure, not an operator who manages it. You write code other engineers depend on.

- Extensive experience building backend or infrastructure systems.

- You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

- A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .

Privacy Policy 

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy .

This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production.

What You Will Do 

- Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses.

- Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss.

- Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack.

What We're Looking For 

- A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

- Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required.

- Research experience of some form: a thesis, publications, a dedicated research project, or efficiency-oriented work in a lab or industry research setting. A PhD is not required, but we are looking for genuine research depth.

- A track record of conducting experiments: forming hypotheses, designing controlled comparisons, and drawing clear conclusions from results.

- Familiarity with the state of the art in LLM inference — you know what has been tried, what works, and where the open problems are.

- Self-starter, low-ego, and collaborative. You are comfortable with ambiguity, negative results, and are eager to take matters into your own hands.

- Inference or serving experience is a plus, not a requirement. Prior work with vLLM, production LLM deployments, or serving systems will help you ramp up faster.

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.
