title: Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt.

Je bent een ervaren monteur die graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt, maar ook energie krijgt van het begeleiden van anderen. Je gaat samen met je team op pad, bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de installaties en helpt ons om steeds meer monteurs op te leiden.

Je komt dus niet in een bestaand team terecht. Je helpt het team zelf opbouwen. 

Wat ga je doen? 

Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen.

Je installeert warmtepompen en leidt je team 

- Je gaat samen met een collega-monteur op pad om onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis te installeren.

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige installatie, van de technische uitvoering en het oplossen van onverwachte problemen tot de oplevering.

- Je zorgt dat installaties veilig, efficiënt en volgens onze kwaliteitsstandaarden worden uitgevoerd.

- Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor de klant tijdens de installatie. Je legt uit wat jullie doen, beantwoordt vragen en zorgt dat de klant met een goed gevoel achterblijft.

- Je stemt waar nodig af met onze werkvoorbereiders en collega's op kantoor over planning, materialen en technische uitdagingen.

Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam 

- Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren.

- Je denkt mee over het aannemen van nieuwe collega's en hoe we ons installatieteam verder kunnen uitbreiden.

- Je helpt onze installatiestandaarden en werkwijzen verder te ontwikkelen.

- Je signaleert wat er in de praktijk beter of slimmer kan en neemt initiatief om dit te verbeteren.

- Je deelt feedback vanuit het veld met onze engineers, werkvoorbereiders en productontwikkelaars, zodat we onze producten en installaties continu kunnen verbeteren.

Wie zoeken wij? 

We zoeken iemand die zijn vak goed verstaat, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het leuk vindt om anderen beter te maken. Je hoeft niet eerder een heel team te hebben opgebouwd, maar je moet wel zin hebben om die uitdaging aan te gaan.

- Je hebt ruime ervaring met het installeren van warmtepompen, cv-installaties of andere verwarmingssystemen. Ervaring met warmtepompen heeft een sterke voorkeur.

- Je hebt een goede technische basis in installatietechniek, elektrotechniek en/of werktuigbouwkunde.

- Je kunt zelfstandig installaties uitvoeren, technische tekeningen lezen en onverwachte problemen oplossen.

- Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van andere monteurs, of bent klaar om die verantwoordelijkheid op je te nemen.

- Je werkt nauwkeurig en veilig en vindt het belangrijk om goed werk af te leveren.

- Je communiceert makkelijk met klanten en collega's en kunt technische zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen.

- Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat.

- Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt rijbewijs B.

Een relevante mbo-opleiding en certificeringen zoals VCA, NEN 3140 of CO-vakmanschap zijn mooi meegenomen. Heb je nog niet alle benodigde certificaten? Dan kijken we samen wat je nog kunt behalen.

Wat bieden wij jou? 

- Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

- Een sleutelrol in ons bedrijf: je wordt de eerste Hoofdmonteur van ons interne installatieteam en helpt dit verder uit te bouwen.

- Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: je krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we installeren, samenwerken en nieuwe monteurs opleiden.

- Goed materiaal: een volledig uitgeruste werkbus en professioneel gereedschap.

- 26 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen op basis van 40 uur, met de mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een hogere beloning in plaats van ADV.

- Een goede pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek.

- Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zowel technisch als in het begeleiden en aansturen van een team.

- Een betrokken team met korte lijnen, weinig bureaucratie en regelmatig leuke activiteiten, van borrels en teamuitjes tot onze jaarlijkse wintersport.

Waarom DeWarmte? 

Bij DeWarmte geloven we dat verduurzaming pas echt werkt als het voor iedereen bereikbaar en aantrekkelijk is. Daarom ontwikkelen we slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen die we zelf ontwerpen en assembleren.

We zijn een groeiend bedrijf waar veel gebeurt en waar je echt invloed hebt op hoe we dingen aanpakken. We houden van mensen die initiatief nemen, samenwerken en niet wachten tot iemand anders een probleem oplost.

Als Hoofdmonteur krijg je de kans om vanaf het begin mee te bouwen aan onze eigen installatieorganisatie. Je werkt zelf aan mooie technische installaties, leidt nieuwe monteurs op en helpt bepalen hoe we dit in de toekomst op grotere schaal gaan doen.

Klaar om samen met ons iets op te bouwen? 

Solliciteer en kom kennismaken. We vertellen je graag meer over DeWarmte, onze warmtepompen en onze plannen voor het interne installatieteam.

Compensation: €4K – €6K per month

title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
AI Engineer
description:
Who are we? 

Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence. 

Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses. 

Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore. 

How we work 

- Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data. 

- Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer. 

- Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted. 

What will you do? 

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents. 

- The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead. 

- The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real. 

- Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins. 

- Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view. 

- Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks. 

In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models. 

Who are you? 

- You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering. 

- In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos. 

- You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data. 

- You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one. 

- You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting. 

- Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed. 

The team 

You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it. 

The stack 

- Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI 

- LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents. 

- Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire 

- Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector 

- Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions 

What do we offer? 

- Competitive base salary and annual bonus linked to your performance / OKRs 

- Attractive benefits including health & wellbeing allowance, work-from-home budget, learning & coaching benefits, etc. 

- Flexible hybrid working model with 3 days per week in our Amsterdam office 

- Healthy work-life balance allowing for planability and personal commitments 

- Chance to grow with the company gaining increasing responsibilities, supported by lots of coaching and a feedback-driven approach 

- Tremendous learning and career progression opportunities 

- International environment with hubs in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore 

- Culture of trust, ownership and standard of excellence and a fun working atmosphere with regular outings and events 

- Post product-market fit and aspiring unicorn status - this is an excellent time to join & grow with us! 

Does this sound like a perfect match? 

We are proud of our wonderful product and believe it has lots of potential. We are growing fast and having fun while building our platform and company. Does this sound like a team you would like to become a part of? Click ‘Apply’ and submit your CV, we are excited to get to know you and show you what we do!

title: Director, European Strategic Communications
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM 

Anduril's global communications team is responsible for shaping how the world understands modern defense technology—and why it matters. We're seeking a Director of Communications, Europe, to build and lead Anduril's external communications presence across the continent.

This is a senior individual contributor role based in Amsterdam, reporting to the VP of Global Communications, with a dotted line to Anduril's European General Manager. You will be Anduril's first dedicated communications hire in Europe, responsible for standing up a regional program from scratch, building relationships with media and institutions, and developing the narratives that will define Anduril's reputation across the world's most consequential defense markets.

This is a builder role. You'll set strategy and execute it yourself, establish agency and contractor networks as the business grows, and work shoulder-to-shoulder with business development, policy, and senior leadership to earn Anduril a place in Europe's defense conversation. The ideal candidate has deep roots across multiple European markets, understands how defense, technology, and industrial policy intersect at the national level, and knows how to build presence and credibility in environments where trust is earned slowly and reputation matters enormously.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Build Anduril's European communications program from the ground up, developing strategy, establishing infrastructure, and executing across markets with varying levels of maturity and priority.

- Drive media relations across defense, technology, business, and policy outlets in priority European markets, building the relationships and pipelines that will sustain long-term coverage.

- Develop and execute market-specific narrative strategies that connect Anduril's mission and capabilities to each country's defense priorities, industrial ambitions, and security context.

- Work closely with Anduril's European General Manager and business development teams to support market entry, customer engagement, partnerships, and key events.

- Build and manage a network of regional agencies and contractors as European operations expand.

- Partner with global communications, policy, and marketing teams to adapt core messaging for European audiences without losing coherence or accuracy.

- Engage think tanks, research institutions, and policy communities to build credibility and shape the broader discourse around defense innovation and allied cooperation.

- Own metrics and reporting frameworks to track progress and demonstrate impact across markets.

QUALIFICATIONS 

- 10+ years of experience in communications, public affairs, or media relations.

- Fluency in the European defense and political landscape across multiple countries, how decisions get made, who shapes opinion, and where the conversation is heading.

- A track record of building communications programs in new markets, not just inheriting them.

- Experience managing agencies, contractors, and regional communications networks across borders.

- Exceptional writing and strategic thinking, with the ability to develop narratives that land across cultures and audiences.

- Comfortable working autonomously in an early-stage market environment, with the judgment to make calls without a lot of process around you.

You'll excel in this role if you:

- Have built something before, a market presence, a regional program, a communications function, and know what that actually requires.

- Can hold complexity: different countries, different threat perceptions, different industrial interests, all requiring distinct approaches under a coherent strategy.

title: Solution Engineer I
description:
Build with us 

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact 

As a Solutions Engineer I in the Connect team, you'll support the partners who bring processing volume to Mollie, think SaaS platforms and marketplaces. Your core activities are discovery, solution design, and implementation support for partner deals, the work that turns a promising conversation into a working integration.

Beyond the deal itself, you'll join forecasting meetings with the Connect leadership team to give an honest, objective view of technical deal health, and you'll have regular one-on-ones with the partner acquisition managers you support to align on deal details and next steps. You'll also support events and pitches for the commercial team and contribute to process improvement and internal product feedback, so the lessons from one deal make the next one easier.

Solutions Engineers are the bridge between technical and commercial teams at Mollie. Strong discovery means partners get solutions that actually fit, pricing negotiations become smoother, and partner needs and product issues make their way back into the business. That's a direct line to how Mollie expands into new products and partner segments.

What you'll ship 

- Lead technical discovery sessions to deeply understand and map complex merchant requirements.

- Design and present tailored payment solutions, clearly mapping Mollie’s APIs and products to specific business needs.

- Build and deliver custom demos, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical workshops that prove our value.

- Act as the technical expert in the room, partnering with Account Executives to overcome objections and close strategic deals.

- Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering teams, channeling critical merchant feedback to help shape our product roadmap.

What you'll bring 

- 2 to 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing, technical role.

- Customer-facing experience with a technical product, such as pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical customer success

- Comfortable working with APIs, with the ability to demo and build solutions on top of them

- Strong discovery skills: understanding what a partner needs and judging what's feasible with the product

- Ability to explain a complex product, including payment methods, sub-products, and the Connect proposition, to both technical and commercial audiences

- Experience working with both internal and external senior executives stakeholders

- A technically curious, commercially minded, and customer-minded approach, with clear rules of engagement, comfortable saying no and pushing back when needed

Grow your way 

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie 

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Senior Uitvoerder kabels & leidingen Railinfra
description:
Ambitie 
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen. 

Als senior uitvoerder kabels & leidingen werk je aan ondergrondse infra rond het spoor en op stations door heel Nederland. Je stuurt uitvoerders, vakmensen en onderaannemers aan, houdt meerdere belangen bij elkaar en zorgt dat het werk doorgaat. Ook als de planning verandert of de situatie buiten anders blijkt dan gedacht. Je krijgt daarbij te maken met onder andere telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Dit ga je doen 
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen . Als uitvoerder 3 kabels & leidingen stuur je medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers aan en houd je grip op planning, kwaliteit en kosten. 

Je werkt aan ondergrondse infra binnen onze railprojecten, zoals telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Je stuurt één of meerdere projecten tegelijk aan en houdt het overzicht, ook als het anders loopt dan gepland. Je gaat: 

- je team aansturen en motiveren , met duidelijke afspraken en ruimte voor vakmanschap; 

- veiligheid vooropzetten en collega's stimuleren risico’s en verbeteringen te delen; 

- plannen en bijsturen , prioriteiten stellen en knopen doorhakken als dat nodig is; 

- kwaliteit en kosten bewaken , inclusief het meer- en minderwerk; 

- schakelen met betrokken partijen , van je team en collega's tot ProRail, OV-bedrijven en netbeheerders; 

- verbeteringen aanjagen door kritisch te kijken, te luisteren en goede ideeën om te zetten in actie. 

Je hoeft niet overal zelf naast te staan. Maar als het erop aankomt, weet jij wat er buiten speelt, ben je er en neem je een besluit. 

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. 

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. 

Dit verwachten wij van jou 
Je bent een ervaren uitvoerder die overzicht houdt en duidelijk communiceert. Je weet wanneer je ruimte kunt geven en wanneer jij degene bent die een beslissing moet nemen. Voor deze rol breng je mee: 

- relevante ervaring met het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van ondergrondse infraprojecten; 

- ervaring met het aansturen van medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers; 

- een technische basis, bijvoorbeeld vanuit civiele techniek, elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde; 

- een scherpe blik op veiligheid, kwaliteit, planning en kosten; 

- het vermogen om rustig te blijven, prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen; 

- de communicatieve kracht om verschillende partijen bij elkaar te brengen; 

- bereidheid om te werken wanneer het spoorwerk daarom vraagt, ook buiten reguliere werktijden. 

We verwachten niet dat je ieder probleem zelf oplost. Wel dat je ervoor zorgt dat problemen op tafel komen, de juiste mensen betrokken zijn en er uiteindelijk een besluit wordt genomen. 

Waarom Dura Vermeer Railinfra? 
Hier krijg je de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen én verantwoordelijkheid te nemen . Je organiseert je werk met veel zelfstandigheid en krijgt mogelijkheden om jezelf via opleidingen verder te ontwikkelen. 

En je werkt niet zomaar aan kabels en leidingen. Jouw werk is onderdeel van railprojecten waarin verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Dat vraagt om samenwerken, vooruitkijken en beslissingen nemen als het buiten anders loopt dan gepland. 

Veilig werken staat daarbij voorop. In hoe je het werk organiseert, je team aanstuurt en de keuzes die je buiten maakt. 

Wij hebben oog voor jou 

Dura Vermeer is een grote organisatie waarin je veel kunt leren en waarin je kansen hebt om je ambities vorm te geven. Daarbij hechten we veel waarde aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief. We hebben goede arbeidsvoorwaarden conform CAO Railinfrastructuur (RIS). Dus bieden we je onder meer: 

- Een goed salaris afhankelijk van de meegebrachte kennis, niveau en werkervaring beginnend bij € 4.620,- tot € 5.775,- bruto per 4 weken en dus 13 maal per jaar!; 

- 25 vakantiedagen + 18 ADV dagen (beide op fulltime basis) 

- Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een standaard verzekering van alle werknemersrisico’s, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. 

- Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden en thuiswerken en moderne verlofvormen voor onder meer ouderschap, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of een sabbatical. 

- Voor verse vaders: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens je (aanvullende) geboorteverlof. 

- Een zeer goede beloning wanneer je de nachten of weekenden gaat werken 

- Veel aandacht voor jouw groei, met onze eigen Dura Vermeer academie en een vergoeding in tijd en geld voor zowel vak- als loopbaangerichte opleidingen. 

- Een mobiliteitsbudget of een leaseauto met grote keuzevrijheid. Smartphone en een laptop of tablet van de zaak. 

- Een vitaliteitsprogramma en een individueel keuzebudget voor duurzame inzetbaarheid. 

- En last but not least: fijne collega’s die in een professionele omgeving zorgen voor een ongekend goede werksfeer.

title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

- Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events

- Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them

- Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading

- Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise

- Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible

- Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales

- Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models

- Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper

- Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems

- Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

- Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning

- No active backlogs

- Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++

- Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects

- Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking

- A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

description:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Account Business Reviews (ABR’s) vormen de rode draad in de gesprekken tussen onze accountmanagers en klanten. Tijdens deze periodieke meetings staan de samenwerking, prestaties, aandachtspunten, kansen en gezamenlijke vervolgstappen centraal. De voorbereiding kost nu veel tijd, omdat relevante informatie uit verschillende systemen en bronnen handmatig moet worden verzameld en samengevoegd.

Jouw uitdaging is om te onderzoeken hoe informatie uit verschillende systemen binnen een veilige en gecontroleerde omgeving automatisch kan worden samengebracht en verwerkt tot een professioneel ABR-rapport. AI helpt bij het structureren, samenvatten en formuleren van relevante inzichten, aanbevelingen en onderwerpen voor het komende gesprek. Zo help je accountmanagers om beter voorbereid en met meer focus aan tafel te zitten.

Ook na de meeting speelt AI een belangrijke rol. Je onderzoekt hoe gesprekken efficiënt kunnen worden samengevat, hoe besluiten en actiepunten worden vastgelegd en hoe de gemaakte afspraken terugkomen in het rapport of in een bevestiging aan de klant. De uiteindelijke oplossing staat niet vooraf vast. Jij bepaalt op basis van gebruikersbehoeften, beschikbare data, AI-mogelijkheden en technische haalbaarheid welke aanpak het beste bij Voortman past.

BEOOGD RESULTAAT

Het beoogde resultaat is een onderbouwd advies met een gevalideerd AI-concept of prototype voor het ABR-proces. De oplossing ondersteunt de voorbereiding, uitvoering en opvolging van klantgesprekken en laat zien hoe informatie uit verschillende bronnen kan worden omgezet in een bruikbaar rapport, concrete afspraken en heldere klantcommunicatie. De aanpak moet praktisch toepasbaar, betrouwbaar en schaalbaar zijn binnen Voortman. 

Wij vragen

- Hbo- of Wo-opleiding in de richting van Business IT & Management, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, Commerciële Economie, Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde of vergelijkbaar. 

- Je bent handig met AI en hebt affiniteit met data, procesverbetering en commerciële klantprocessen. 

Wij bieden

- Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

- Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

- Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

- Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
Wat ga je doen? 

Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen. 

Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn. 

Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s. 

Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. De dagelijkse coördinatie van deze verschillende activiteiten en de aansturing van de Finance-afdeling wordt verzorgd door de Finance-director, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders. 

Wat maakt deze rol uniek? 

In deze rol krijg je de kans om zichtbaar richting te geven aan de volgende groeifase van Voortman Steel Machinery. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en slagkracht samenkomen: ideeën worden niet alleen verkend, maar ook scherp getoetst op waardecreatie, rendement, risico en schaalbaarheid. Daarmee krijg je ruimte om jouw financiële expertise en strategisch vermogen in te zetten bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe proposities, het onderbouwen van businesscases en het bepalen van investeringskeuzes die impact hebben op de internationale groei van de organisatie. Dit maakt de functie nadrukkelijk méér dan een traditionele CFO-rol: je bewaakt niet alleen de financiële basis, maar bent medebepalend in hoe Voortman Steel Machinery commerciële kansen vertaalt naar gezonde, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige groei. 

Positie binnen de organisatie 

Voortman Steel Machinery ontwikkelt machines, software en serviceoplossingen waarmee staalverwerkende bedrijven hun productieprocessen automatiseren en optimaliseren. Het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Nederland. Dankzij vestigingen in verschillende landen kan effectieve lokale ondersteuning worden geboden. De recent geopende, grootschalige productielocatie in de Verenigde Staten laat zien hoe de organisatie internationaal blijft groeien. Tevens vindt in Engeland hoofdzakelijk de ontwikkeling van onze LogicSteel-software plaats. Daarnaast bezit Voortman wereldwijd diverse sales & service-hubs. 

Als CFO vorm je samen met de CEO en COO de board van Voortman Steel Machinery, geef je met hen richting aan de ontwikkeling van het Global Management Team en de organisatie als geheel. Jouw focus ligt op het vertalen van de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete kansen voor nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met de afdeling Product Management, dat verantwoordelijk is voor het identificeren en ontwikkelen van software-, machine- en serviceproposities. Als CFO ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de Finance-afdeling en werk je nauw samen met de Finance Director, die de dagelijkse internationale operationele aansturing van de afdeling verzorgt. Tevens rapporteren de HR-Manager en Trade Compliance Officer aan jou. De HR-Manager is (mede) verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van de HR-strategie en het borgen van de operationele uitvoering. Daarnaast ziet de Trade Compliance Officer erop toe dat de organisatie voldoet aan de relevante wet- en regelgeving. Daarbij bewaakt de Trade Compliance Officer onder andere de inhoudelijke juistheid en werking van ingezette maatregelen. 

Wat wij bieden? 

Bij Voortman Steel Machinery kom je terecht in een écht familiebedrijf met een informele, betrokken en ondernemende cultuur. Mensen kennen elkaar en lijnen zijn kort. Er is volop ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, initiatief te tonen en ideeën verder te brengen. Onze kernwaarden ondernemerschap, vakmanschap, passie voor technologie, toewijding en samenwerking vormen daarbij de basis voor hoe we werken en met elkaar omgaan. Je ziet ze terug in de trots waarmee we hoogwaardige technologie ontwikkelen, in de manier waarop teams elkaar versterken en in de gezamenlijke drive om klanten vooruit te helpen. Zo ontstaat een werkomgeving waarin ambitie, betrokkenheid en werkplezier op een natuurlijke manier samenkomen. 

Naast een professionele, ondernemende en loyale werkomgeving krijg je bij ons: 

- Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring; 

- Een passende pensioenregeling bij ASR, waarbij jij en Voortman samen pensioenkapitaal opbouwen; 

- Een leaseauto voor zakelijk en privégebruik; 

- Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze strategie met internationale impact; 

- Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen; 

Wat breng je mee? 

Wij zoeken een ondernemende, strategische en daadkrachtige CFO met een afgeronde masteropleiding in Finance, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Een titel als RA, RC of CPA is een must. Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als CFO, Divisie-CFO, Senior Finance Director, Head of Finance of Director Corporate Finance, bij voorkeur binnen een internationale original equipment manufacturer (OEM), industrieel technologiebedrijf, technisch complexe B2B-organisatie of top-tier consultancybureau. Ervaring binnen een ondernemend familiebedrijf of een organisatie van vergelijkbare omvang en complexiteit is daarbij een pré. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met aansturen van een finance-afdeling of -team. Verder voldoe je aan het volgende profiel: 

- Strategisch en analytisch vermogen: je beschikt over sterk analytisch en strategisch vermogen en hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het doorgronden van complexe data en businessmodellen. Je weet informatie te vertalen naar heldere strategische en financiële logica, logische transparante aannames en goed onderbouwde besluitvorming. Je bent in staat om richting te bepalen, langetermijndoelen te formuleren en de organisatie daarin mee te nemen. 

- Businessmodelinnovatie: je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het in kaart brengen van groeikansen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe (schaalbare) verdien-, prijs- en contractmodellen. Deze weet je te onderbouwen met solide businesscases en scenarioanalyses. Daarnaast heb je ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieringsmodellen en het inrichten van kapitaalallocatie op basis van het (verwachte) rendement, risico’s en strategische bijdrage. 

- Besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht: je bent besluitvaardig en kunt tijdig en doordacht keuzes maken op basis van beschikbare informatie. Als je éénmaal een keuze hebt gemaakt, durf je achter je keuze te blijven staan. Je beschikt over overtuigingskracht, kunt draagvlak creëren en interne en externe stakeholders zorgvuldig meenemen in strategische veranderingen. Tevens stuur je actief op concrete resultaten en realiseer je aantoonbare positieve financiële impact. 

- Verandervermogen en omgevingsbewustzijn: je hebt ervaring met het realiseren van interne veranderingen en de implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen, evenals het tijdig bijsturen daarvan. Tevens ben je sterk in het vertalen van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen naar heldere, beheersbare processen en rollen. Daarbij zorg je voor een gestructureerde stapsgewijze implementatie en ben je sterk in het meenemen en begeleiden van collega’s tijdens veranderingen. Ook onder druk en in complexe situaties blijf je rustig, behoud je overzicht en kun je snel schakelen. Tevens heb je een scherp oog voor verhoudingen, kun je belangen goed afwegen en anticipeer je tijdig op ontwikkelingen. Daarbij heb je een goed begrip van culturele en organisatorische verschillen in een internationale context. 

- Verbindend vermogen en communicatie: je bent betrokken en weet duurzame professionele relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders, zoals banken, accountants en verzekeraars. Je communiceert helder, informeert betrokkenen tijdig over relevante ontwikkelingen en bent benaderbaar. Je weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk over te brengen en stemt je communicatie af op verschillende gesprekspartners. Daarnaast beschik je over sterke Nederlandse en Engelse communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. 

- Inspirerend leiderschap: jouw leiderschap is gericht op groei, vertrouwen en ontwikkeling. Je weet medewerkers te coachen, te inspireren en richting te geven, terwijl je ruimte geeft voor eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid. Daarbij stuur je bij waar nodig, stimuleer je samenwerking en help je collega’s hun potentieel te benutten. Zo draag je bij aan een omgeving waarin mensen zich betrokken voelen en werken aan gezamenlijke doelen. 

- Onafhankelijke en reflectieve houding: je hebt een onafhankelijke, kritische en constructieve houding, staat open voor feedback, kunt je eigen handelen kritisch evalueren en wilt continu blijven leren. 

Nieuwsgierig? 

Ben jij dé ondernemende en daadkrachtige Chief Financial Officer (CFO) die strategie weet te vertalen naar waarde, nieuwe verdienmodellen tot leven brengt, internationale groei mede realiseert en de organisatie met visie en resultaatgerichtheid stuurt? Solliciteer dan nu en word onderdeel van onze organisatie! Na ontvangst beoordelen wij jouw sollicitatie en nemen we binnen twee werkdagen contact met je op. Zijn wij net als jij positief, dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een eerste sollicitatiegesprek op locatie. Bij een positieve uitkomst volgt een tweede en mogelijk derde sollicitatiegesprek. title: Sales Director (International), OTE €150.000 per year | Breda
description:
You hit targets. But what you really want is to build. 

You know how to deliver ARR targets. What really gets you going is building a sales organisation that’s ready for the next stage of growth. Sound like you? Read on. 

Your role
As Sales Director, you’re the CCO’s operational and tactical right hand on sales management. The CCO holds ultimate responsibility for the group result and the strategic relationships. You make sure we deliver our ARR targets, day in, day out. You keep the sales team sharp, focused and on track. Customer Success and expansion also fall under your leadership.

This is explicitly more than running today’s team. You help build tomorrow’s. You translate the group’s growth strategy (vertical specialisation, internationalisation and portfolio expansion) into the commercial capacity and structure we’ll need next. You also help build the playbook that lets sales teams from new acquisitions integrate smoothly into the group.

You report to the CCO. Together with the CCO and the Marketing Director, you form the Commercial MT (CMT). You also work closely with the Leadership Team (LT).

Day to day, you and the Marketing Director make sure the commercial disciplines work together seamlessly: from lead to pipeline to revenue. You make clear agreements on MQLs, SQLs and forecasting. That collaboration has to be ultra-tight.

What you’ll do 
Revenue & results

You’re operationally responsible for delivering the group’s ARR targets, day in, day out. That covers new business, upsell and cross-sell, and retention and expansion through Customer Success.

You translate the commercial strategy (set with and by the CCO and the Commercial MT) into concrete sales goals, targets per country and team, and an actionable sales plan.

You drive pipeline, conversion and forecast accuracy. You own the sales funnel from SQL to closed-won, and the expansion funnel within our existing customer base.

You’re responsible for pricing and deal structure within the agreed framework, in line with our margin and growth targets.

Leadership & team 
+ You lead and further professionalise the sales team (about 15 FTE) day to day, across all countries where Whitevision operates. That includes visiting our offices and teams at the various locations.
+ You directly lead Customer Success (currently 2 FTE) as part of the broader sales and expansion motion. As the team grows, this structure can grow with it.
+ You decide on team structure, capacity and how accounts and verticals are divided, to fit our international growth.
+ You coach, develop and recruit sales professionals. You also own onboarding and enablement for new colleagues.
+ You drive individual and team performance with clear KPIs and a healthy rhythm of 1:1s, forecast reviews and pipeline meetings.

Building & integrating
+ You set up and safeguard scalable sales processes, CRM and tooling that grow with a fast-growing, international buy-and-build organisation.
+ You own the sales methodology, from qualification through negotiation to closing. You make sure every country and team applies it the same way.
+ You (co-)develop and execute the playbook for integrating sales teams of newly acquired companies: one sales methodology, one CRM, one way of working.
+ You spot operational bottlenecks in the commercial organisation and resolve them.

Collaboration & execution
+ You work closely with the Marketing Director on lead follow-up, campaign ROI, events, partners and a consistent go-to-market.
+ You support the CCO in the commercial execution of strategic partnerships, including AFAS, 4PS, Exact and other partners.
+ You report on sales performance, pipeline and risks to the CCO and the Commercial MT.
+ You travel regularly to our international teams and customers.

About Whitevision 

Whitevision is a fast-growing SaaS organisation. We specialise in intelligent document processing and automating document-intensive workflows. Through an ambitious buy-and-build strategy, we’re bringing several software companies together into one strong, international platform. We’re active across Europe, and the US is likely next.

Our mission is clear: build one strong, recognisable and scalable company. One Company. The coming years are all about international growth, integration and commercial professionalisation. For this next phase, we’re looking for a Sales Director who doesn’t just deliver results, but also builds the organisation that makes the next stage of growth possible.

"At Whitevision, we provide a solution that genuinely helps people move forward in their organizations. It enables them to work more efficiently and effectively, allowing them to make a greater impact. Our team is stable and consists of a great mix of experience, personalities, and backgrounds. That diversity is one of our strengths. We also enjoy spending time together outside of work, whether it's a game of padel or a limoncello workshop." Erik, Sales Manager 

What you bring
+ 2–4 years of sales management experience, including at least one year in an end-responsible role (Sales Director or Head of Sales) in B2B SaaS or software.
+ A successful track record of at least 4 years as an individual contributor in SaaS sales.
+ A proven track record of hitting MRR/ARR targets and scaling a sales team in a fast-growing environment.
+ Experience (co-)building a sales organisation. You’ve put structure, process and capacity in place for the next phase, not just run an existing team.
+ You’re data- and process-driven. You build processes, rhythm and discipline, and you steer on data and forecasts.
+ An affinity for Customer Success and retention, alongside new business sales.
+ Experience leading sales teams across multiple countries and cultures. You’re a leader people want to follow, and the teams you’ve led will tell you so.
+ Experience in a scale-up or buy-and-build SaaS environment is a strong plus.
+ You’re a natural sparring partner for marketing. You think in terms of the full funnel, not just your own team.
+ Excellent English. Good Dutch is a plus, as is fluency in a third European language.

Our Whitevision way of working is built on respect, decisiveness, commitment and ambition. These core values are an excellent match with your personality and the way you approach your work. 

What we offer
+ OTE of €150,000 per year, depending on your experience. We’ll discuss the split, accelerators and caps on the variable part together.
+ A company car, laptop, mobile phone and a solid pension plan.
+ An executive role with direct, operational impact on our commercial result and on building a fast-growing international SaaS organisation.
+ Close collaboration in a small, decisive Commercial MT: the CCO, the Marketing Director and you.
+ The chance to help build tomorrow’s Sales and Customer Success organisation, including integrating new acquisitions.

Ready to drive our commercial engine?
Are you the Sales Director who’ll drive Whitevision’s commercial engine? Can you see yourself forming the Commercial MT with the CCO and the Marketing Director? Then we’d love to hear from you.

title: Director of Pricing & Monetization
description:
The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei , the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission 

We are looking for a Director of Pricing & Monetization , who will be responsible for defining and executing the company's pricing strategy to maximize revenue growth, profitability, and market competitiveness. This leader will develop scalable pricing frameworks, design bundled product offerings, lead willingness-to-pay research, and establish a data-driven approach to pricing across products, industries, customer segments, and geographies. The role sits at the intersection of Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics & Product, ensuring pricing decisions balance customer value, competitive positioning, profitability, and growth objectives. 

Responsibilities 

Pricing Framework Development 

- Design and maintain the company's enterprise-wide pricing framework. 
- Develop attribute-based pricing models across products, industries, geographies, customer segments, and risk profiles. 
- Establish pricing governance, policies, guardrails, and decision-making frameworks. 
- Create methodologies for standard pricing, exception pricing, strategic discounts, and deal approvals. 
- Define pricing architecture for new products and market launches. 
Bundling & Monetization Strategy 

- Design and implement bundled product and service offerings that maximize customer value and company profitability. 
- Identify opportunities to unbundle and re-bundle products to improve monetization and customer segmentation. 
- Develop packaging strategies across core products, value-added services, premium features, and subscriptions. 
- Partner with Product Management to create tiered "Good-Better-Best" pricing structures. 
- Measure bundle performance and continuously optimize package economics. 
Willingness-to-Pay & Customer Research 

- Lead willingness-to-pay studies and pricing research programs. 
- Develop segmentation models based on customer value perception and purchasing behavior. 
- Conduct customer interviews, surveys, conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp studies, and other pricing methodologies. 
- Identify pricing drivers by industry, customer size, region, and product category. 
- Translate customer insights into actionable pricing recommendations. 
Market & Competitive Intelligence 

- Build and maintain a competitive pricing intelligence program. 
- Monitor competitor pricing structures, packaging strategies, discounting practices, and market trends. 
- Conduct benchmarking analyses to evaluate pricing position versus competitors. 
- Identify emerging monetization strategies and disruptive pricing models. 
- Provide executive recommendations on pricing actions required to maintain market competitiveness. 
Pricing Analytics & Optimization 

- Develop pricing elasticity models and price-volume curves. 
- Establish analytical frameworks to measure profitability, margin performance, and pricing effectiveness. 
- Evaluate revenue impact of pricing changes before deployment. 
- Track pricing KPIs and identify opportunities for revenue optimization. 
- Support AI-driven and data-driven pricing initiatives. 
Cross-Functional Leadership 

- Partner closely with Product, Finance, Commercial, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Data teams. 
- Influence product roadmap decisions through monetization insights. 
- Support executive leadership on strategic pricing investments and initiatives. 
- Lead pricing councils, governance forums, and strategic pricing reviews. 
- Manage and develop a high-performing pricing team. 

Qualifications 

- 8+ years of experience in Pricing, Strategy, Product Management, Revenue Management, Consulting, or Commercial Excellence. 
- 4+ years leading pricing strategy or monetization initiatives. 
- Demonstrated experience building pricing frameworks and governance models. 
- Strong background in market research and willingness-to-pay methodologies. 
- Experience designing pricing bundles, packaging strategies, and commercial offers. 
- Experience driving pricing transformations in complex organizations. 
Preferred Experience 

- Payments, fintech, SaaS, software, technology, telecommunications, financial services, or marketplace experience. 
- Experience with CPQ platforms, pricing systems, and revenue management tools. 
- Knowledge of advanced pricing analytics, AI-driven pricing, and revenue optimization. 
Benefits 

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process.

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. title: Senior RAMS Engineer
description:
We are looking for a RAMS Engineer to strengthen our safety and compliance team, with a particular emphasis on safety engineering for our vehicles, propulsion systems, ground infrastructure, and operations.

RAMS covers Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety. This role will apply those principles across the full lifecycle of complex hardware and operational systems, helping ensure that hazards are identified early, risks are controlled, and safety requirements are supported by clear technical evidence.

Although the role sits within safety and compliance rather than systems engineering, you will need a strong systems-engineering background and experience working with high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems.

About us 

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities 

- Establish and develop RAMS and safety-engineering processes across vehicles, propulsion systems, ground systems, facilities, and operations.

- Define, manage, and verify reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety requirements throughout the system lifecycle.

- Lead hazard identification, risk assessments, failure-mode analysis, fault-tree analysis, and other structured safety assessments.

- Develop and maintain safety cases, hazard logs, RAMS plans, safety assessments, compliance evidence, and technical justifications.

- Work with systems, propulsion, avionics, test, manufacturing, operations, and suppliers to identify hazards and implement effective risk controls.

- Support design reviews, test-readiness reviews, operational-readiness activities, incident investigations, change control, and corrective actions.

What we are looking for 

- Proven experience in RAMS, safety engineering, reliability engineering, or systems engineering for high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems.

- Experience analysing complex hardware and operational systems, including interfaces, failure modes, hazards, and system-level risks.

- Strong understanding of safety-engineering methods and the ability to turn analysis into practical design and operational controls.

- Experience producing clear technical documentation, safety arguments, risk assessments, compliance evidence, and engineering reports.

- Strong communication skills, with the confidence to challenge technical decisions and work effectively with specialist engineering and operational teams.

- A degree in systems engineering, safety engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience 

- RAMS or safety engineering within aerospace, space, defence, rocketry, missile systems, nuclear, rail, energy, automotive, or another high-consequence industry.

- Experience with FMEA, FMECA, fault-tree analysis, hazard analysis, HAZOP, STPA, bow-tie analysis, or similar techniques.

- Safety cases, functional-safety assessments, reliability predictions, maintainability analysis, or probabilistic risk assessment.

- Propulsion systems, solid rocket motors, hazardous materials, explosives, test stands, launch operations, or high-energy systems.

- Experience supporting verification and validation, qualification, acceptance testing, configuration control, and engineering change processes.

- Familiarity with applicable aerospace, defence, functional-safety, quality, or hazardous-operations standards and regulatory frameworks.

- Fluent German would be a significant advantage in this position.

Benefits and important information: 

- We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent. 

- Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success. 

- Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

- Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

- Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week. 

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About ALPAMI

At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 200+ keys across the Black Forest, Switzerland, Tirol, and Munich — spanning City Boutique Houses, Tiny Houses in Nature, and Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.

We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast — with a clear target of 500 units next year. That means the operational engine behind our guest experience needs to scale just as fast, and that's exactly where you come in.

The Role

We're looking for an Operations Manager who reports directly to the MD and, from our Munich HQ, keeps the operational engine behind our guest experience running: you make sure our Customer Care team always has the relevant information at hand, support them in guest communication, and steer our local stakeholders on site. You are the nerve center of ALPAMI's day-to-day: the person who sees every property, every process, and every issue before it becomes a problem — and who fixes it before the guest even notices.

This is not a job for someone who wants a quiet 9-to-5. We're a fast-growing, founder-led company, and we need someone who understands what that actually means in practice: unpredictable days, fast decisions, and a genuine sense of ownership over the outcome. We expect high reachability, hospitality is a 365 day business. If you don’t agree with that, this might not be the right choice for you.

What You'll Do

- Own operations end-to-end — surveil and continuously improve operational processes and management standards across our entire portfolio of properties

- Be the single point of contact for our Customer Care team, provide them with relevant, up-to-date property information (access details, house rules, local specifics, open issues) so every guest gets a fast and correct answer

- Assist with guest communication — step in on complex requests, special cases, and escalations, and help keep our tone and response times consistently on brand

- Steer our local stakeholders on site — make sure the guest journey is smooth at every locationMonitor and act on operating room KPIs — occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction scores, response SLAs, and the other numbers that tell you where to focus next

- Carry out on-site visits in coordination with our Operations Lead whenever quality checks, partner onboarding, training, or problem-solving require an on-the-ground presence

- Prioritize ruthlessly — you always know what needs fixing right now versus what can wait, and you make that call fast

- Solve issues immediately — you're hands-on by nature and would rather fix something yourself in the next ten minutes than schedule a meeting about it next week

- Lead and develop operational team members as we scale, setting the standard for how ALPAMI runs

- Champion guest happiness as a non-negotiable core value — every decision you make is filtered through "does this make the guest experience better?"

What You Bring (Must-Haves)

- 2–5+ years of experience in hospitality operations

- Bilingual in German and English (spoken and written)

- Strong written communication skills, clear, warm, and solution-oriented with guests, colleagues, and partners alike

- A genuine hands-on mentality — you fix things yourself, immediately, rather than escalating by default

- Strong prioritization skills and the judgment to resolve issues on the spot

- Stress resistance, you stay clear-headed and effective when multiple things go wrong at once

- Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site visits to our properties

- An understanding that joining a fast-growing company means flexible hours and a workload that doesn't always fit neatly into Monday–Friday, 9-to-5

- Customer happiness as a core personal value, not just a KPI

Nice-to-Have

- Experience leading a team

- Experience in guest communication or customer care, ideally in hospitality

- Deep technical understanding of hospitality tech tools (e.g. PMS, channel managers, guest communication platforms, revenue management systems)

- Familiarity with AI, you don’t step away in challenge yourself and your workflows with AI

- A driver's license

- Experience opening new locations/properties

What We Offer

- Direct reporting line to the Managing Director — your work has visibility and impact from day one

- A front-row seat and real influence on our path to 500 units next year — you won't just support our growth, you'll be one of the reasons it happens

- The autonomy of a founder-led, bootstrapped company: fast decisions, no bureaucracy, real ownership

- The chance to shape what "operational excellence" means at ALPAMI as we scale

- A team that believes 5-star experiences aren't about star ratings — they're about how we treat every single guest

- A fair, competitive salary

- A nice office in Munich

- Frequent team events

- Wellpass membership for your physical and mental well-being

title: (Senior) HR Tech Business Analyst — Automation & AI (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

You will join Flix's People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a technically hands-on Business Analyst, bridging HR operations, Workday and emerging AI and automation technologies. 

You will understand how HR processes work end to end, identify opportunities to simplify and automate them, and turn business challenges into practical technology solutions. 

Beyond gathering requirements, you will help build and deploy workflows, integrations and AI-enabled tools, while supporting Workday tech operations and process optimization in close collaboration with our internal Workday technology team and FlixTech. 

The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and collaborates with HR process owners, People Operations, Workday Tech team, FlixTech, IT Security and Data Privacy teams globally. 

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model). Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required. 

About the Role 

- Analyze and optimize HR processes across the hire-to-retire lifecycle, working with People Operations and process owners to identify inefficiencies, conduct as-is/to-be gap analyses and translate requirements into practical Workday, automation and AI solutions 

- Support hands-on Workday operations and optimization , including approved HRIS transactions, organizational and position management, data maintenance, EIB uploads and functional testing, working within established security and governance frameworks 

- Design, build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, UiPath, Python and GenAI/LLM technologies, including MCPs, custom connectors, exception handling, monitoring and operational support. 

- Build and deploy AI-powered HR tools and internal applications , including Claude-based apps, with appropriate authentication, role-based access, data privacy and governance in collaboration with FlixTech and IT Security. 

- Drive business analysis and technical delivery from requirements and process design through prototyping, integration specifications, SIT/UAT, implementation and adoption, collaborating with Workday tech team on Workday configuration and technical integrations 

- Develop HR technology products and service-delivery solutions using Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo Agents, improving employee and HR experiences through workflow automation, self-service and continuous product improvement

Most HR analyst roles stop at scoping requirements and handing them over. This one doesn't. You will keep Workday running for HR day to day, shape how our processes work in Workday, and build the automation and AI that removes manual work. You'll be the person the People function brings its problems to, and you'll help define how AI & Automation is adopted responsibly across HR at scale. 

About You

- 5+ years of experience in HR technology, HR business analysis, HRIS or automation, with strong operational HR domain knowledge across the hire-to-retire lifecycle 

- Strong understanding of Workday Core HCM, business processes, organizational structures, security concepts and HRIS governance , including practical experience with Workday optimization, operational transactions, reporting, data maintenance or EIBs. A Workday (e.g. Core HCM) certification is preferred 

- Strong business analysis skills: gap analysis between as-is Workday processes and feasible to-be processes, requirements engineering, BPMN, and the ability to explain clearly to both HR and technical colleagues what is possible and what is not 

- Strong hands-on programming and automation experience , particularly Python, n8n, UiPath or comparable tools, with proven experience building, troubleshooting and maintaining production workflows. N8n certification is a strong plus 

- A solid understanding of various integration approaches e.g. APIs, custom connectors and enterprise integrations , including REST APIs, SFTP, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, to specify integration requirements for tech teams to ensure secure data exchange between HRIS and other enterprise systems 

- Hands-on knowledge of the Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo agents, together with experience building AI-enabled tools using Claude MCP, GenAI/LLMs or similar technologies and applying appropriate security controls 

- Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently across HR and technology teams

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer 

- Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

- Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

- Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

- Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

- Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

- Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. 
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. 

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Accounting Expert: AI Model Evaluation
description:
About Huzzle Labs

Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance.

About the Role 

Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance.

This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.

Responsibilities

- Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books.
- Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly.
- Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo.
- Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears.
- Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.”
- Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria.
Requirements 

- At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations.
- Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.
- Hands-on knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, AR/AP, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax and job costing.
- Excellent written English and precision with numbers.
- Careful and detail-oriented: accurate figures and objective, checkable criteria.
- Available 20 to 40 hours per week for an initial one-week trial, with potential extension.

Example Assignment

For a client deal room covering a small business with incomplete and inconsistent books, you would:

- Review the files and select the relevant documents, such as bank statements, ledgers, invoices and ageing reports.
- Write a prompt as the business owner or controller would, asking for a reconciliation and the adjusting entries needed to close the month.
- Run the prompt against a frontier AI model and check the spreadsheet or journal entry schedule line by line.
- If the model completes the task correctly, increase the difficulty, for example, by adding a customer deposit, a timing difference or a sales tax complication, until it fails.
- Write the rubric, such as “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue,” so another reviewer can grade any answer without repeating the work.

Confidentiality 

An NDA must be signed before the engagement begins.

Benefits 

Compensation: $60 - $90 USD / hour
