title: Demand Generation & Marketing Manager
description:
About REPLUG

REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value and long-term business growth.

We connect acquisition, retention, measurement and app experience into a unified growth system that improves commercial performance. From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently and build sustainable growth.

Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement and mobile growth consulting.

We are looking for a Demand Generation & Marketing Manager to build and run a marketing function that makes a measurable contribution to REPLUG’s commercial growth. Your primary objective is to generate qualified demand and sales opportunities from the businesses we want to work with, with a particular focus on higher-value engagements.

You’ll own the marketing plan, its execution and its performance. Working closely with the founders and Sales, you’ll decide where marketing should focus, challenge assumptions and connect marketing activity to qualified conversations, opportunities and pipeline value.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll combine commercial judgement with strong content and practical CRM skills, while ensuring our positioning and the experience prospects have with REPLUG remain consistent.

Success will be measured primarily through qualified opportunities generated, the quality and value of pipeline created, and marketing’s contribution to commercial growth.

What You’ll Do 

Generate Demand from the Right Businesses 

- Plan and execute B2B campaigns around the problems, buying triggers and decision-makers within our priority customer profiles.

- Choose and test the right mix of channels, including LinkedIn, email, partnerships, webinars and events, with a clear route from engagement to conversation.

- Build campaign assets, landing pages and follow-up journeys. Work with Sales to improve targeting and lead quality using feedback from real conversations.

Own the Marketing Plan and Delivery 

- Translate business objectives into a clear marketing plan with priorities, campaigns, timelines, budgets and measures of success.

- Make decisions about where to invest time and resources, explain your reasoning and challenge activities that lack a clear purpose.

- Deliver core marketing activities yourself and coordinate contributions from founders, specialists and external partners. Keep delivery moving and identify where additional support is needed.

Own Content and Distribution 

- Coordinate founder and team LinkedIn activity, turning specialist insights and client results into relevant content for prospective buyers.

- Create and commission case studies, website content and campaign materials. Own briefs, editorial quality, distribution and reuse across channels.

- Develop partner activity that extends our reach into the right audiences. Keep messaging, tone and the prospect experience consistent across touchpoints.

Own CRM and Lead Nurturing 

- Own HubSpot marketing processes, including segmentation, forms, workflows, email nurturing, campaign tracking and data quality.

- Build nurture journeys for contacts at different stages of interest, including those who fit our target profile but are not ready to buy.

- Agree qualification criteria and handover processes with Sales. Make sure relevant leads reach the right person with useful context and clear next steps.

Understand Performance and Improve It 

- Track how marketing contributes to qualified conversations and pipeline. Report marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced opportunities separately.

- Review conversion between stages with Sales, identify where prospects drop out and adjust campaigns, messaging or nurturing accordingly.

- Use results to decide what to continue, change or stop. Explain what is working, what remains uncertain and what you will test next.

What We’re Looking For 

We care about demonstrated impact and your personal contribution. You should be able to explain a campaign you owned, the decisions you made, and the commercial opportunities it generated.

- 3 to 5 years of proven, hands-on B2B marketing experience, including campaigns designed to generate qualified demand for services or products through a considered sales process.

- Commercial awareness and a clear understanding of customer fit, lead qualification, sales cycles and pipeline progression.

- Strong content judgement and excellent written and spoken English. You can turn specialist knowledge into clear, credible messaging for buyers.

- Practical HubSpot experience, including segmentation, workflows, nurturing and reporting. You can build and improve the setup yourself.

- Experience owning a marketing plan and delivering it within limited resources, while coordinating colleagues and external contributors.

- The confidence to challenge the founders constructively, make recommendations and take responsibility for the outcome.

- Good brand judgement and the ability to balance immediate demand generation with long-term credibility.

Nice to Have 

- Experience marketing an agency, consultancy or other B2B services business.

- Familiarity with mobile marketing, AdTech or the app growth ecosystem.

- Experience building demand through founder visibility, expert content, partnerships or industry events.

- Based in a location with convenient flight connections to Berlin, Germany.

What We Offer 

- Ownership of REPLUG’s marketing plan, with senior marketing guidance, direct access to the founders and influence over priorities.

- Access to REPLUG’s specialists, client results and industry relationships. You’ll lead and coordinate delivery, with specialist support so you can focus your hands-on work where it has the greatest impact.

- The opportunity to shape how REPLUG reaches its next clients and demonstrate a clear contribution to business growth.

- A fully remote setup, with travel opportunities to attend industry and REPLUG’s events

- A EUR 1,000 annual educational budget

The Role 

We are looking for a Management Accountant to take ownership of the core financial processes that underpin our growing business.

This is a hands-on role covering the mechanics of our finance function: month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, VAT, the timesheet-to-invoice process and the production of accurate, timely management accounts.

You would be joining a function that has grown quickly and has room to improve. We want someone who will run the core processes reliably and then make them better, rather than accepting them as they are. You would be the in-house finance lead, working with our external accountants and, where needed, senior finance support. 

This would suit someone who is qualified or nearly qualified , has strong technical accounting fundamentals and enjoys being close to the detail while also understanding the wider commercial picture.

Key Responsibilities 

Month-End & Management Accounts 

- Own and manage the month-end close process from start to finish.

- Prepare accurate and timely monthly management accounts.

- Prepare and post month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and other adjustments.

- Reconcile balance sheet accounts and investigate and resolve discrepancies.

- Provide clear financial information and commentary to the leadership team.

- Prepare monthly cash flow forecasts and support the annual budgeting cycle.

Revenue, Billing & WIP 

- Own the timesheet-to-invoice process, from approved timesheets through to invoices issued.

- Raise client invoices in line with each client's billing arrangements, which vary considerably by client and by platform.

- Maintain revenue accruals and monitor unbilled work, keeping WIP and the cash conversion cycle under control.

- Run credit control and follow up overdue balances.

- Monitor timesheet submissions and chase employees for missing or incomplete timesheets ahead of each month-end.

Accounts Payable, Payments & Cash 

- Manage the accounts payable process, ensuring supplier invoices are accurately recorded and appropriately authorised.

- Maintain accurate supplier records and resolve supplier queries and invoice discrepancies.

- Process employee expenses and company credit card transactions, checking them against policy and chasing missing receipts.

- Prepare and process supplier payment runs.

- Support cash flow management and ensure key payment obligations are met on time.

VAT & Compliance 

- Prepare and submit VAT returns accurately and on time.

- Ensure VAT treatment is applied correctly across transactions.

- Support the year-end accounts process and CMR's external accountants.

- Work with the external accountants (and any fractional senior finance support) on year-end, tax and technical accounting matters, escalating judgement calls rather than deciding them alone.

Financial Control & Reporting 

- Perform regular bank, control account and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Identify errors, inconsistencies and control issues and take ownership of resolving them.

- Support the development and maintenance of appropriate financial controls and processes.

What We're Looking For 

Essential 

- Qualified or nearly qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

- Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals and double-entry bookkeeping.

- Practical experience of month-end accounting and preparation of management accounts.

- Experience with accruals, prepayments, journals and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Experience preparing or supporting VAT returns.

- Strong Excel skills and experience with Xero or a similar accounting system.

- A proactive approach, with the confidence to investigate issues rather than simply flagging them.

- At least two years' experience working in industry rather than solely in practice.

- Experience of timesheet-based, multi-client billing and credit control.

- Experience working as the sole or lead finance person, or the confidence to do so.

Desirable 

- Experience within professional services, consultancy, construction or another project-based business.

- Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting and cash flow reporting.

- Previous experience working in a growing SME environment.

The Person 

We're looking for someone who is hands-on, organised and commercially aware .

You'll be comfortable getting into the detail, but you won't lose sight of the bigger picture. You will take pride in getting the numbers right, meeting deadlines and maintaining a finance function that the wider business can rely on.

You'll be comfortable in a growing business where not everything is perfectly established, and willing to say when something isn't working rather than quietly working around it. 

Most importantly, you'll be someone people can trust with the numbers.

What You'll Get at CMR 

- The opportunity to play a key role in the finance function of a growing consultancy.

- Exposure to the wider commercial and operational side of the business.

- Support for your continued professional development and qualification.

- A flexible/hybrid working environment.

About You 

If you're a qualified or nearly qualified accountant looking for a role where you can take genuine ownership, work closely with senior stakeholders and play an important part in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

Come and help us build the finance function that supports the next stage of Cooper Moss Rutland's growth.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Life at UiPath 

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission 

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

What you'll do at UiPath 

- Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.

- Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.

- Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.

- Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.

- Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements.

- Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us.

- Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it.

- Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough.

What you'll bring to the team 

- A solid track record (7+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on.

- Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all.

- Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written.

- Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems.

- Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months.

- An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents.

- A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook.

- Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust.

- Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive.

- An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us.

- You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

description:
Data Scientist - iwocaPay Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom (one day per week in office requirement)

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad. 

You'll own credit models that decide who iwocaPay can safely fund, on what terms, and how far the product can grow. You'll help shape how risk modelling develops.

The company 

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team 

The Risk Squad owns credit risk and fraud for iwocaPay, iwoca's Buy Now Pay Later product for businesses. The aim is to lend to every business likely to repay, and to spot the ones that aren't.

The squad works across three areas:

- Lending decisions. Building and improving the automated credit model.

- The portfolio. Tracking losses, chargebacks, and seller performance, and deciding which segments to grow or pull back from.

- New products. Designing the risk side of each one before it launches.

The squad is small and new – two data scientists, a risk analyst and a risk lead.

The role 

As a Data Scientist in the Risk Squad, you'll co-own every credit model with the other data scientist and review one another's work. The job is mostly supervised ML on tabular data, with a fair amount of data engineering as the squad moves onto its own pipelines. You'll start on the automated credit model and take on the invoice financing models over time. You can also test ideas with iwoca's other lending data science teams, who work on similar credit problems.

You'll choose what to work on and write the plans you deliver. Much of the squad's work happens in iwocaPay's product and strategy meetings, so your models shape the roadmap. You'll also help set up how the squad works – what it monitors, and the guidelines it follows.

Live project examples:

- Model architecture. Rethinking the model around how iwocaPay actually lends: overlapping facilities, short terms, and a growing set of products a customer can use.

- Blending datasets. Bringing more iwocaPay-specific data into the models while still drawing on iwoca's larger core lending dataset, through methods such as transfer learning.

- Invoice financing. Building a credit risk model from scratch for a new product on a segment iwoca hasn’t lent to before. Plus finding the modelling opportunities elsewhere in the funnel, like in our offers...

The requirements 

Essential:

- Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

- Production ML. You have built supervised ML models on tabular data end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring.

- Ownership. You work well in a small, early-stage team where priorities move quickly. You build what you need as you go, and take loosely defined problems from framing to a landed decision.

- Judgement. You know when a model is good enough to go live, and when it needs more work. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right.

- AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a modelling pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't.

- Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in product, risk, and leadership.

Bonus:

- Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk modelling or lending.

- Non-linear methods. You have used gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

- Combining datasets. You have used transfer learning, domain adaptation, or similar methods on data sources of different size and relevance.

- Data engineering. You have built data pipelines and managed datasets alongside your modelling work.

- Coding. You can write code for analysis. The squad works in Python.

The salary 

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture 

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices 

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits 

- Flexible working hours.

- Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

- A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

- 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

- A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

- Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

- 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

- An employee equity incentive scheme.

- Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

- Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

- Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone.

- Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

- Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

description:

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

description:

Notre vision

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

title: Head of Product - H/F
description:
Vos missions

Vos missions 

Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise. 

En binôme avec le Product Lead, vous portez la vision, fixez le cadre stratégique et représentez le produit auprès de la Direction Générale. 

Principales responsabilités 

* Définir la stratégie d'un portefeuille multi-produits : investissements, priorités, évolution et cycle de vie des produits.
* Appuyer chaque décision sur des données mesurables (revenus, usage, renouvellements, churn, coûts, risques).
* Manager l'équipe Produit (Product Lead, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Product Designers, QA Engineers) : recrutement, accompagnement, évaluation et développement des compétences.
* Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs clairs, stables et mesurables et faire vivre une culture produit orientée qualité et performance.
* Construire et piloter le budget de la fonction Produit ainsi que l'organisation des équipes et des squads.
* Garantir le respect des budgets et plannings, anticiper les risques et contribuer à la résolution des écarts.
* Piloter la veille concurrentielle afin d'alimenter les orientations stratégiques et les roadmaps.
* Développer l'innovation et l'usage de l'IA dans les pratiques produit (discovery, spécification, design, tests, documentation), dans un cadre sécurisé et conforme.
* Représenter le produit auprès des dirigeants et arbitrer les décisions majeures inter-équipes. 

Environnement : Jira, Figma, Confluence, outils de data produit et solutions d'IA.

Vos compétences

Votre profil 

Diplômé(e) d'une école de commerce ou d'ingénieur (Bac+5), vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience en direction produit ou management d'équipes produit dans un environnement B2B / éditeur de logiciels. 

Orienté(e) business et marché, vous savez transformer les besoins clients et les enjeux commerciaux en stratégie produit. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les équipes commerciales, la gestion d'investissements et les arbitrages à forte valeur ajoutée. 

Compétences clés 

* Stratégie et vision produit multi-produits
* Analyse de marché et veille concurrentielle
* Leadership et management d'équipes
* Construction et pilotage budgétaire
* Culture data-driven et indicateurs business
* IA appliquée au produit
* Méthodologies Agile / Scrum 

Qualités attendues 

* Vision stratégique et sens des priorités
* Leadership et capacité à fédérer
* Sens de la décision et de l'arbitrage
* Aisance avec les dirigeants et parties prenantes
* Vision long terme et approche systémique 

Atouts appréciés 

* Gestion de produits à cycle de vie long ou de portefeuilles complexes
* Expérience en environnement réglementé ou à forts enjeux de sécurité
* Connaissance du secteur public, des élections ou certification Agile

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

* Un poste de direction à fort impact stratégique
* Une participation clé à une refonte technologique ambitieuse
* Une équipe Produit complète et structurée
* Un environnement Agile favorisant innovation, IA et amélioration continue
* Un cadre de travail attractif à Meylan, près de Grenoble 

Conditions 

* CDI - jusqu'à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine

title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
description:
About Alma 

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team 

Strategic Finance is part of Alma's Finance team and reports to the CFO. Our job is to understand Alma's economics better than anyone: we own the top line, the unit economics and the Contribution Margin, and we turn that knowledge into decisions on pricing, partnerships, markets and products.

We are organising the team so that each person owns a piece of Alma's P&L from start to finish: its business plan, its recurring analysis, its key finance processes, its business partners and its Board materials. Depending on the scope, that piece can be payments and partnerships, our existing merchant base, or new business and growth, each with one or more European markets attached.

About the job 

- Own your piece of the P&L. Build and maintain its business plan, follow its performance month after month, and explain what moves the numbers and why, all the way up to the Board.

- Run the key finance processes of your scope. Depending on the scope: pricing, merchant performance reviews, cost and margin analysis, country reviews. You are accountable for their quality, and for making them better at every cycle.

- Be a real partner to the business. Work day to day with the commercial, product and operations teams, step back from the numbers, and bring a clear recommendation whenever a decision is on the table.

- Rebuild how finance works with AI. Prototype AI-assisted workflows, industrialise the ones that work, and free up the team's time for analysis and influence. Raising the bar on how we work matters as much as what we deliver.

You will work with 

Google Sheets · Excel · SQL (largely AI-assisted) · Notion · Slack · AI assistants and LLMs

About you 

To succeed in this job 

- Have 6 to 7 years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, transaction services, consulting or a similar analytical role, ideally including time in a fast-growing company.

- Model with ease and think in unit economics: you can build a business plan from raw data and spot when a number doesn't make sense. Querying is largely AI-assisted at Alma, so data judgement matters more than deep SQL.

- Have a strong appetite for AI and learn fast. Ideally, you have already built AI-assisted workflows and made them stick.

- Take ownership and bring business sense: you make a scope your own, you know when to step back, and you can influence people who don't report to you. You work comfortably in English and have enough French for day-to-day exchanges with colleagues (native French is not required).

And it will be nice if you also 

- Hold a Master's degree in Finance, Business or Engineering, or equivalent.

- Have exposure to fintech, payments or BNPL.

- Speak a third language beyond French and English, a real plus given our European footprint.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience. 

What's in it for you 

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

- Ownership and visibility. A piece of Alma's P&L that is truly yours, with direct exposure.

- AI at the core of the job. The chance to redesign how a finance team works, building the workflows rather than just using them.

- A team in the making. Strategic Finance is being restructured now: you will help shape how it works, in a Next40 scale-up growing across Europe, with room to take on broader responsibilities.

- Profit-sharing and employee savings plan

- Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package

- Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities

Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. 

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities 

- Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
- Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
- Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
- Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
- Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
- Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
- Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.
Requirements 

Background & Experience 

- At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
- Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
- A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
- Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
- Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
- Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
- Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
- Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.
Benefits 

What Makes You A Great Fit 

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us? 

- Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
- Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
- Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
- Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
- Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).
Ready to Move the Needle? 

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

🏠 Where you'll fit in: 

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Our technology 

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.

What we do 

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

Client Engineering is the development arm responsible for making sure our clients receive the best possible experience and their needs are met with high quality solutions. 

🚀 What you’ll own 

- We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The French energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

- We have challenging technical problems to solve; like processing tens of millions of meter readings a day. We need the right technology in place to handle this smoothly as well as feeding data into a machine learning pipeline that models and predicts consumption. Or thinking about how we adapt Kraken to improve other utilities like water and broadband.

- There's a great opportunity for disruption in the French energy market. The big suppliers still dominate, but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology.

title: Director of Product Marketing
description:
About Telnyx 

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. 

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. 

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. 

The opportunity 

We're looking for a Director or VP of Product Marketing to lead that effort globally. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can connect deep technical understanding with positioning, distribution and commercial results. The title will reflect the experience and scope of the person we hire.

A good product story matters, but a story alone isn't enough. The person in this role needs to turn our infrastructure into clear customer problems we solve, compelling reasons to choose Telnyx and practical ways to try it. A great sample application, integration or reference architecture can do more than another 30-slide deck. So can a precise message that reaches a developer at the moment they are deciding how to build.

You'll work across Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Sales and Marketing to bring those pieces together. You'll help shape what we launch, how we explain it, how buyers discover it and how our field teams take it to market.

What you'll build 

- A coherent product story. Own positioning, segmentation and competitive differentiation across AI inference, Voice AI, agent and edge infrastructure, communications, networking and wireless. Make the full platform understandable without flattening the technical details that make it valuable.

- Solutions people can actually use. Drive the packaging of sample apps, reference architectures, integrations, templates and working demos that prove what the infrastructure makes possible. Build repeatable plays for use cases such as contact centers, agent assist and industry-specific workflows. These should accelerate adoption and enterprise sales, not become disconnected software products.

- Distribution that reaches technical buyers. Shape how we win discovery through product pages, developer content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), technical communities and paid acquisition. You won't necessarily operate every campaign, but you must understand the mechanics deeply enough to direct them: search and answer-engine visibility, technical site structure, intent, targeting, conversion paths, attribution and economics.

- A field-ready commercial engine. Give enterprise sellers, FDEs and solutions teams the pitches, discovery frameworks, architecture diagrams, competitive proof, demos and ROI narratives they need to generate and advance opportunities. Translate platform capabilities into buying reasons for developers, technical executives and enterprise decision-makers.

- Launches that translate into adoption. Work with Product and Engineering early, not after something ships. Choose the audience, packaging and launch strategy, then measure activation, qualified demand, field utilization and downstream pipeline. Build an operating cadence that keeps pace with a rapidly changing roadmap.

- An AI-native PMM team. Use AI research tools, coding assistants, agents and automation as part of everyday work to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, messaging tests, content production, demo development and go-to-market execution. Know when to trust those tools, how to evaluate outputs and where human technical judgment still matters. Lead the team to operate the same way.

How we'll measure success 

The ultimate measure is pipeline. Not the number of launches, assets, impressions or campaigns. We expect this leader to partner closely with Demand Generation and Sales to create measurable, qualified pipeline, improve conversion and accelerate opportunities. Product marketing should be able to show how specific product narratives, solutions, integrations and programs contribute to commercial results.

Early wins will look like a dramatically clearer platform story; a small number of flagship use cases with runnable demos and integrations; sellers using consistent, technically credible plays; stronger discovery and conversion from search, AEO and paid channels; and a repeatable link from product launches to adoption and pipeline. We care about what works and scales, not activity for its own sake.

What we're looking for 

- You've led product marketing for a complex B2B technical platform, ideally in AI infrastructure, developer tools, APIs, cloud, networking or communications. You can be strategic without becoming removed from the work.

- You are technically fluent. You can understand architecture, work with APIs or SDKs, interrogate a latency or cost claim and talk comfortably with engineers. You don't have to be a production engineer, but you need to know when a demo is real and when it's just a pitch.

- You're already effective with AI tools and agents in your own work. You experiment, build workflows and use the technology to move faster. Familiarity with the limitations and evaluation of AI-generated outputs is as important as enthusiasm for the tools.

- You've built or led strong teams, can prioritize across competing launches and products, and enjoy working directly with product leaders and technical builders.

Telecom experience is not required. Technical curiosity, taste, speed and a track record of generating commercial impact matter more.

Why Telnyx 

This is a chance to shape the market narrative for a company that owns the underlying network, communications and compute infrastructure it sells. The platform is real, customers are deploying it in production, and the commercial opportunity is substantial. You'll have direct access to senior leadership and the ability to build a PMM function measured by its contribution to growth.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
At evenito, we build enterprise event management software centered on human connection. By combining cutting-edge technology with personal support, we empower event teams to automate routine logistics and free up time for what truly matters: crafting memorable, sustainable event experiences.

As our Head of Customer Success (CS) you will have a front row seat. Together with your team you will be responsible for evenito’s customer excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will not only ensure that our customers receive professional support, but also be the strategic business owner of our post-sale organization and act as a key customer voice within the company. You will develop and execute a scalable CS operating model and play a pivotal role in shaping our product and the future of evenito.

Are you ready to make an impact?

Your Mission: 

Drive customer success, develop a high-performing team and turn everyday user insights into strategic product growth.

- Lead by Example: You set the tone through your actions. From onboarding our largest enterprise clients (ICPs) to handling support tickets alongside your team, you showcase what great customer service looks like while equipping your team with the tools and support they need to succeed.

- Team Development & Coaching: You will lead and coach a team of five. Through regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and constructive feedback, you will foster a positive, supportive work environment focused on steady growth and a resilient team setup.

- Escalations & Problem Solving: You view complex situations as opportunities to build trust with our clients. When high-stakes issues arise, you partner directly with Product and Management to find clear solutions, using customer data to guide thoughtful decisions.

- Cross-Functional Advocacy: You serve as a key connector between our clients and internal teams. By sharing real customer insights with Product, Sales and Marketing, you help shape and prioritize our product roadmap while keeping team priorities aligned with company strategy.

- Process & Project Innovation: You stay current on Customer Success best practices and enjoy improving how things work. You will have the freedom to introduce new CS workflows that streamline daily operations and support our current growth stage.

- Commercial Impact & Growth: You ensure Customer Success is a growth engine by delivering clear, measurable value. You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics.

- Knowledge Base Development: You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable.

Your Story 

You have a solid B2B SaaS experience, a practical doer mindset and a genuine drive to grow people and businesses - all fueled by a real enthusiasm for the magic of event tech.

- SaaS Experience: You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation or Account Management in the B2B SaaS environment.

- Hands-on Doer Mindset: You keep your cool and stay positive when things go sideways. You are pragmatic, humble and jump into daily support queues without hesitation.

- Effective Communicator: You are a skilled communicator and workshop facilitator who connects effortlessly with enterprise executives, end-users and internal teams alike.

- Tech Savvy and Agile: You are at home analyzing usage data, mapping workflows and collaborating with Product on technical escalations. You adapt quickly to new software, shifting priorities and changing processes.

- Leadership Drive: You genuinely care about people. Ideally, you have led a small team before and take true fulfillment in coaching others, building confidence and helping your team grow.

- Passion for Events and Tech: Events are all about emotion and experience. We are looking for someone who brings that exact enthusiasm for events, event tech and / or digital products.

- Languages: Fluent in English and German, with the ability to comfortably follow Swiss-German in client meetings.

What We Offer 

Unlock your full potential in an inspiring and fast-paced environment. We provide the stage; you take the reins.

- Impact : Take ownership of a role where your work directly shapes evenito's growth and sets new standards for the industry. You will work closely with management, an amazing team, passionate clients and drive projects that make a difference.

- Flexibility : As one of our core values, we strongly believe in hybrid remote work options and flexible schedules that allow you to align your professional commitments with your personal life.

- Time to Recharge : Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge.

- Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots.

- Unique Event s: Events are our DNA. Beyond building great software, we truly enjoy spending time with each other - whether through spontaneous summer swims in the Limmat-river, Friday Beer um Vier drinks, our annual Global Team Event or legendary Christmas parties.

- Mobility Support: We contribute toward your public transport pass (öV-Abo) to support convenient and sustainable commuting.

- Growth Potential: Thrive in a workplace with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making and an open feedback culture designed to help you continuously develop.

Are you ready to shape the future of events with us? 

Discover more about life at evenito on our career page, send us your CV and tell us what excites you most about joining our team. We are building something special at evenito - and we can’t wait to meet the person behind the application.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. 

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Responsibilities 

- Plan your sourcing. You take the bill of materials and build a sourcing plan for each commodity. You weigh criticality, lead time and single or dual source options.

- Find the right suppliers. You run market scans, requests for information and requests for quote. Then you shortlist the suppliers worth a closer look.

- Judge capability together. You work with R&D, Production, Finance and Compliance to build one clear view of what each supplier can do.

- Negotiate the deal. You agree pricing, volume tiers, tooling and payment terms. You also set up the NDAs, supply agreements and long-term agreements that back them.

- Set suppliers up properly. You onboard new suppliers and keep vendor data, price breaks and lead times current in our ERP system.

- Lead supplier qualification. You coordinate our tiered qualification process, including quality agreements and first-article inspections.

- Audit on site and remotely. You check suppliers for quality management, traceability and compliance. You also screen them against trade compliance requirements.

- Keep builds moving. You place and expedite orders for prototype, validation, pilot and pre-series builds. You track supplier performance on delivery, price and quality.

- Bring costs down. You work with suppliers on cost reduction, using should-cost and landed-cost models.

- Grow our supplier base. You qualify suppliers for additional production sites and regions, reusing existing qualification records.

- Make it repeatable. You document sourcing processes, templates and playbooks, so the purchasing team can take over mature suppliers.

Requirements 

- You have 6+ years in sourcing, purchasing or new product introduction for hardware products, across a variety of product types, complexities and technologies.

- You can read technical drawings and specifications, and you work closely with engineers.

- You’re willing to travel regularly, including international trips of several days.

- You’ve audited suppliers hands-on or worked within a quality management system such as ISO 9001.

- You have working knowledge of trade compliance rules.

- You’ve used an ERP system for purchasing and vendor data.

- You have a qualification in engineering, supply chain, business or a related field.

- You communicate excellently in English and build good working relationships with colleagues and suppliers.

Plus 

- Experience in aerospace, drones or other safety-critical products

- Experience sourcing custom electromechanical parts such as plastic parts, motors, batteries and avionics

- Experience qualifying suppliers for production in more than one region

- Experience with supplier scorecards and performance reporting

If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

Maak het verschil als managing director bij Berenschot 

Nederland staat voor één van de grootste transities van deze generatie. Als managing director Energie & Leefomgeving speel je hierin een sleutelrol. Je bepaalt mede de koers van onze grootste maatschappelijke adviespraktijken en draagt bij aan de toekomst van Nederland. Heb jij een sterk netwerk op C-level en ben je commercieel gedreven zonder de maatschappelijke opgave uit het oog te verliezen? Dan is dit jouw kans om het verschil te maken als managing director Energie & Leefomgeving bij Berenschot. 

Dit ga je doen 

Als managing director en tevens lid van het mt draag je actief bij aan de (uitvoering van de) strategie van Berenschot en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de strategierealisatie en financiële prestaties van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving (E&L). Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor een van de grootste adviesgroepen binnen Berenschot met circa zeventig professionals en een substantiële omzetbijdrage aan de groep. Je leidt het E&L-managementteam met vijf teamleads en draagt bij aan de verdere positionering en groei van Berenschot in de betreffende domeinen, voortbouwend op onze sterke reputatie. Je geeft richting aan de volgende groeifase binnen energie en leefomgeving, inspelend op de veranderende markt, waarin ook digitalisering en realisatie steeds belangrijker worden. Het zwaartepunt ligt hierbij op het goed positioneren van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving bij onze klanten buiten en het intern leiden van de E&L-teams naar de volgende fase. 

- Je hebt een heldere visie op de ontwikkelingen in de energiesector en de leefomgeving. Je kent onze opdrachtgevers, begrijpt hun vraagstukken en vertaalt dit samen met je teams naar een scherpe strategische koers, met commerciële kansen buiten en een strategisch personeelsplan binnen. 

- Je ondersteunt marktteams bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe business en initieert, ontwikkelt en realiseert omvangrijke adviesopdrachten en strategische samenwerkingen. 

- Je onderhoudt en versterkt relaties op C-level binnen relevante klantsegmenten voor E&L: (netbeheerders, energieproducenten, warmtebedrijven, ministeries van EZK, IenW en LVVN, provincies en waterschappen). 

- Je bent een gezaghebbende gesprekspartner binnen het publieke debat op ten minste een van de proposities van E&L en begrijpt de context van het gehele veld, waarbinnen E&L opereert. Je vertegenwoordigt Berenschot in bestuurlijke netwerken, media, congressen en vakinhoudelijke platforms. 

- Je geeft niet alleen richting aan de groep met haar diverse teams, maar bouwt met de groep aan de volgende fase van E&L. 

- Je bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar op de werkvloer en legt verbinding. Je ondersteunt teamleads en professionals en daagt hen uit in hun ontwikkeling. 

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en realiseren van een begroting, stuurt op declarabiliteit, bezettingsgraad en rendement.

title: Senior Controls Engineer

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
description:
About Finom 

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role 

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day. 

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes. 

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership. 

How We Build 

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.

What You'll Do 

What You'll Do 

- 
Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation. 

- 
Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle. 

- 
Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details. 

- 
Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 

- 
Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech. 

- 
Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team. 

Who You Are 

Who You Are 

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three. 

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue. 

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build. 

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team. 

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform. 

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague. 

Your Experience Includes 

- 
5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift. 

- 
Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns. 

- 
Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better. 

- 
Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI. 

- 
Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools. 

- 
Ability to write unit and UI tests. 

- 
Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD. 

- 
Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included. 

- 
A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code. 

Nice to Have 

Nice to Have 

- 
Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment. 

- 
Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain). 

- 
Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS. 

- 
Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar. 

- 
Published apps on the App Store you're proud of. 

- 
An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share. 

- 
Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices. 

- 
Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively. 

- 
Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows. 

Recruitment Flow 

- Recruiter Interview

- First Technical Interview

- Coding / AI assisted coding interview

- Mobile System Design Interview

- Team Fit Interview (peer interview)

- Offer

What You Will Get In Return 

Make a genuine impact on the product 

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product. 

Work in the EU 

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. 

Become a stock options holder 

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders. 

Receive unwavering support and care 

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling. 

Work & Swim program 

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views. 

Equal Opportunity Statement 

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Succevol ingevuld: Senior growth marketeer @ Snelstart
description:
Vacature: Senior Growth Marketeer (B2B SaaS) @ Snelstart 

• Impact maken, versnellen en professionaliseren 

• Mandaat en vrijheid 

• Locatie: Amersfoort 

• Uren: 32–40 uur 

• Opleidingsniveau: Hbo 

• Salaris: €4.800 – €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur 

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales. 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart 

• Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie. 

• Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering). 

• Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks. 

• Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal. 

• Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie). 

• Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention. 

• Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics. 

• Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed. 

Waarom is deze rol interessant voor jou? 

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten. Daarnaast kun je experimenteren, testen, AI inzetten, optimaliseren en nauw samenwerken met product, marketing automation, marketing director en het MT. 

Wat biedt Snelstart 

• Brutosalaris €4.800 – €7.000 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring. 

• 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur), maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage. 

• Hybride werken, modern benefits-pakket, laptop en ergonomische werkplek (zit-sta). 

• Toegang tot sportschool met bedrijfskorting. 

• Cultuur die data, snelheid en creativiteit omarmt; ruimte en budget voor tooling/experimenten. 

• Directe invloed op product, strategie en roadmap; doorgroeimogelijkheden in een schaalbare omgeving. 

• Een betrokken team met 200+ collega’s. 

Spreekt dit jou aan? Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer ( 

Wat is de procedure? 

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de directeur commercie en product en HR. De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de directeur commercie en product en een externe adviseur. Daarna volgt een arbeidsvoorwaarden gesprek.

Slotopmerking 

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!

Jouw profiel 

Ervaring en competenties 

• Hbo werk- en denkniveau. 

• 7+ jaar in growth/performance marketing of vergelijkbare data-gedreven SaaS-rol. 

• Sterk in strategie én executie; van visie naar vandaag nog live experimenten. 

• Analytisch: hypotheses, statistiek, funnel metrics, cohort analyses, CAC, LTV, incrementality. 

• Ervaring met A/B-testing, experiment design, CRO en gedragspsychologie.
