title: Senior Information Security Officer
description:
Your Role in Our Story: 

ACT is strengthening its data, technology and AI capabilities as we build a more integrated digital platform alongside our core environmental commodities trading and market-making business. This transformation is commercially driven, enabling us to scale, deepen client relationships and support increasingly complex and digital markets.

As Senior Information Security Officer, you will own ACT’s enterprise information security strategy and governance at Group level, spanning our core operations, emerging digital businesses and client-facing technology platforms. You will define the security risk appetite, lead our response to an evolving threat landscape, and ensure security and resilience are embedded by design as our technology landscape develops.

Working across business and technology leadership, you will translate commercial ambition into a pragmatic and scalable security posture that protects our systems and data while maintaining the trust of clients, counterparties and regulators. In essence, your role involves:

Strategy & Governance 

- Own the Group-wide information security strategy and roadmap across ACT’s core market-making business and digital and client-facing platforms, aligned with business goals and industry frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST CSF. Define and maintain ACT’s cyber risk appetite.

- Establish and lead security governance, including policies, standards and control frameworks, with clear accountability across the Group. Report on security posture and material incidents to executive leadership and, where relevant, the Board.

Client Platforms & Secure-by-Design 

- Embed security-by-design into new products and client platforms, partnering with Data, Architecture and Commercial teams to ensure emerging digital capabilities are secure from inception, while acting as a credible security voice to clients and counterparties.

- Oversee application, product and SaaS security, embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle for internal and client-facing platforms, and assessing third-party services handling ACT and counterparty data.

Risk & Resilience 

- Lead enterprise security risk management, including risk assessments, vulnerability management and third-party/supply-chain risk, driving timely mitigation across core and digital environments.

- Direct incident preparedness and response, coordinating detection, containment, eradication and recovery, while continuously strengthening incident and crisis-management plans.

Infrastructure & Emerging Technology 

- Secure ACT’s cloud and infrastructure through Zero-Trust-aligned controls, including identity and access management, segmentation and encryption, across a hybrid and multi-platform environment.

- Govern emerging technology and AI security, extending security oversight to AI and data platforms, including model and data-exposure risks and AI-enabled threats, as ACT expands its use of AI.

Compliance & Leadership 

- Ensure regulatory and compliance alignment, including GDPR, DORA and relevant sector obligations, advising the business on required adaptations and coordinating audits and certifications.

- Lead the security function and strengthen security culture across the Group, developing the team, raising security awareness, and acting as ACT’s primary authority and trusted advisor on cyber security to executives and business leaders, working alongside existing teams and capabilities.

Your Expertise: 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes: 

- A Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field. A relevant Master’s degree is an advantage.

- 10–15 years of progressive experience in information security and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior security role, with ownership of enterprise security strategy, governance and risk management.

- Broad security leadership experience across incident response, cloud and infrastructure security, product/application security and regulatory compliance. Experience securing client-facing platforms or digital products is highly valuable.

- Experience within trading, financial services, commodities or another data-intensive and regulated environment is highly advantageous.

- Strong knowledge of security frameworks and standards, including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and CIS Controls, with practical experience implementing them.

- Good understanding of data protection, regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, DORA and standards such as SOC 2.

- Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA, or equivalent, are highly desirable.

- Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex security risks into clear business implications and advise technical teams, executives, business stakeholders and clients.

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer 

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero 

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity .

Your team 

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters 

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like 

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

· Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

· Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

· Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

· Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

· Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

· Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

· Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves 

· A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

· At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

· Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

· Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

· Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

· Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

· Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

· Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

· You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

· You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves 

· Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

· Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

· Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

· Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

· Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

· Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero 

· Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

· Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

· Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

· International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

· Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis. 

What we offer 

· A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

· A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

· Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

· Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.

Application process 

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het voorbereiden en organiseren van export luchtvrachtzendingen conform de specificatie van de klant en richtlijnen van Geodis.

Je bent het centrale punt in een dynamisch proces. Je communiceert met klanten, leveranciers, kantoren en agenten. Je maakt afspraken met vervoerders en airlines conform de wensen van de klant. Hierbij probeer je proactief te zorgen dat marges worden vergroot zonder dat dit ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit die je levert.

Als accuraat persoon zorg je ervoor dat de data die je in het systeem invoert altijd correct is. Ook zorg je ervoor dat alle luchtvracht gerelateerde documenten en facturen foutloos worden opgemaakt.

Na een gedegen inwerkperiode zal er sprake zijn van periodieke standby/weekenddiensten.

Daarnaast ligt onze focus op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling binnen het vakgebied.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een leuke, enthousiaste, leergierige Freight Forwarder met goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift. Je bent communicatief vaardig en je hebt gedegen kennis van de Freight Forwarding Industrie. Je hebt MBO+ werkervaring, bent in het bezit van een geldige VGB & MLV en je hebt een probleemoplossende instelling. 

Voor aanvang van het dienstverband zal er een VGB aanvraag worden gestart.

title: Head of Product
description:
As Head of Product, your mission is to lead the product organization that builds what our users bank with every day, ensuring they get the safe, smart and effortless banking they expect.

Why this matters:
At bunq, our mission is to Make Life Easy, for our users, our teams, and the world around us.

title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role 

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.

What you’ll do 

- Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.

- Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.

- Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.

- Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.

- Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.

- Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.

- Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.

- Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What you’ll bring 

- Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.

- Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.

- Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.

- Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.

- The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.

- Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.

- Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.

- Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.

If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.

About the team 

We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, and we're distributed and all-remote.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees 

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 

- Flexible Paid Time Off 

- Team Member Resource Groups 

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 

- Growth and Development Fund 

- Parental Leave

- You will collaborate with the hardware design teams to guide the implementation of the chip's physical design.

- You will coordinate with our firmware & GNSS team to ensure the SoC Architecture supports efficient execution of software, including drivers, operating systems and applications.

- Solid understanding of chip packaging.

- Proficient in hardware-software interface design, including device drivers, firmware, and low-level software optimizations.

- Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve architectural issues related to SoC integration, performance, and power efficiency.

- Experienced with silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug methodologies.

- Practical experience with IP integration, including integration flows, interconnect design (e.g., AMBA, AXI, AHB), and managing key IP integration architecture tasks.

- Deep understanding of peripherals, Pin Function Assignment, and multiplexing, as well as familiarity with various communication protocols (e.g. MIPI, LVDS, SPI, I2C, UART).

- Experience in analog-digital interface design, including RF and Analog components like PLL, ADC, DAC, LNA, PA, DCDC, LDO… integration, and layout constraints for minimizing noise and signal interference.

- Knowledge of low-power design techniques, including clock gating, power gating, and multi-voltage domains (UPF/CPF).

- Deep understanding of library selection and design, with a focus on leakage power-aware methodologies to optimize performance and power trade-offs.

- Hands-on experience with IP selection to meet the specific needs of the design.

- Strong experience in selecting appropriate I/O technologies and designing for signal integrity, noise resilience, and power efficiency.

- Strong knowledge of pad ring placement and ESD strategy.

- In-depth expertise in clock and reset architecture design, including low-jitter clock distribution networks, clock domain crossing issues, and reset synchronization.

- Solid understanding of power management units and implementing various power sequencing schemes, including wake, sleep, and deep sleep modes for power efficiency.

- Solid Knowledge in signal processing, communication system.

Als Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek binnen de Life Sciences speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerp van complexe en technisch productiefaciliteiten, zoals laboratoria. Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige elektrotechnische installaties, van energievoorziening tot communicatie- en beveiligingssystemen.

Vanaf de conceptfase denk je mee over technische oplossingen die voldoen aan de strengste normen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang binnen het ontwerp. Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

- Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp- en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria of productiefaciliteiten.

- Afstemmen en coördineren van ontwerpwerkzaamheden met de ontwerpleider en andere disciplines.

Hier is waar 

- We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. SRON verhuisde naar het Leiden BioScience Park en stelde hoge eisen aan het nieuwe gebouw op het gebied van duurzaamheid, cleanrooms en installatietechniek. Als onderzoeksinstituut gewijd aan het bestuderen van de aardatmosfeer vond SRON het belangrijk om de impact op natuur en milieu te minimaliseren. Daarom koos Deerns in het ontwerp voor warmtepompen voor verwarming en koeling van het gebouw en werden er zonnepanelen op het dak geïnstalleerd. Bovendien kreeg het gebouw het BREEAM-NL certificaat Excellent.

- We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe, duurzame DSM Lab 6 in Delft, waar Deerns alle technische installaties, elektrische systemen, IT-infrastructuur, beveiliging, mechanische systemen, HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), transport- en utiliteitssystemen verzorgde. Tijdens de ontwerpfase werden ook de technische en financiële haalbaarheid grondig gecontroleerd. Op basis van de inval van zonlicht in het gebouw, de energieprestatie-eisen en de strenge eisen voor de binnentemperatuur ontwierp Deerns een gevel die voor 25% gesloten is. Dit zorgt voor een natuurlijk koel binnenklimaat, waardoor energie wordt bespaard op verwarmings-, ventilatie- en airconditioningsystemen.

- Jij hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor (Hbo/ Wo) in Electrical engineering of een andere technische opleiding.

- Jij hebt al enige ervaring opgedaan als Engineer Elektrotechniek en bent klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière.

- Jij hebt ervaring met werken in projecten en bent een uitstekende teamspeler.

- Je hebt uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (zowel geschreven als gesproken).

- MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en andere berekeningsprogramma’s hebben geen geheimen voor jou.

Dit bieden wij 

- Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. 

- Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

- Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

- Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. 

- Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. 

- Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. 

- Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. 

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Ben jij een Senior Mechanical Engineer die impact wil maken in één van de meest kritische technische omgevingen? Binnen onze unit Airports werk je aan hoogwaardige projecten die direct bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en duurzame luchthaveninfrastructuur. Je combineert technische diepgang met overzicht en neemt een sleutelrol in complexe projecten. 

De uitdaging 

In deze rol ben jij de inhoudelijke werktuigbouwkundige spil binnen complexe luchthavenprojecten, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Je opereert midden in de luchthavenoperatie, waar veiligheid, continuïteit en kwaliteit leidend zijn. Je neemt het voortouw in het ontwikkelen van slimme, integrale installatietechnische oplossingen en adviseert opdrachtgevers op strategisch en conceptueel niveau.

Werken in een 24uurs luchthavenomgeving maakt deze rol bijzonder dynamisch en uitdagend. De complexiteit van zowel de klant als de situatie vraagt om flexibiliteit, snel schakelen en creatief denken. Juist deze afwisseling zorgt ervoor dat geen dag hetzelfde is.

Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau.

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

- Je ontwerpt en adviseert zelfstandig over complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen luchthavenprojecten en vertaalt ontwerpen van schets tot technische uitwerking in AutoCAD en BIM. Je zet BIM‑structuren op en begeleidt en corrigeert junior collega’s.

- Het inhoudelijk bijdragen aan conceptontwikkeling en het vertalen van ontwerpuitgangspunten naar haalbare en integrale oplossingen.

- Het uitvoeren en controleren van berekeningen en het beoordelen van het werk van engineers en technici.

- Het afstemmen met projectleiders, ontwerpers, andere disciplines en externe partijen over technische keuzes en randvoorwaarden.

- Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen in kwaliteit, planning en budget en hierover proactief schakelen binnen het projectteam.

- Het begeleiden, coachen en inhoudelijk ondersteunen van junior engineers binnen projecten.

- Het leveren van input voor rapportages, adviezen en offertes.

- Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en kwaliteitsverbetering binnen de afdeling Airports.

De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn 

- We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling. Dit moet zorgen voor een aangename passagiersbeleving maar ook voor het aanbieden van een prettig werkklimaat voor de medewerkers op Schiphol, rekening houdend met hun dagelijkse activiteiten.

- We werken aan het nieuwe operationele gebouw van DC ANSP, de luchtverkeersleiding van het Nederlandse luchtruim in de Cariben. Dit is een faciliteit voor de luchtverkeersleiders die verantwoordelijk zijn voor area control, waarbij de operations room en de ruimte waar de apparatuur staat opgesteld aan strenge bouwfysische en klimaateisen moeten voldoen met een hoge mate van redundantie. De omgeving vraagt daarnaast om een robuust ontwerp dat bestand is tegen orkanen en aardbevingen.

- We werken op Schiphol aan diverse grote en kleine projecten waarin klimaatbeheersing een grote rol speelt door intensiever gebruik van diverse ruimtes en toename van de apparatuur. Schiphol is een unieke klant om voor te werken, vanwege de omvang van de luchthaven, de continue operationele eisen en de aanwezigheid van verschillende beveiligingszones. Wij worden veel ingezet om de oorzaak van klachten te achterhalen en de juiste oplossing te bieden, of om de juiste oplossing te vinden voor nieuwe apparatuur die hogere eisen stelt aan de installaties. Vrijwel altijd gaat het hier om locaties waar zich passagiers bevinden en Schiphol deze een comfortabele omgeving wil bieden, of waar medewerkers taken uitvoeren die essentieel zijn voor het primaire proces van de luchthaven, waarbij een prettig klimaat een belangrijke voorwaarde is.

Team 

Je werkt in een team van collega’s binnen een organisatie met ruim 750 medewerkers, actief in verschillende sectoren. Het hechte airports team bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers en specialisten in airportsystemen. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over luchthavenoperaties, gebouwgebonden installaties en specifieke luchthavensystemen. De cultuur is open en gericht op het delen van kennis en werkplezier. Je maakt deel uit van een integraal projectteam waarin ieders expertise optimaal wordt benut, wat zorgt voor sterke samenwerking en persoonlijke groei. De unit Airports werkt voor luchthavens in binnen- en buitenland, waardoor je aan diverse projecten werkt en geen dag hetzelfde is.

Dit ben jij 

- Mbo-, hbo- of wo‑werk- en denkniveau, met een afgeronde opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Installatietechniek of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Ook kandidaten met een mbo‑achtergrond en ruime relevante werkervaring aan de ontwerpkant nodigen wij nadrukkelijk uit om te reageren. 

- Enkele jaren ervaring binnen de gebouwde omgeving, bij voorkeur in een ontwerp of engineeringsrol.

- Goede technische basis en inzicht in het ontwerp en uitvoeringsproces.

- Ervaring met bijvoorbeeld luchthaven-, winkelcentra, grote kantoren of ziekenhuisprojecten is een pré.

- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling.

- Gestructureerde en zorgvuldige manier van werken, met oog voor kwaliteit en planning.

title: Software Engineer, AI Enablement
description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale . If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! 

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role 

We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.

Key Responsibilities 

- Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap.

- Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product.

- Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt.

- Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.

- Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool.

- Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.

What We Are Looking For 

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use

- Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation

- Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling

- A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate.

- Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team

- Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap

Nice to Have

- Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling

- Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents

- Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python

- Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer

- Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption

- Technical project management experience

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range

£128,770—£178,540 GBP

What We Offer 

- An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.

- A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

- Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

- Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

- Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.

- Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. 

- Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 

- Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 

- A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 

- Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter. 

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people. 

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness .

title: Design Engineer, Site
description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Design Engineer (Site) to own https://infisical.com and show the world what we're about.

In this role, you'll work with engineering, design, and marketing to be the go-to person for everything having to do with building and maintaining the design and infrastructure of the landing page; we want this surface to be iconic and performant to drive organic traffic and user adoption.

This role is for someone who has a frontend-leaning full stack engineering background, who obsesses over crafting pixel-perfect experiences, cares about building sound underlying infrastructure, and is motivated to help build out our growth engine.

You'll work closely with our co-founder, engineering, design, and marketing to:

- 
Design and ship pixel-perfect, reusable components and complex designs.

- 
Build and maintain core website pages (home, product, blogs, learning/resource hub etc.), microsites, frontend architecture, code quality, CMS integration and experience.

- 
Implement SEO best practices, run A/B tests, and optimize conversion funnels.

- 
Integrate analytics, attribution, and marketing tooling - Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, etc.

Requirements 

- 
Deep mastery of JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and frameworks like React/Next.js.

- 
Experience building high-quality frontend systems and components with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

- 
Experience with web design and design systems.

- 
Exceptional attention to detail and eagerness to learn.

- 
Bias toward action: able to make decisions, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

- 
Based in the Americas (SF preferred) or able to work EST hours.

Nice to have 

- 
Technical SEO fundamentals.

- 
Experience with CMS platforms (e.g. Contentful, Sanity, etc.).

- 
Experience configuring website analytics/marketing platform integrations such as with Google Analytics and HubSpot.

- 
Experience with developer-facing products or startups.

Team, values & benefits 

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. 

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. 

About the Role 

As our Principal AI Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of production AI systems that solve real business problems for our partners and shape how Able builds. You were a Technical Founder, Co-founder, or founding engineer at an AI company. You have the scar tissue of taking something to market and learning why product-market fit is hard. You will set the technical bar for AI at Able, working at the spec and acceptance layer of an AI-native engineering model, and play a key role in establishing Able as a leader in the AI space.

What We’re Looking For 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 

- Technical Leadership: you will lead technical conversations, be hands-on in building applications or proofs of concepts, and establish AI/ML guidelines and standards for our partners, prospects, and across the organization.

- Entrepreneurship: you will spot market opportunities to match technology with business outcomes, bringing a builder's instinct for what will and won't land commercially.

- AI Thought Leadership and Innovation: you will drive Able's AI strategy forward by constantly exploring and implementing cutting-edge AI technologies, frameworks, and tools.

- Consulting/Business Development: you will work with partners and prospects to understand their business and conceive of opportunities to introduce technology (AI specifically) to improve performance.

- AI Enablement: you will provide coaching and mentorship, continuously enhancing our team's and partner teams AI capabilities through knowledge sharing and training on the latest technology and best practices.

Required Skills & Experience 

- 12+ years building AI/ML systems, with production experience shipping and operating them

- Fluency with the modern LLM stack: frontier models, RAG, vector databases, agentic frameworks, and the evals and guardrails that make them trustworthy in production

- You operate in the spec-and-harness model, leveraging agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.,) at the spec and acceptance layer 

- Demonstrated experience leading large and complex projects

- Proven experience integrating ML and generative models with existing web and mobile applications

- Innate ability to effectively interact and inspire our partners and executive stakeholders on new AI ideas

- Demonstrated skill in connecting business challenges to the potential benefits of AI, and effectively communicating those opportunities to non-technical audiences

- Excellent English verbal and written communication

Nice to Have 

- Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with a strong focus on AI and Machine Learning

- Experience with MCP, graph-based retrieval, or multimodal pipelines

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

- To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.

- Payments made in USD.

- 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.

- Wellness + Remote Stipend

- AI Voucher

About Able 

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who are we? 

At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

About the role 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own a feature area within our Product Engineering team. You'll be the engineer your product manager turns to for "is this possible, and how big is it", leading technical design for your area and seeing it through to production. You'll shape how your squad builds, mentor the engineers around you, and have real influence over what we ship for customers who depend on us to understand their cyber risk.

You'll join one of our 11 (and growing) Product Engineering squads, most of which have a product manager, designer and technical lead alongside the engineers.

Our stack is React and TypeScript on the front end, Go services with Postgres as our primary database, running on Kubernetes via Google Cloud Platform.

Our engineers work with agentic coding tools, mostly Claude Code and Cursor, and a growing part of the product is LLM-backed. You'll work this way from day one, and we'll want your ideas on what to automate next, from how we write code to how we test, review, ship and run it.

What you'll do 

- 
Own a feature area end to end, from design conversations with product through to production and follow-up

- 
Lead technical design for your area and drive the architectural decisions within it

title: Scout Junior Quality Coordinator - Spanish (Mexico)
description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE 


Are you a search engine guru? Can you find what you're looking for with just a few keywords? We have a unique opportunity for you to put your skills to the test!



Welocalize is looking for an Spanish (Mexico) speaker in Mexico to help support our client's project as Junior Quality Coordinator .



MAIN DUTIES 



You will be the junior coordinator of our Search Quality Rater project. 


You will complete tasks both in Spanish (Mexico) and English (US) .



The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership of the Junior Quality Coordinator: 



Performance Analysis 


・May analyze data on quality performance, produce statistical quality reports, monitor progress, and create related documentation - with support from Quality Coordinators. 


・Completes Internal Assessments. 


・ Provides feedback on blind test ranges and queries coming from the team. 


・ May provide ad-hoc support to raters and educate them on best practices and client’s expectations. 


・Flags raters that show any behavioral concerns. 


・ May analyze RCAs provided by resources and request clarifications, as necessary. 



Training and support  


・ May participate in the creation/review of new training material, including best practices, newsletters, webinars, and others. 



Analytics, Reporting, Knowledge, and Asset Management  


・May keep track of data and analyze the data. 



Communication 


・May attend meetings with different stakeholders as applicable - with support of Quality Coordinators.  


・ Monitors raters’ queries. 



Other 


・ May perform other program-specific tasks needed to achieve OKRs. 



Project Details 



Location: Remote, Mexico-based


Hours: 20hours/week


Start date: ASAP


Employment Type: Freelance/Independent Contract


REQUIRED SKILLS



- Fully Proficient in Spanish (Mexico)

- Strong understanding of English

- Must be located in Mexico

- Strong understanding of popular culture in Spanish (Mexico)

- Must be dedicated only to "Search Quality rating program" and NOT other search or ads rating programs

- Must not have current or previous experience with "Ads quality rating"

- Must be the only one in your household working as a "Search Quality Rater"

- Web-savvy and able to work in a fast-paced environment

- Excellent online research skills

- Reliable computer system and internet connection 

- Reliable anti-virus software (as you will be surfing the web as part of the work)

- Ability to follow instructions in English and comply with the project conventions and rules expected by the client

- Must sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement to protect client confidentiality

- Must pass learning modules and a required quality test designed by our client before starting work


Compensation


Additional Information


When you join Welocalize, you have the opportunity to bring your career to the next level: 


... receive steady volume of work and long-term partnership {where this applies} 


... professional development: work on exciting projects that will empower you keep learning and growing


... work with multicultural, international team with a great variety of documents and content types 


... 24-hour 6-day a week support from our Community team.



If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, apply below.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco .

About the Job: 

Zone & Co is seeking a skilled AI Software Engineer to join our fast-paced, innovation-driven development team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions that power and enhance our business products and operations. You’ll collaborate closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to build scalable, production-ready AI systems that deliver real business value. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically curious and creative problem-solver who is passionate about artificial intelligence, continuous learning, and delivering high-impact outcomes.

What You'll Do: 

- 
Design, prototype, and implement AI systems for real-world business applications.

- 
Build and deploy end-to-end AI/ML pipelines for key product features.

- 
Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to deliver integrated AI solutions.

- 
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code using Python, JavaScript, or statically typed languages.

- 
Integrate AI/ML models into backend and frontend applications.

- 
Analyze large datasets to extract insights and support data-driven decisions.

- 
Evaluate and select AI frameworks, tools, and technologies based on project needs.

- 
Monitor and optimize deployed models for performance, scalability, and reliability.

- 
Lead experimentation and prototyping efforts to test new ideas and algorithms.

- 
Participate in code reviews and mentor junior engineers.

- 
Communicate technical details and outcomes to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- 
Maintain a strong commitment to data quality, privacy, and ethical AI practices.

- 
Stay current with emerging AI research, frameworks, and methodologies.

- 
Contribute to infrastructure and cloud service decisions for AI workflows.

What You'll Bring: 

- 
2+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on AI/ML applications.

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field (Master’s preferred).

- 
Hands-on experience with LLMs, agents, and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or DSPy.

- 
Proficient in Python with familiarity in JavaScript or similar languages; knowledge of statically typed languages is a plus.

- 
Strong understanding of both relational (SQL) and non-relational databases.

- 
Experience deploying AI systems in production environments.

- 
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure); containerization experience is a bonus.

- 
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities.

- 
Strong communication skills in English—both written and verbal.

- 
Passion for innovation and using technology to create business value.

- 
Commitment to ethical AI development and continuous professional growth.

Benefits 

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers 

Join Our Global Mission 

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment Terms 

United States 

Employment with Zone is “At-Will” , meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
description:
Who is Boulevard ? 

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . 

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most .

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come Do The Best Work Of Your Life At Boulevard 

As an Engineering Manager at Boulevard, you'll lead a team of talented engineers building the platform that powers thousands of self-care businesses. You'll balance technical leadership with people management, fostering a culture of excellence while delivering impactful products across a variety of domains.

Our engineering teams are responsible for developing scalable, reliable, and user-centric solutions that help businesses grow and operate efficiently. Whether working on customer engagement, commerce, scheduling, or core platform capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology.

What You'll Do Here: 

- Lead and develop a team of 5-8 engineers across various experience levels.

- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning.

- Partner with Product Management and Design to define and deliver the team roadmap.

- Drive technical excellence through code reviews and architectural guidance.

- Build a high-performing team culture focused on collaboration and growth.

- Manage team delivery, removing blockers, and ensuring successful execution.

- Contribute to hiring, interviewing, and onboarding new team members.

- Participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response when needed.

- Balance hands-on technical contribution with team enablement.

What You'll Need To Thrive: 

- 5+ years of software development experience with 2+ years of people management.

- Proven ability to lead and develop engineering teams.

- Strong technical background with the ability to provide architectural guidance.

- Experience with agile development and delivery management.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Track record of building inclusive, high-performing teams.

- Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity for your team.

- Experience with remote team management and async collaboration.

Nice To Have: 

- Previous experience in B2B SaaS or marketing platforms.

- Background in payment systems, scheduling, or commerce platforms.

- Experience with Elixir, React, or similar technologies.

- MBA or advanced degree in a related field.

How We'll Take Care Of You: 

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $173,000 - $216,500 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $153,500 - $211,200 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors, which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically. 

- 
✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance. 

- 
Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy. 

- 
Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month. 

- 
Family planning resources and specialized support programs. 

- 
Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard. 

- 
Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve.

We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life!

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

title: Technical Lead Manager
description:
About Us: 

Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. 

We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us.

About The Role: 

We're hiring a Tech Lead Manager (Staff+) to lead a small team building the platform that is modernizing homebuilding. This is a leadership-track role for a senior engineer ready to grow their scope and impact. You'll stay hands-on as a technical leader while directly managing a team of 2–4 engineers.

The role blends deep technical ownership with people leadership. You'll set technical direction for your domain, ship production-grade code, and be accountable for the growth, output, and delivery of your team. The work spans the full stack and covers both internal tools that power construction operations and customer-facing experiences for homeowners and trades.

We're a remote-first team. You'll work from wherever you do your best work, with regular offsites to get together in person. You'll own entire product areas, make real technical decisions, and work directly with engineering leadership, product, and design to take features from concept to production.

What You'll Do: 

Technical Leadership: 

- 
Set technical direction for your domain. Contribute to architecture decisions, API contracts, and data models that shape how our systems scale and evolve.

- 
Design, build, and deliver features across the platform. You own the full lifecycle from technical design through deployment and monitoring.

- 
Stay hands-on. Write and deploy high-quality, production-grade code on a regular basis.

- 
Raise the bar across engineering. Review designs, improve developer experience, and help other engineers work through complex problems.

People Leadership: 

- 
Directly manage a team of 2–4 engineers. Hold regular 1:1s, give clear and actionable feedback, and lead growth and performance conversations.

- 
Own your team's delivery. Drive planning, prioritization, and execution, and be accountable for outcomes.

- 
Coach and develop your engineers. Help them grow their skills, scope, and careers, and create the conditions for them to do their best work.

- 
Partner with product and design to translate messy, real-world processes into clean, reliable software and to make tradeoffs that balance speed and quality.

- 
Help grow the team. Recruit, interview, and raise the bar on who we hire.

About You: 

- 
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping products that land real-world impact.

- 
Experience as a tech lead, team lead, or engineering manager. You've led projects and/or people, whether formally or informally, and prior direct management experience is a strong plus.

- 
Built and delivered full-stack features across modern web technologies. Our stack includes TypeScript, Node, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS. We care more about your ability to learn and build than checking every box.

- 
Actively using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) in your daily workflow. You can explain how they change the way you approach problems and how you'd bring that leverage to a team.

- 
Demonstrated leadership and ownership. Mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and being the person people depend on.

- 
Designed systems that balance quick iterations with long-term reliability and maintainability.

- 
Partnered with product, design, and non-technical stakeholders to define requirements, make tradeoffs, and deliver outcomes. Not just code.

Who You Are: 

- 
You want to grow your scope and impact through leadership, both technical and people.

- 
You care about the people on your team. Their growth, their output, and their experience.

- 
You take ownership and seek autonomy over your work and outcomes.

- 
You're excited to build and lead within a small, nimble, high-impact team.

- 
You are self-directed. Comfortable prioritizing your own work and your team's with minimal oversight.

- 
You communicate clearly and proactively. Especially in writing.

- 
You're humble, good-natured, and bring positive energy to your tea

Our Commitment :

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page. 

Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our Compensation Philosophy :

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Please note that the salary range displayed on each job posting may vary by state. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. You can find information about our benefits here .
